translations.idiomatic: Patrollers held the left half and guards the right; matching the halves verified attendance.

sentences.zh: 權杖之號六：曰申，以給金吾諸衛之警夜者；

translations.literal: Six staff-tally designations: Shen, issued to night-watch officers of the Golden Guard and other guards;
translations.idiomatic: Six staff-tally types included Shen for night-watch officers of the Golden Guard and other guards;

sentences.zh: 曰木，曰金，曰土，曰火，曰水，以給五城之警夜者。

translations.literal: Mu, Jin, Tu, Huo, and Shui for night-watch officers of the Five Cities.
translations.idiomatic: Mu, Jin, Tu, Huo, and Shui for night-watch officers of the Five Cities.

sentences.zh: 銅牌之號一，以稽守卒，曰勇。

translations.literal: One bronze plaque type to check garrison soldiers, called Yong (Valor).
translations.idiomatic: One bronze plaque type, Yong (Valor), checked garrison soldiers.

sentences.zh: 牙牌之號五，以察朝參：公、侯、伯曰勳，駙馬都尉曰親，文官曰文，武官曰武，教坊司曰樂。

translations.literal: Five ivory plaque types to verify court attendance: dukes, marquises, and earls—Xun (Merit); imperial sons-in-law—Qin (Kin); civil officials—Wen (Civil); military officials—Wu (Military); Music Office—Yue (Music).
translations.idiomatic: Five ivory plaque types verified court attendance: Xun (Merit) for dukes, marquises, and earls; Qin (Kin) for imperial sons-in-law; Wen (Civil) for civil officials; Wu (Military) for military officials; and Yue (Music) for the Music Office.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖中，總編曰官字某號，朝參佩以出入，不則門者止之。

translations.literal: During Jiajing they were generally inscribed "Official Character, No. __"; worn for court attendance to enter and exit—otherwise gatekeepers stopped them.
translations.idiomatic: During Jiajing they were inscribed "Official Type, Serial No. __"; court attendance required wearing them to pass—otherwise gatekeepers barred entry.

sentences.zh: 私相借者，論如律。

translations.literal: Private lending was punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Private lending was punished under statute.

sentences.zh: 有故，納之內府。

translations.literal: When no longer needed, they were surrendered to the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: When no longer needed, they were returned to the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 祭牌之號三：陪，祀官曰陪，供事官曰供，執事人曰執。

translations.literal: Three sacrificial plaque types: Pei for collateral sacrificers, Gong for supply officers, and Zhi for attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Three sacrificial plaque types: Pei for collateral sacrificers, Gong for supply officers, and Zhi for attendants.

sentences.zh: 雙魚銅牌之號二：曰嚴，以肅直衛錦衣校尉之止直者；

translations.literal: Two double-fish bronze plaque types: Yan, to enforce off-duty discipline among Brocade Guard squad sergeants;
translations.idiomatic: Two double-fish bronze plaque types: Yan enforced off-duty discipline among Brocade Guard squad sergeants;

sentences.zh: 曰善，以飾光祿胥役之供事者。

translations.literal: Shan, to regulate attendants among the Court of Imperial Entertainments laborers.
translations.idiomatic: Shan regulated attendants among the Court of Imperial Entertainments laborers.

sentences.zh: 符驗之號五：曰馬，曰水，曰達，曰通，曰信。

translations.literal: Five travel-credential types: Ma, Shui, Da, Tong, and Xin.
translations.idiomatic: Five travel-credential types: Ma, Shui, Da, Tong, and Xin.

sentences.zh: 符驗之制，上織船馬之狀，起馬用「馬。」

translations.literal: Travel credentials were made with woven depictions of boats and horses; single-horse relay used the character "Ma"
translations.idiomatic: Credentials bore woven depictions of boats and horses; single-horse relay used "Ma"

sentences.zh: 字，雙馬用「達。」

translations.literal: ; double-horse relay used "Da"
translations.idiomatic: ; double-horse relay used "Da"

sentences.zh: 字，單馬用「通。」

translations.literal: ; ordinary single-horse relay used "Tong"
translations.idiomatic: ; ordinary single-horse relay used "Tong"

sentences.zh: 字。
起船者用「水。」

translations.literal: For starting boats, "Shui"
translations.idiomatic: Boat relay used "Shui"

sentences.zh: 字，並船用「信。」

translations.literal: ; combined boat relay used "Xin"
translations.idiomatic: ; combined boat relay used "Xin"

sentences.zh: 字。
親王之籓及文武出鎮撫、行人通使命者，則給之。

translations.literal: They were issued to princes in their fiefs, civil and military officials going out to command pacification, and receptionists conveying missions.
translations.idiomatic: They were issued to fief princes, civil and military pacification commissioners, and receptionists on diplomatic missions.

sentences.zh: 御史出巡察則給印，事竣，鹹驗而納之。

translations.literal: Censors on inspection tours received seals; when the task was complete, all were verified and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Censors on inspection tours received seals; when missions ended, all were verified and returned.

sentences.zh: 稽出入之令，而辨其數，其職至邇，其事至重也。

translations.literal: It checked orders of entry and exit and kept count—a duty most immediate, and a matter most weighty.
translations.idiomatic: It verified entry and exit orders and tracked their numbers—a duty of utmost immediacy and gravity.

sentences.zh: 吏、戶、禮、兵、刑、工六科。

translations.literal: The six offices: Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Justice, and Works.
translations.idiomatic: The Six Offices of Scrutiny: Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Justice, and Works.

sentences.zh: 各都給事中一人，正七品左、右給事中各一人。

translations.literal: Each had one Supervising Secretary at rank 7a; one Left and one Right Associate Supervising Secretary
translations.idiomatic: Each had one supervising secretary at rank 7a and one left and one right associate supervising secretary

sentences.zh: 從七品給事中，吏科四人，戶科八人，禮科六人，兵科十人，刑科八人，工科四人。

translations.literal: at rank 7b; Secretaries: Personnel four, Revenue eight, Rites six, War ten, Justice eight, Works four.
translations.idiomatic: at rank 7b; personnel four, revenue eight, rites six, war ten, justice eight, and works four secretaries.

sentences.zh: 並從七品，後增、減員數不常。

translations.literal: All at rank 7b; later increases and reductions were inconstant.
translations.idiomatic: All at rank 7b; later staffing changes were frequent.

sentences.zh: 萬曆九年裁兵科五人，戶、刑二科各四人，禮科二人。

translations.literal: In Wanli year 9 five War Office posts were cut, four each from Revenue and Justice, and two from Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli year 9 cut five war posts, four each from revenue and justice, and two from rites.

sentences.zh: 十一年復設戶、兵、刑三科各二人，禮科一人。

translations.literal: In year 11 two each were restored to Revenue, War, and Justice, and one to Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Year 11 restored two each to revenue, war, and justice and one to rites.

sentences.zh: 六科，掌侍從、規諫、補闕、拾遺、稽察六部百司之事。

translations.literal: The Six Offices managed attendance on the throne, remonstrance, filling omissions, recovering oversights, and scrutiny of the Six Ministries and all offices.
translations.idiomatic: The Six Offices handled attendance, remonstrance, filling omissions, recovering oversights, and scrutiny of the Six Ministries and all offices.

sentences.zh: 凡制敕宣行，大事覆奏，小事署而頒之；

translations.literal: When proclamations and commands were promulgated, major matters were re-memorialized; minor ones were signed and issued;
translations.idiomatic: When edicts and commands were promulgated, major matters required re-memorialization; minor ones were signed and issued;

sentences.zh: 有失，封還執奏。

translations.literal: errors were sealed and returned for memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Errors were sealed and returned for re-memorialization.

sentences.zh: 凡內外所上章疏下，分類抄出，參署付部，駁正其違誤。

translations.literal: All memorials submitted from within and without, once received, were copied by category, countersigned, and forwarded to ministries, with errors corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Incoming memorials from within and without were copied by category, countersigned, forwarded to ministries, and corrected for errors.

sentences.zh: 吏科，凡吏部引選，則掌科即都給事中，以掌本科印，故名，六科同。

translations.literal: The Personnel Office: whenever the Ministry of Personnel presented candidates for selection, the supervising secretary—that is, the Office Director, so called because he held the office seal—the same for all six offices;
translations.idiomatic: In the Personnel Office, when the Ministry of Personnel presented candidates, the supervising secretary—the office head, so named for holding the seal—did likewise in all six offices;

sentences.zh: 同至御前請旨。

translations.literal: together they went before the throne to request the imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: together they went before the throne to request the imperial decision.

sentences.zh: 外官領文憑，皆先赴科畫字。

translations.literal: Outside officials receiving appointment documents all first went to the office to sign.
translations.idiomatic: Outside officials receiving appointment credentials first had to obtain the office's countersignature.

sentences.zh: 內外官考察自陳後，則與各科具奏。

translations.literal: After inside and outside officials' performance review self-reports, they jointly submitted full memorials with each office.
translations.idiomatic: After provincial and capital officials filed self-reports in the performance review, each office jointly memorialized with the others.

sentences.zh: 拾遺糾其不職者。

translations.literal: Remonstrance recoverers impeached those derelict in duty.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance recoverers impeached officials who had failed in their duties.

sentences.zh: 戶科，監光祿寺歲入金穀，甲字等十庫錢鈔雜物，與各科兼蒞之，皆三月而代。

translations.literal: The Revenue Office supervised the Court of Imperial Entertainments' annual intake of gold and grain, the Jia-character and nine other vaults' cash notes and miscellaneous goods, jointly attending with each office; all rotated every three months.
translations.idiomatic: The Revenue Office supervised the Court of Imperial Entertainments' annual revenue in gold and grain and the ten vaults—including the Jia vault—for cash notes and miscellaneous goods, sharing duty with the other offices on three-month rotations.

sentences.zh: 內外有陳乞田土、隱佔侵奪者，糾之。

translations.literal: Inside and outside, those who petitioned for land grants or concealed occupation and seizure, it impeached.
translations.idiomatic: It impeached petitions for land grants and cases of concealed occupation or unlawful seizure, whether in the capital or the provinces.

sentences.zh: 禮科，監訂禮部儀制，凡大臣曾經糾劾削奪、有玷士論者紀錄之，以核贈諡之典。

translations.literal: The Rites Office supervised and revised the Ministry of Rites' ritual regulations; all grand ministers once impeached and stripped, tainted in scholarly opinion, it recorded, to verify posthumous honors and posthumous titles.
translations.idiomatic: The Rites Office supervised revision of the Ministry of Rites' ritual code and recorded grand ministers who had been impeached, stripped of honors, or discredited in scholarly opinion, for use in verifying posthumous honors and titles.

sentences.zh: 兵科，凡武臣貼黃誥敕，本科一人監視。

translations.literal: The War Office: for all military officers' attached yellow briefs and patent letters, one person from this office supervised.
translations.idiomatic: In the War Office, one secretary supervised the attached yellow briefs and patent letters issued to military officers.

sentences.zh: 其引選畫憑之制，如吏科。

translations.literal: Its system of referral selection and countersigning credentials was as in the Personnel Office.
translations.idiomatic: Its procedures for candidate referral, selection, and credential countersigning followed those of the Personnel Office.

sentences.zh: 刑科，每歲二月下旬，上前一年南北罪囚之數，歲終類上一歲蔽獄之數，閱十日一上實在罪囚之數，皆憑法司移報而奏禦焉。

translations.literal: The Justice Office: each year in late second month, it memorialized the previous year's north and south criminal prisoner counts; at year's end it summarized the previous year's closed-case counts; every ten days it memorialized the actual prisoner counts—all relying on judicial offices' transfer reports and memorializing to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: The Justice Office each year in late second month reported the previous year's prisoner totals for north and south; at year's end it summarized closed cases for the year; every ten days it reported current prisoner counts—all based on transfer reports from the judicial offices and memorialized to the throne.

sentences.zh: 工科，閱試軍器局，同御史巡視節慎庫，與各科稽查寶源局。

translations.literal: The Works Office inspected the Armory Bureau, jointly with censors inspected the Treasury of Careful Stewardship, and with each office scrutinized the Bureau of Precious Sources.
translations.idiomatic: The Works Office inspected the Armory Bureau, joined censors in inspecting the Treasury of Careful Stewardship, and with the other offices scrutinized the Bureau of Precious Sources.

sentences.zh: 而主德闕違，朝政失得，百官賢佞，各科或單疏專達，或公疏連署奏聞。

translations.literal: As for sovereign virtue deficient or deviant, court governance's gains and losses, and all officials' worthiness and sycophancy, each office might submit an individual memorial directly, or a collective memorial with joint signatures.
translations.idiomatic: On deficiencies in imperial virtue, errors in court governance, and the worthiness or sycophancy of officials, each office could submit an individual memorial directly or a collective memorial with joint signatures.

sentences.zh: 雖分隸六科，其事屬重大者，各科皆得通奏。

translations.literal: Although divided among the Six Offices, for matters of great weight, every office could submit memorials generally.
translations.idiomatic: Although each office had its specialty, any office could memorialize on matters of major importance.

sentences.zh: 但事屬某科，則列其科為首。

translations.literal: But if the matter belonged to a given office, that office was listed first.
translations.idiomatic: When a matter fell under a particular office's jurisdiction, that office was named first on the memorial.

sentences.zh: 凡日朝，六科輪一人立殿左右，珥筆記旨。

translations.literal: At each daily court audience, the Six Offices rotated one person to stand left and right of the hall, pen behind ear recording the imperial will.
translations.idiomatic: At daily court audiences, the Six Offices rotated one secretary to stand beside the throne with a pen behind the ear, recording the imperial will.

sentences.zh: 凡題奏，日附科籍，五日一送內閣，備編纂。

translations.literal: All memorials and reports were daily attached to the office register; every five days sent once to the Grand Secretariat, for compilation.
translations.idiomatic: Memorials and reports were logged daily in the office register and sent to the Grand Secretariat every five days for compilation.

sentences.zh: 其諸司奉旨處分事目，五日一註銷，核稽緩。

translations.literal: The various offices' items handled by imperial order were cancelled off every five days, verifying delays.
translations.idiomatic: Items ordered by imperial decree were checked off every five days to verify whether execution had been delayed.

sentences.zh: 內官傳旨必覆奏，復得旨而後行。

translations.literal: When inner-court eunuchs transmitted orders, re-memorialization was mandatory; only after again receiving the order did they proceed.
translations.idiomatic: Orders transmitted by inner-court eunuchs had to be re-memorialized; execution proceeded only after the order was confirmed a second time.

sentences.zh: 鄉試充考試官，會試充同考官，殿試充受卷官。

translations.literal: For provincial examinations they served as examination officers; for metropolitan examinations as associate examiners; for palace examinations as receiving-scroll officers.
translations.idiomatic: They served as examination officers in provincial exams, associate examiners in metropolitan exams, and scroll receivers in palace exams.

sentences.zh: 冊封宗室、諸蕃或告諭外國，充正、副使。

translations.literal: For investiture of imperial clansmen, various tributary domains, or proclaiming and instructing foreign states, they served as chief and deputy envoys.
translations.idiomatic: They served as chief and deputy envoys for investitures of imperial clansmen, tributary domains, and missions proclaiming imperial instructions to foreign states.

sentences.zh: 朝參門籍，六科流掌之。

translations.literal: The court attendance gate register the Six Offices managed in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: The Six Offices took turns maintaining the court attendance gate register.

sentences.zh: 登聞鼓樓，日一人，皆錦衣衛官監蒞。

translations.literal: The Drum Tower for Reaching the Emperor's Hearing: one person daily, all supervised by Brocade Guard officers.
translations.idiomatic: At the Drum Tower for Reaching the Emperor's Hearing, one secretary served each day under supervision by Brocade Guard officers.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，以監察御史一人監登聞鼓，後令六科與錦衣衛輪直。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 1, one investigating censor was assigned to supervise the reaching-hearing drum; later the Six Offices and the Brocade Guard rotated duty.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1 one investigating censor supervised the reaching-hearing drum; later the Six Offices and the Brocade Guard took turns on duty.

sentences.zh: 受牒，則具題本封上。

translations.literal: When a petition was received, a topic memorial was prepared and sealed upward.
translations.idiomatic: When a petition was received, they prepared a topic memorial and forwarded it sealed to the throne.

sentences.zh: 遇決囚，有投牒訟冤者，則判停刑請旨。

translations.literal: When executing prisoners, if one submitted a petition alleging injustice, they judged a halt to execution and requested an order.
translations.idiomatic: During executions, if someone submitted a petition alleging injustice, they halted the execution pending imperial order.

sentences.zh: 凡大事廷議，大臣廷推，大獄廷鞫，六掌科皆預焉。

translations.literal: For major matters of court deliberation, grand ministers' court recommendation, and major cases' court interrogation, all six office heads participated.
translations.idiomatic: All six supervising secretaries participated in court deliberations on major affairs, court recommendations of grand ministers, and court interrogations in major cases.

sentences.zh: 明初，統設給事中，正五品，後數更其秩。

translations.literal: At the dynasty's beginning, supervising secretaries were established uniformly at rank 5a; later their ranks were changed several times.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the dynasty supervising secretaries were established uniformly at rank 5a; their ranks were revised several times thereafter.

sentences.zh: 與起居注同。

translations.literal: The same as the Diarists.
translations.idiomatic: Their rank changes matched those of the Diarists.

sentences.zh: 洪武六年，設給事中十二人，秩正七品，始分為六科，每科二人，鑄給事中印一，推年長者一人掌之。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 6, twelve supervising secretaries were established at rank 7a; they were first divided into six offices, two per office; one supervising-secretary seal was cast; the senior by age among them held it.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 6 twelve supervising secretaries at rank 7a were appointed and first divided into six offices of two each; one office seal was cast and held by the senior member.

sentences.zh: 九年，定給事中十人。

translations.literal: Year 9, supervising secretaries were fixed at ten.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 the number of supervising secretaries was fixed at ten.

sentences.zh: 十年，隸承敕監。

translations.literal: Year 10, subordinated to the Imperial Decree Reception Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 they were placed under the Imperial Decree Reception Directorate.

sentences.zh: 十二年，改隸通政司。

translations.literal: Year 12, subordination was changed to the Office of Transmission.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 they were transferred to the Office of Transmission.

sentences.zh: 十三年，置諫院，左、右司諫各一人，正七品左、右正言各二人。

translations.literal: Year 13, the Remonstrance Bureau was established: one Left and one Right Remonstrance Director each at rank 7a; two Left and two Right Chief Censors each
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 the Remonstrance Bureau was established with one Left and one Right Remonstrance Director at rank 7a and two Left and two Right Chief Censors

sentences.zh: 從七品十五年，又置諫議大夫。

translations.literal: at rank 7b. In year 15, Remonstrance Grand Masters were also established.
translations.idiomatic: at rank 7b. In year 15 Remonstrance Grand Masters were also appointed.

sentences.zh: 以兵部尚書唐鐸為之。

translations.literal: The Minister of War Tang Duo was appointed to the post.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Tang Duo was appointed to the post.

sentences.zh: 尋皆罷。

translations.literal: Soon all were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Soon all these posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，改給事中為源士，增至八十一人。

translations.literal: Year 22, supervising secretaries were changed to Source Scholars, increased to eighty-one persons.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22 supervising secretaries were retitled Source Scholars and increased to eighty-one posts.

sentences.zh: 初，魏敏、卓敬等凡八十一人為給事中。

translations.literal: Initially Wei Min, Zhuo Jing, and others—eighty-one in all—were supervising secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: Initially eighty-one men, including Wei Min and Zhuo Jing, served as supervising secretaries.

sentences.zh: 上以其適符古元士之數，改為元士。

translations.literal: The emperor, because their number matched the ancient count of foundational scholars, changed them to Foundational Scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Because their number matched the ancient quota of foundational scholars, the emperor retitled them Foundational Scholars.

sentences.zh: 至是，又以六科為事之本源，改為源士。

translations.literal: At this point, because the Six Offices were the root source of affairs, they were changed to Source Scholars.
translations.idiomatic: They were then retitled Source Scholars because the Six Offices were regarded as the root source of government business.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復為給事中。

translations.literal: Before long, they were restored as supervising secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the title was restored to supervising secretaries.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，更定科員，每科都給事中一人，正八品。

translations.literal: Year 24, office staffing was revised: each office one Supervising Secretary at rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: In year 24 office staffing was revised: each office received one supervising secretary at rank 8a.

sentences.zh: 左、右給事中二人，從八品。

translations.literal: Two Left and Right Associate Supervising Secretaries at rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: Two left and right associate supervising secretaries at rank 8b.

sentences.zh: 給事中共四十人，正九品。

translations.literal: Forty supervising secretaries in all at rank 9a.
translations.idiomatic: Forty secretaries in all at rank 9a.

sentences.zh: 各科分設員數，如前所列。

translations.literal: Each office's allotted posts were as listed above.
translations.idiomatic: Each office's allotted posts were as listed above.

sentences.zh: 建文中，改都給事中，正七品，給事中，從七品，不置左、右給事中。

translations.literal: During the Jianwen reign, Supervising Secretaries were changed to rank 7a and Secretaries to rank 7b; Left and Right Associate Supervising Secretaries were not appointed.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jianwen reign supervising secretaries were raised to rank 7a and secretaries to rank 7b, and left and right associate supervising secretaries were abolished.

sentences.zh: 增設拾遺、補闕。

translations.literal: Remonstrance recoverers and gap-fillers were added.
translations.idiomatic: Posts of remonstrance recoverer and gap-filler were added.

sentences.zh: 成祖初，革拾遺、補闕，仍置左、右給事中，亦從七品。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Chengzu reign, remonstrance recoverers and gap-fillers were abolished; Left and Right Associate Supervising Secretaries were restored, also at rank 7b.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Yongle reign remonstrance recoverers and gap-fillers were abolished and left and right associate supervising secretaries restored, also at rank 7b.

sentences.zh: 尋改六科，置於午門外直房蒞事。

translations.literal: Soon the Six Offices were reorganized and placed in duty rooms outside the Meridian Gate to handle business.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Six Offices were reorganized and assigned duty rooms outside the Meridian Gate.

sentences.zh: 六科衙門舊在磚門內尚寶司西。

translations.literal: The Six Offices' yamen had formerly been inside Brick Gate, west of the Imperial Seals Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: The Six Offices had formerly been quartered inside Brick Gate, west of the Imperial Seals Directorate.

sentences.zh: 永樂中災，移午門外東西，每夜一科直宿。

translations.literal: After a disaster in the Yongle reign, they moved east and west outside the Meridian Gate; each night one office kept night duty.
translations.idiomatic: After a fire in the Yongle reign they moved to quarters east and west of the Meridian Gate, with one office on night duty each night.

sentences.zh: 宣德八年，增戶科給事中，專理黃冊。

translations.literal: Xuande year 8, a Revenue Office secretary was added to manage yellow registers exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 8 an additional revenue secretary was appointed to manage yellow registers exclusively.

sentences.zh: 中書科。

translations.literal: The Secretarial Drafters Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretarial Drafters Bureau.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人二十人，從七品直文華殿東房中書舍人，直武英殿西房中書舍人，內閣誥敕房中書舍人，制敕房中書舍人。

translations.literal: Twenty Secretariat Drafters at rank 7b; Secretariat Drafters assigned to the Hall of Literary Glory east chambers; Secretariat Drafters assigned to the Hall of Military Eminence west chambers; Secretariat Drafters of the Grand Secretariat Commission Drafting Office; Secretariat Drafters of the Decree Drafting Office.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty secretariat drafters at rank 7b; drafters assigned to the east chambers of the Hall of Literary Glory; drafters assigned to the west chambers of the Hall of Military Eminence; drafters in the Grand Secretariat Commission Drafting Office; and drafters in the Decree Drafting Office.

sentences.zh: 並從七品，無定員。

translations.literal: All at rank 7b, with no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: All at rank 7b, with no fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 中書科舍人掌書寫誥敕、制詔、銀冊、鐵券等事。

translations.literal: Secretarial Drafters of the bureau managed writing patent letters, decrees and proclamations, silver registers, iron certificates, and such matters.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau drafters handled the writing of patent letters, decrees and proclamations, silver registers, iron certificates, and related documents.

sentences.zh: 凡草請諸翰林，寶請諸內府，左券及勘籍，歸諸古今通集庫。

translations.literal: Drafts were requested from the Hanlin; seals from the inner palace; left tally halves and verification registers went to the Treasury of Ancient and Modern Comprehensive Collections.
translations.idiomatic: Drafts came from the Hanlin Academy, seals from the inner palace, and left tally halves and verification registers were kept in the Treasury of Ancient and Modern Comprehensive Collections.

sentences.zh: 誥敕，公侯伯及一品至五品誥命、六品至九品敕命。

translations.literal: Patent letters: dukes, marquises, earls, and patent letters of appointment from rank 1a through 5a; command letters from rank 6a through 9b.
translations.idiomatic: Patent letters went to dukes, marquises, and earls and to civil appointees from rank 1a through 5a; command letters to appointees from rank 6a through 9b.

sentences.zh: 勘合籍，初用二十八宿，後用《急就章》為號。

translations.literal: Tally verification registers initially used the twenty-eight lunar mansions; later the Rapid Composition Primer was used for numbering.
translations.idiomatic: Tally verification registers initially used the twenty-eight lunar mansions for numbering; later the Rapid Composition Primer was used instead.

sentences.zh: 誥敕之號，曰仁、義、禮、智，公、侯、伯、蕃王、一品、二品用之；

translations.literal: Patent letter serials were called Benevolence, Righteousness, Propriety, and Wisdom; dukes, marquises, earls, tributary kings, and ranks 1a and 2a used them;
translations.idiomatic: Patent serials named Benevolence, Righteousness, Propriety, and Wisdom were used for dukes, marquises, earls, tributary kings, and ranks 1a and 2a;

sentences.zh: 曰十二支，曰文、行、忠、信，文官三品以下用之；

translations.literal: called the twelve earthly branches; called Culture, Conduct, Loyalty, and Trust—used for civil officials below rank 3a;
translations.idiomatic: the twelve earthly branches; and Culture, Conduct, Loyalty, and Trust—for civil officials below rank 3a;

sentences.zh: 曰千字文，武官、續誥用之。

translations.literal: called the Thousand-Character Classic—used for military officers and supplemental patents.
translations.idiomatic: the Thousand-Character Classic—for military officers and supplemental patents.

sentences.zh: 皆以千號為滿，滿則復始。

translations.literal: Each ran to one thousand numbers; when full, counting began anew.
translations.idiomatic: Each series ran to one thousand numbers and then started over.

sentences.zh: 王府及駙馬都尉不編號，土官以文武類編。

translations.literal: Princely establishments and imperial sons-in-law were not numbered; native officials were numbered by civil and military categories.
translations.idiomatic: Princely establishments and imperial sons-in-law received no serial numbers; native officials were numbered separately by civil and military type.

sentences.zh: 凡大朝會，則侍班。

translations.literal: At great court assemblies, they attended in standing formation.
translations.idiomatic: At great court assemblies they stood attendance in the imperial procession.

sentences.zh: 東宮令節朝賀，則導駕侍班於文華殿。

translations.literal: On the Heir Apparent's festive days of court congratulations, they guided the carriage and attended in standing formation in the Hall of Literary Glory.
translations.idiomatic: On the crown prince's festive court audiences they guided the procession and stood attendance in the Hall of Literary Glory.

sentences.zh: 冊封宗室，則充副使。

translations.literal: For investiture of imperial clansmen, they served as deputy envoys.
translations.idiomatic: For investitures of imperial clansmen they served as deputy envoys.

sentences.zh: 其鄉試、會試、殿試，間有差遣，充授並如科員。

translations.literal: For provincial, metropolitan, and palace examinations, they were occasionally dispatched, serving in appointment just like office secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: They were occasionally assigned to provincial, metropolitan, and palace examinations in the same capacities as the Six Offices' secretaries.

sentences.zh: 大祀南郊，則隨駕而供事。

translations.literal: At the great sacrifice at the Southern Suburb, they followed the imperial carriage and performed duties.
translations.idiomatic: At the great suburban sacrifice they accompanied the imperial procession and performed attendant duties.

sentences.zh: 員無正貳，印用年深者掌之。

translations.literal: There were no fixed chief and deputy posts; the seal was held by the most senior in years of service.
translations.idiomatic: There were no fixed chief and deputy ranks; the seal was held by the longest-serving drafter.

sentences.zh: 文華殿舍人，職掌奉旨書寫書籍。

translations.literal: Hall of Literary Glory drafters had as their duty writing books by imperial order.
translations.idiomatic: Drafters in the Hall of Literary Glory wrote books on imperial order.

sentences.zh: 武英殿舍人，職掌奉旨篆寫冊寶、圖書、冊頁。

translations.literal: Hall of Military Eminence drafters had as their duty seal-script writing of seal registers, books, and album leaves by imperial order.
translations.idiomatic: Drafters in the Hall of Military Eminence wrote seal registers, books, and album leaves in seal script on imperial order.

sentences.zh: 內閣誥敕房舍人，掌書辦文官誥敕，番譯敕書，並外國文書、揭帖，兵部紀功、勘合底簿。

translations.literal: Grand Secretariat Commission Drafting Office drafters managed writing and processing civil patent letters, translating patent letters, and foreign documents and briefing notes, and the War Ministry's merit records and tally ledgers.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretariat commission drafters handled civil patent letters, translated patent letters, foreign documents and briefing notes, and the War Ministry's merit records and tally ledgers.

sentences.zh: 制敕房舍人，掌書辦制敕、詔書、誥命、冊表、寶文、玉牒、講章、碑額、題奏、揭帖一應機密文書，各王府敕符底簿。

translations.literal: Decree Drafting Office drafters managed writing and processing decrees, imperial proclamations, patent letters of appointment, investiture memorials, seal texts, jade genealogies, lecture chapters, stele inscriptions, memorial headings, briefing notes—all confidential documents—and each princely establishment's command-tally ledgers.
translations.idiomatic: Decree drafters handled decrees, imperial proclamations, patent letters, investiture memorials, seal texts, jade genealogies, lecture chapters, stele inscriptions, memorial headings, briefing notes, and other confidential documents, as well as command-tally ledgers for each princely establishment.

sentences.zh: 洪武七年，初設直省舍人十人，秩從八品，隸中書省。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 7, ten provincial secretarial drafters were first established at rank 8b, subordinate to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 7 ten provincial secretarial drafters were first established at rank 8b under the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 九年，為中書舍人，改正七品，尋又改從七品。

translations.literal: Year 9, they became Secretariat Drafters, rank changed to 7a; soon changed again to 7b.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 they were retitled secretariat drafters and raised to rank 7a, then soon reduced to rank 7b.

sentences.zh: 十年，與給事中皆隸承敕監。

translations.literal: Year 10, both they and the supervising secretaries were subordinated to the Imperial Decree Reception Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 both drafters and supervising secretaries were placed under the Imperial Decree Reception Directorate.

sentences.zh: 建文中，革中書舍人，改為侍書，升正七品，入文翰館，隸翰林院。

translations.literal: During the Jianwen reign, Secretariat Drafters were abolished and changed to Attendant Scribes, promoted to rank 7a, entered the Literary Drafting Hall, and were subordinated to the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jianwen reign secretariat drafters were abolished, retitled attendant scribes, promoted to rank 7a, placed in the Literary Drafting Hall, and subordinated to the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 成祖復舊制。

translations.literal: Chengzu restored the former system.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongle Emperor restored the former system.

sentences.zh: 尋設中書科署於午門外，定設中書舍人二十人。

translations.literal: Soon the Secretarial Drafters Bureau was established outside the Meridian Gate, with twenty Secretariat Drafters fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Secretarial Drafters Bureau was established outside the Meridian Gate with a fixed staff of twenty drafters.

sentences.zh: 其恩廕帶俸者，不在額內。

translations.literal: Those appointed by hereditary grace drawing salary were outside the quota.
translations.idiomatic: Hereditary grace appointees drawing salary were outside the fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 宣德間，內閣置誥敕、制敕兩房，皆設中書舍人。

translations.literal: During the Xuande reign, the Grand Secretariat established Commission Drafting and Decree Drafting offices, each with Secretariat Drafters.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xuande reign the Grand Secretariat established commission drafting and decree drafting offices, each staffed with secretariat drafters.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十年，選各部主事，大理寺評事，帶原銜直誥敕、制敕兩房。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 20, section directors from each ministry and reviewing secretaries from the Court of Judicial Review were selected, retaining their original titles while serving in the Commission Drafting and Decree Drafting offices.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 20 section directors from the ministries and reviewing secretaries from the Court of Judicial Review were selected to serve in the commission and decree drafting offices while retaining their original ranks.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，兩房員缺，令吏部考選舉人為中書舍人。

translations.literal: Year 44, when both offices had vacancies, the Ministry of Personnel was ordered to select presented scholars as Secretariat Drafters.
translations.idiomatic: In year 44, when both offices had vacancies, the Ministry of Personnel was ordered to appoint presented scholars as secretariat drafters.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年，令兩房辦事官不得升列九卿。

translations.literal: Longqing year 1, it was ordered that processing officers of the two offices could not be promoted to the Nine Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In Longqing 1 it was decreed that processing officers in the two offices could not be promoted to the Nine Ministers.

sentences.zh: 按洪武間，置承敕監、洪武九年置，設令一人，正六品，丞二人，從六品。

translations.literal: Note: in the Hongwu period the Imperial Decree Reception Directorate was established in Hongwu year 9, with one Director at rank 6a and two Vice Directors at rank 6b.
translations.idiomatic: During Hongwu the Imperial Decree Reception Directorate was established in year 9 with one director at rank 6a and two vice directors at rank 6b.

sentences.zh: 尋改令正七品，丞正八品。

translations.literal: Soon the Director was changed to rank 7a and Vice Directors to rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the director was reduced to rank 7a and the vice directors to rank 8a.

sentences.zh: 十年改令、丞為承敕郎，設二人，從七品。

translations.literal: Year 10 the Director and Vice Directors were changed to Imperial Decree Reception Officers; two were appointed at rank 7b.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 the director and vice directors were retitled imperial decree reception officers; two posts were established at rank 7b.

sentences.zh: 給事中、中書舍人鹹隸焉。

translations.literal: Supervising secretaries and Secretariat Drafters were all subordinated to it.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising secretaries and secretariat drafters were all placed under it.

sentences.zh: 後罷。

translations.literal: Later it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: It was later abolished.

sentences.zh: 司文監、洪武九年置，設令一人，正六品，丞二人，從六品。

translations.literal: The Documentary Directorate, established in Hongwu year 9, had one Director at rank 6a and two Vice Directors at rank 6b.
translations.idiomatic: The Documentary Directorate, established in Hongwu year 9, had one director at rank 6a and two vice directors at rank 6b.

sentences.zh: 尋改令正七品，丞正八品。

translations.literal: Soon the Director was changed to rank 7a and Vice Directors to rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the director was reduced to rank 7a and the vice directors to rank 8a.

sentences.zh: 十年罷。

translations.literal: Year 10 it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in year 10.

sentences.zh: 考功監，洪武八年置，設令、丞。

translations.literal: The Merit Evaluation Directorate, established in Hongwu year 8, had a Director and Vice Directors.
translations.idiomatic: The Merit Evaluation Directorate, established in Hongwu year 8, had a director and vice directors.

sentences.zh: 九年定設令一人，正六品，丞二人，從六品。

translations.literal: Year 9 it was fixed at one Director at rank 6a and two Vice Directors at rank 6b.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 it was fixed at one director at rank 6a and two vice directors at rank 6b.

sentences.zh: 尋改令正七品，丞正八品。

translations.literal: Soon the Director was changed to rank 7a and Vice Directors to rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the director was reduced to rank 7a and the vice directors to rank 8a.

sentences.zh: 十八年罷。

translations.literal: Year 18 it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in year 18.

sentences.zh: 參掌給授誥敕之事。

translations.literal: It jointly managed the issuance of patent letters.
translations.idiomatic: It jointly managed the issuance of patent letters.

sentences.zh: 永樂初，命內閣學士典機務，詔冊、制誥皆屬之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yongle reign, Grand Secretariat academicians were ordered to manage state affairs; proclamations, investiture documents, and patent letters all belonged to them.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yongle reign Grand Secretariat academicians were charged with managing state affairs; proclamations, investiture documents, and patent letters all fell under their authority.

sentences.zh: 而謄副、繕正皆中書舍人入辦，事竣輒出。

translations.literal: But fair copies and fair transcription were all handled by Secretariat Drafters entering to process; when the task was finished they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Fair copies and transcription, however, were handled by secretariat drafters who entered to process documents and withdrew when the work was done.

sentences.zh: 宣德初，始選能書者處於閣之西小房，謂之西制敕房。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Xuande reign, skilled calligraphers were first selected and placed in a small room west of the pavilion, called the West Decree Drafting Office.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xuande reign skilled calligraphers were first selected for a small room west of the pavilion, called the West Decree Drafting Office.

sentences.zh: 而諸學士掌誥敕者居閣東，具稿付中書繕進，謂之東誥敕房。

translations.literal: Academicians in charge of patent letters stayed east in the pavilion; they prepared drafts and handed them to the secretariat for transcription and submission—called the East Commission Drafting Office.
translations.idiomatic: Academicians in charge of patent letters remained in the east pavilion, prepared drafts, and handed them to the secretariat for transcription and submission—the East Commission Drafting Office.

sentences.zh: 此係辦事。

translations.literal: This concerned handling affairs.
translations.idiomatic: This concerned administrative duty.

sentences.zh: 若知制誥銜，惟大學士與諸學士可帶。

translations.literal: As for the title Associate in Decree Drafting, only Grand Secretaries and academicians could hold it.
translations.idiomatic: Only grand secretaries and academicians could hold the title Associate in Decree Drafting.

sentences.zh: 正統後，學士不能視誥敕，內閣悉委於中書、序班、譯字等官，於是內閣又有東誥敕房。

translations.literal: After the Zhengtong reign, academicians could no longer oversee patent letters; the Grand Secretariat wholly delegated the work to secretariat drafters, marshals, transliteration officers, and the like, and so the Grand Secretariat again had an East Commission Drafting Office.
translations.idiomatic: After the Zhengtong reign academicians no longer oversaw patent letters; the Grand Secretariat delegated the work entirely to secretariat drafters, marshals, and transliteration officers, and the East Commission Drafting Office was reestablished within the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 因劉鉉不與輔臣會食始。

translations.literal: This began when Liu Xuan did not join the principal ministers at meals.
translations.idiomatic: The change began when Liu Xuan stopped dining with the chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖末，復以翰林史官掌外製，而武官誥敕仍自其屬為之。

translations.literal: At the end of the Jiajing reign, Hanlin historiographers again managed external drafts, while military patent letters remained handled by their subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Jiajing reign Hanlin historiographers again managed external drafts, while military patent letters continued to be handled by their subordinates.

sentences.zh: 若詔赦、敕革之類，必由閣臣，翰林諸臣不得預。

translations.literal: Proclamations of amnesty, decree revisions, and the like had to go through cabinet ministers; Hanlin officials could not participate.
translations.idiomatic: Proclamations of amnesty, decree revisions, and similar documents had to pass through cabinet ministers; Hanlin officials were excluded.

sentences.zh: 其直文華、武英兩殿供御筆劄者，初為內官職，繼以中書分直，後亦專舉能書者。

translations.literal: Those assigned to the Halls of Literary Glory and Military Eminence to supply imperial brush notes were at first inner eunuch posts, then secretariat drafters in rotation, and later specifically skilled calligraphers.
translations.idiomatic: Drafters assigned to the Halls of Literary Glory and Military Eminence to supply imperial brush notes were at first inner eunuch posts, then secretariat drafters on rotation, and later specially selected skilled calligraphers.

sentences.zh: 大約舍人有兩途，由進士部選者，得遷科道部屬，其直兩殿、兩房舍人，不必由部選，自甲科、監生、生儒、布衣能書者，俱可為之。

translations.literal: Broadly speaking, drafters had two paths: those selected through the Ministry of Personnel from jinshi could transfer to the censorate or the ministries; drafters assigned to the two halls and two offices did not need ministry selection—jinshi, students, scholars, and commoners skilled in writing could all serve.
translations.idiomatic: Drafters generally followed two paths: those selected through the Ministry of Personnel from among jinshi could transfer to the censorate or the ministries; drafters in the two halls and two offices did not require ministry selection—jinshi, students, scholars, and commoners skilled in writing could all serve.

sentences.zh: 不由科甲者，初授序班，及試中書舍人，不得遷科道部屬，後雖加銜九列，仍帶銜辦事。

translations.literal: Those not from the civil examination: at first appointed marshals; after passing the secretariat drafter examination they could not transfer to the censorate or ministries; even if later given rank-9 titles, they still served with nominal titles.
translations.idiomatic: Those not from the civil examination were first appointed marshals; after passing the secretariat drafter examination they could not transfer to the censorate or ministries; even when later given rank-9 titles, they still served with nominal ranks.

sentences.zh: 楷書出身者，或加太常卿銜，沈度、沈粲、潘辰等有加至翰林學士、禮部尚書者。

translations.literal: Those from regular-script calligraphy backgrounds could receive the title Vice Director of Imperial Sacrifices; Shen Du, Shen Can, Pan Chen, and others rose as far as Hanlin academicians and Ministers of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Calligraphers from regular-script backgrounds could receive the title Vice Director of Imperial Sacrifices; Shen Du, Shen Can, Pan Chen, and others rose as high as Hanlin academicians and Ministers of Rites.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，又有承天門待詔一人，閣門使四人，觀察使十人，後俱革。

translations.literal: Early in the Hongwu reign there were also one edict-awaiter at the Gate of Accepting Heaven, four gate commissioners, and ten observation commissioners—all later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Hongwu reign there were also one edict-awaiter at the Gate of Accepting Heaven, four gate commissioners, and ten observation commissioners—all later abolished.

sentences.zh: 行人司。

translations.literal: The Reception Office.
translations.idiomatic: The Reception Office.

sentences.zh: 司正一人，正七品左、右司副各一人，從七品行人三十七人。

translations.literal: One Director at rank 7a; one Left and one Right Vice Director each at rank 7b; thirty-seven reception attendants.
translations.idiomatic: One director at rank 7a; one left and one right vice director each at rank 7b; and thirty-seven reception attendants.

sentences.zh: 正八品職專捧節、奉使之事。

translations.literal: At rank 8a, its duty was specialized in holding credentials and embassy affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At rank 8a its duty was specialized in holding credentials and conducting embassies.

sentences.zh: 凡頒行詔赦，冊封宗室，撫諭諸蕃，徵聘賢才，與夫賞賜、慰問、賑濟、軍旅、祭祀，鹹敘差焉。

translations.literal: For issuing amnesty proclamations, investiture of imperial clansmen, pacification of foreign peoples, recruitment of talent, and also rewards, condolences, relief, military affairs, and sacrifices—all were dispatched in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Issuing amnesty proclamations, investing imperial clansmen, pacifying foreign peoples, recruiting talent, and also rewards, condolences, relief, military affairs, and sacrifices—all were assigned in turn.

sentences.zh: 每歲朝審，則行人持節傳旨法司，遣戍囚徒，送五府填精微冊，批繳內府。

translations.literal: Each year at the judicial review, reception attendants held credentials to transmit edicts to the judicial offices, dispatch convicts to frontier service, send them to the Five Chief Military Commissions to fill detailed registers, and return the batch to the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: Each year at the judicial review reception attendants held credentials to transmit edicts to the judicial offices, dispatch convicts to frontier service, send them to the Five Chief Military Commissions to fill detailed registers, and return the batch to the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 初，洪武十三年置行人司，設行人，秩正九品。

translations.literal: Initially, in Hongwu year 13 the Reception Office was established with reception attendants at rank 9a.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, in Hongwu year 13 the Reception Office was established with reception attendants at rank 9a.

sentences.zh: 左、右行人，從九品。

translations.literal: Left and Right Reception Attendants at rank 9b.
translations.idiomatic: Left and right reception attendants at rank 9b.

sentences.zh: 尋改行人為司正，左、右行人為左、右司副，更設行人三百四十五人。

translations.literal: Soon the attendants were renamed Director, the Left and Right attendants became Left and Right Vice Directors, and three hundred forty-five attendants were added.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the attendants were renamed director, the left and right attendants became left and right vice directors, and three hundred forty-five attendants were added.

sentences.zh: 二十七年升品秩，以所任行人多孝廉人材，奉使率不稱旨，定設行人司官四十員，咸以進士為之。

translations.literal: In year 27 ranks were raised; because the attendants appointed were mostly filial and pure talent, embassies often failed to satisfy imperial intent, and the office was fixed at forty posts, all filled by jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: In year 27 ranks were raised; because most appointees were filial and pure talent whose embassies often failed to satisfy imperial intent, the office was fixed at forty posts, all filled by jinshi.

sentences.zh: 非奉旨，不得擅遣，行人之職始重。

translations.literal: Without an imperial order they could not be dispatched at will, and the attendant's duty became weighty.
translations.idiomatic: Without an imperial order they could not be dispatched at will, and the reception attendant's duty gained real weight.

sentences.zh: 建文中，罷行人司，而以行人隸鴻臚寺。

translations.literal: In the Jianwen era the Reception Office was abolished and the attendants were subordinated to the Court of State Ceremonial.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jianwen era the Reception Office was abolished and the attendants were placed under the Court of State Ceremonial.

sentences.zh: 成祖復舊制。

translations.literal: Chengzu restored the old system.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzu restored the old system.

sentences.zh: 欽天監。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Astronomy.

sentences.zh: 監正一人，正五品監副二人。

translations.literal: One Superintendent at rank 5a and two Vice Superintendents at rank 6a.
translations.idiomatic: One superintendent at rank 5a and two vice superintendents at rank 6a.

sentences.zh: 正六品其屬，主簿廳，主簿一人，正八品春、夏、中、秋、冬官正各一人，正六品五官靈臺郎八人，從七品，後革四人。

translations.literal: Its subordinates: in the Registrar Office, one Registrar at rank 8a; one Director each for Spring, Summer, Intercalary, Autumn, and Winter at rank 6a; eight Clerks of the Spirit Platform at rank 7b, later reduced by four.
translations.idiomatic: Its subordinates included the Registrar Office with one registrar at rank 8a; one director each for Spring, Summer, Intercalary, Autumn, and Winter at rank 6a; and eight Clerks of the Spirit Platform at rank 7b, later reduced by four.

sentences.zh: 五官保章正二人，正八品，後革一人。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Preservation and Registers at rank 8a, later reduced by one.
translations.idiomatic: Two Directors of Preservation and Registers at rank 8a, later reduced by one.

sentences.zh: 五官挈壺正二人，從八品，後革一人。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Water-Clock Regulation at rank 8b, later reduced by one.
translations.idiomatic: Two Directors of Water-Clock Regulation at rank 8b, later reduced by one.

sentences.zh: 五官監候三人，正九品，後革一人。

translations.literal: Three Astral Observers at rank 9a, later reduced by one.
translations.idiomatic: Three Astral Observers at rank 9a, later reduced by one.

sentences.zh: 五官司曆二人，正九品五官司晨八人，從九品，後革六人。

translations.literal: Two Calendar Clerks at rank 9a; eight Dawn Announcers at rank 9b, later reduced by six.
translations.idiomatic: Two Calendar Clerks at rank 9a; eight Dawn Announcers at rank 9b, later reduced by six.

sentences.zh: 漏刻博士六人。

translations.literal: Six Water-Clock Doctors.
translations.idiomatic: Six Water-Clock Doctors.

sentences.zh: 從九品，後革五人。

translations.literal: At rank 9b, later reduced by five.
translations.idiomatic: At rank 9b, later reduced by five.

sentences.zh: 監正、副，掌察天文、定歷數、占候、推步之事。

translations.literal: The Superintendent and Vice Superintendents managed observing astronomy, fixing calendrical numbers, divination observation, and computational ephemerides.
translations.idiomatic: The superintendent and vice superintendents managed observing astronomy, fixing calendrical numbers, divination observation, and computational ephemerides.

sentences.zh: 凡日月、星辰、風雲、氣色，率其屬而測候焉。

translations.literal: For sun, moon, stars, wind, clouds, and atmospheric colors, they led their subordinates in observation.
translations.idiomatic: For the sun, moon, stars, wind, clouds, and atmospheric colors they led their subordinates in observation.

sentences.zh: 有變異，密疏以聞。

translations.literal: When there were anomalies, they reported them in secret memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Anomalies were reported in secret memorials.

sentences.zh: 凡習業分四科：曰天文，曰漏刻，曰回回，曰曆。

translations.literal: Training was divided into four specialties: astronomy, water-clocks, Islamic astronomy, and calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Training was divided into four specialties: astronomy, water-clocks, Islamic astronomy, and calendar.

sentences.zh: 自五官正下至天文生、陰陽人，各分科肄業。

translations.literal: From the Five Directors down to astronomy students and yin-yang practitioners, each trained in a separate specialty.
translations.idiomatic: From the Five Directors down to astronomy students and yin-yang practitioners, each trained in a separate specialty.

sentences.zh: 每歲冬至日，呈奏明歲《大統曆》，成化十五年改頒明歲曆於十月朔日。

translations.literal: Each year on the winter solstice they memorialized the next year's 《Great Unity Calendar》; in Chenghua year 15 issuance of the next year's calendar was moved to the first day of the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: Each year on the winter solstice they memorialized the next year's 《Great Unity Calendar》; in Chenghua year 15 issuance of the next year's calendar was moved to the first day of the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 移送禮部頒行。

translations.literal: It was transferred to the Ministry of Rites for promulgation.
translations.idiomatic: It was transferred to the Ministry of Rites for promulgation.

sentences.zh: 其《御覽月令曆》、《七政躔度曆》、《六壬遁甲曆》、《四季天象錄》，並先期進呈。

translations.literal: The 《Imperial Monthly Order Calendar》, 《Seven Luminaries Ephemeris Calendar》, 《Six Ren Hidden Stem Calendar》, and 《Four Seasons Celestial Phenomena Record》 were all submitted in advance.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Imperial Monthly Order Calendar》, 《Seven Luminaries Ephemeris Calendar》, 《Six Ren Hidden Stem Calendar》, and 《Four Seasons Celestial Phenomena Record》 were all submitted in advance.

sentences.zh: 凡曆注，禦曆注三十事，如祭祀、頒詔、行幸等類。

translations.literal: For calendar annotations: thirty imperial matters, such as sacrifices, proclamations, and imperial tours.
translations.idiomatic: Calendar annotations included thirty imperial matters, such as sacrifices, proclamations, and imperial tours.

sentences.zh: 民曆三十二事，壬遁曆七十二事。

translations.literal: Thirty-two common calendar matters and seventy-two Ren Dun calendar matters.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-two common calendar matters and seventy-two Ren Dun calendar matters.

sentences.zh: 凡祭日，前一年會選以進，移知太常。

translations.literal: For sacrificial dates, selections were made jointly in the previous year and forwarded to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial dates were selected jointly in the previous year and forwarded to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 凡營建、徵討、冠婚、山陵之事，則選地而擇日。

translations.literal: For construction, punitive campaigns, capping and marriage, and imperial tombs, they selected sites and chose days.
translations.idiomatic: For construction, punitive campaigns, capping and marriage, and imperial tombs they selected sites and chose days.

sentences.zh: 立春，則預候氣於東郊。

translations.literal: At Start of Spring they presaged the qi at the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: At Start of Spring they presaged the qi at the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 大朝賀，於文樓設定時鼓、漏刻報時，司晨、雞唱，各供其事。

translations.literal: At great court congratulations they set timing drums and water-clock time at the Literary Tower; Dawn Announcers and cock-crow each performed their duties.
translations.idiomatic: At great court congratulations they set timing drums and water-clock time at the Literary Tower; Dawn Announcers and cock-crow each performed their duties.

sentences.zh: 日月交食，先期算其分秒時刻、起復方位以聞，下禮部，移內外諸司救之，仍按佔書條奏。

translations.literal: For solar and lunar eclipses they calculated in advance the degrees, seconds, timing, and orientation of onset and recovery and reported them; the Ministry of Rites was notified, all offices inside and outside were instructed to perform rescue rites, and memorials were submitted according to prognostication texts.
translations.idiomatic: For solar and lunar eclipses they calculated in advance the degrees, seconds, timing, and orientation of onset and recovery and reported them; the Ministry of Rites was notified, all offices inside and outside were instructed to perform rescue rites, and memorials were submitted according to prognostication texts.

sentences.zh: 若食不及一分，與《回回曆》雖食一分以上，則奏而不救。

translations.literal: If the eclipse was less than one degree, or if the 《Islamic Calendar》 showed an eclipse of more than one degree, they memorialized without ordering rescue rites.
translations.idiomatic: If the eclipse was less than one degree, or if the 《Islamic Calendar》 showed an eclipse of more than one degree, they memorialized without ordering rescue rites.

sentences.zh: 監官毋得改他官，子孫毋得徙他業。

translations.literal: Directorate officials could not transfer to other posts, and their descendants could not change professions.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate officials could not transfer to other posts, and their descendants could not change professions.

sentences.zh: 乏人，則移禮部訪取而試用焉。

translations.literal: When personnel were lacking, the Ministry of Rites was asked to recruit candidates for trial appointment.
translations.idiomatic: When personnel were lacking, the Ministry of Rites was asked to recruit candidates for trial appointment.

sentences.zh: 五官正推曆法，定四時。

translations.literal: The Five Directors computed calendar methods and fixed the four seasons.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Directors computed calendar methods and fixed the four seasons.

sentences.zh: 司曆、監候佐之。

translations.literal: Calendar Clerks and Observers assisted them.
translations.idiomatic: Calendar Clerks and Observers assisted them.

sentences.zh: 靈臺郎辨日月星辰之躔次、分野，以占候天文之變。

translations.literal: Clerks of the Spirit Platform distinguished the positions and territorial correspondences of the sun, moon, and stars to observe celestial changes.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks of the Spirit Platform distinguished the positions and territorial correspondences of the sun, moon, and stars to observe celestial changes.

sentences.zh: 觀象臺四面，面四天文生，輪司測候。

translations.literal: The Observatory had four sides; on each side four astronomy students rotated in observation duty.
translations.idiomatic: The Observatory had four sides; on each side four astronomy students rotated in observation duty.

sentences.zh: 保章正專志天文之變，定其吉凶之佔。

translations.literal: Directors of Preservation and Registers specialized in celestial changes and fixed auspicious and inauspicious prognostications.
translations.idiomatic: Directors of Preservation and Registers specialized in celestial changes and fixed auspicious and inauspicious prognostications.

sentences.zh: 挈壺正知刻漏。

translations.literal: Directors of Water-Clock Regulation managed the clepsydra.
translations.idiomatic: Directors of Water-Clock Regulation managed the clepsydra.

sentences.zh: 孔壺為漏，浮箭為刻，以考中星昏旦之次。

translations.literal: A bronze vessel served as the clepsydra and a floating marker as the marks, to verify meridian stars and the sequence of dawn and dusk.
translations.idiomatic: A bronze vessel served as the clepsydra and a floating marker as the marks, to verify meridian stars and the sequence of dawn and dusk.

sentences.zh: 漏刻博士定時以漏，換時以牌，報更以鼓，警晨昏以鐘鼓。

translations.literal: Water-Clock Doctors fixed time by clepsydra, changed time by placard, announced watches by drum, and warned dawn and dusk by bells and drums.
translations.idiomatic: Water-Clock Doctors fixed time by clepsydra, changed time by placard, announced watches by drum, and warned dawn and dusk by bells and drums.

sentences.zh: 司晨佐之。

translations.literal: Dawn Announcers assisted them.
translations.idiomatic: Dawn Announcers assisted them.

sentences.zh: 明初，即置太史監，設太史令，通判太史監事，僉判太史監事，校事郎，五官正，靈臺郎，保章正、副，挈壺正，掌曆，管勾等官。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Ming, the Grand Astrologer Directorate was established with a Grand Astrologer, Associate Director of the Grand Astrologer Directorate, Vice Associate Director, Verification Clerk, Five Directors, Clerks of the Spirit Platform, Directors of Preservation and Registers and their deputies, Directors of Water-Clock Regulation, Calendar Manager, Administrator, and other officials.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Ming the Grand Astrologer Directorate was established with a Grand Astrologer, associate and vice associate directors, verification clerk, Five Directors, Clerks of the Spirit Platform, Directors of Preservation and Registers and their deputies, Directors of Water-Clock Regulation, calendar manager, administrator, and other officials.

sentences.zh: 以劉基為太史令。

translations.literal: Liu Ji was appointed Grand Astrologer.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ji was appointed Grand Astrologer.

sentences.zh: 吳元年，改監為院，秩正三品。

translations.literal: In the Wu era year the directorate was changed to a court at rank 3a.
translations.idiomatic: In the Wu era year the directorate was changed to a court at rank 3a.

sentences.zh: 院使，正三品，同知，正四品，院判，正五品，五官正，正六品，典簿、雨暘司、時敘郎、紀候郎，正七品，靈臺郎、保章正，正八品，副，從八品，掌曆、管勾，從九品。

translations.literal: Court Director at rank 3a; Associate at rank 4a; Vice Director at rank 5a; Five Directors at rank 6a; Clerk of Records, Rain and Sun Bureau, Season Recorder, and Calendar Observer at rank 7a; Clerks of the Spirit Platform and Directors of Preservation and Registers at rank 8a; deputies at rank 8b; Calendar Manager and Administrator at rank 9b.
translations.idiomatic: Court Director at rank 3a; Associate at rank 4a; Vice Director at rank 5a; Five Directors at rank 6a; Clerk of Records, Rain and Sun Bureau, Season Recorder, and Calendar Observer at rank 7a; Clerks of the Spirit Platform and Directors of Preservation and Registers at rank 8a; deputies at rank 8b; Calendar Manager and Administrator at rank 9b.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，徵元太史張佑、張沂等十四人，改太史院為司天監，設監令一人，正三品少監二人，正四品監丞一人，正六品主簿一人，正七品主事一人，正八品五官正五人，正五品五官副五人，正六品靈臺郎二人，正七品保章正二人，從七品監候三人，正八品司辰八人，正九品漏刻博士六人。

translations.literal: In Hongwu 1, fourteen Yuan grand astrologers including Zhang You and Zhang Yi were recruited; the Grand Astrologer Court was changed to the Directorate of Heavenly Observation, with one Superintendent at rank 3a, two Vice Superintendents at rank 4a, one Assistant Superintendent at rank 6a, one Registrar at rank 7a, one Clerk at rank 8a, five Five Directors at rank 5a, five Five Vice Directors at rank 6a, two Clerks of the Spirit Platform at rank 7a, two Directors of Preservation and Registers at rank 7b, three Observers at rank 8a, eight Dawn Clerks at rank 9a, and six Water-Clock Doctors at rank 9b.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1 fourteen Yuan grand astrologers including Zhang You and Zhang Yi were recruited; the Grand Astrologer Court became the Directorate of Heavenly Observation, with one superintendent at rank 3a, two vice superintendents at rank 4a, one assistant superintendent at rank 6a, one registrar at rank 7a, one clerk at rank 8a, five Five Directors at rank 5a, five Five Vice Directors at rank 6a, two Clerks of the Spirit Platform at rank 7a, two Directors of Preservation and Registers at rank 7b, three Observers at rank 8a, eight Dawn Clerks at rank 9a, and six Water-Clock Doctors at rank 9b.

sentences.zh: 從九品又置回回司天監，設監令一人，正四品少監二人，正五品監丞二人。

translations.literal: At rank 9b. Also the Islamic Directorate of Heavenly Observation was established, with one Superintendent at rank 4a, two Vice Superintendents at rank 5a, and two Assistant Superintendents at rank 6a.
translations.idiomatic: At rank 9b. An Islamic Directorate of Heavenly Observation was also established, with one superintendent at rank 4a, two vice superintendents at rank 5a, and two assistant superintendents at rank 6a.

sentences.zh: 正六品徵元回回司天監鄭阿裏等議曆。

translations.literal: At rank 6a Zheng Ali and others of the Yuan Islamic Directorate of Heavenly Observation were recruited to discuss the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: At rank 6a Zheng Ali and others of the Yuan Islamic Directorate of Heavenly Observation were recruited to discuss the calendar.

sentences.zh: 三年，改司天監為欽天監。

translations.literal: In year 3 the Directorate of Heavenly Observation was renamed the Directorate of Astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 the Directorate of Heavenly Observation was renamed the Directorate of Astronomy.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔監官職專司天，非特旨不得升調。

translations.literal: In year 4 an edict fixed directorate posts exclusively to heavenly observation; without a special order there could be no promotion or transfer.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 an edict fixed directorate posts exclusively to heavenly observation; without a special order there could be no promotion or transfer.

sentences.zh: 又定監官散官。

translations.literal: Honorary titles for directorate officials were also fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Honorary titles for directorate officials were also fixed.

sentences.zh: 監令，正儀大夫；

translations.literal: Superintendent: Correct Ritual Grandee;
translations.idiomatic: Superintendent: Correct Ritual Grandee;

sentences.zh: 少監，分朔大夫；

translations.literal: Vice Superintendent: Divided New-Moon Grandee;
translations.idiomatic: Vice Superintendent: Divided New-Moon Grandee;

sentences.zh: 五官司，司玄大夫；

translations.literal: Five Directors Clerk: Dark Mystery Grandee;
translations.idiomatic: Five Directors Clerk: Dark Mystery Grandee;

sentences.zh: 監丞，靈臺郎；

translations.literal: Assistant Superintendent: Spirit Platform Gentleman;
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Superintendent: Spirit Platform Gentleman;

sentences.zh: 五官保章正，平秩郎；

translations.literal: Director of Preservation and Registers: Balanced Order Gentleman;
translations.idiomatic: Director of Preservation and Registers: Balanced Order Gentleman;

sentences.zh: 五官靈臺郎，司正郎；

translations.literal: Clerk of the Spirit Platform: Correct Order Gentleman;
translations.idiomatic: Clerk of the Spirit Platform: Correct Order Gentleman;

sentences.zh: 五官挈壺正，挈壺郎。

translations.literal: Director of Water-Clock Regulation: Water-Clock Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Water-Clock Regulation: Water-Clock Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 十四年，改欽天監為正五品，設令一人，丞一人，屬官五官正以下，員數如前所列。

translations.literal: In year 14 the Directorate of Astronomy was changed to rank 5a, with one Director and one Vice Director; subordinate officials from the Five Directors down remained as previously listed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 the Directorate of Astronomy was changed to rank 5a, with one director and one vice director; subordinate officials from the Five Directors down remained as previously listed.

sentences.zh: 俱從品級授以文職散官。

translations.literal: All were given civil honorary titles according to their rank grades.
translations.idiomatic: All were given civil honorary titles according to their rank grades.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，改令為監正，丞為監副。

translations.literal: In year 22 Director was changed to Superintendent and Vice Director to Vice Superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22 director was changed to superintendent and vice director to vice superintendent.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，罷回回欽天監，以其曆法隸本監。

translations.literal: In year 31 the Islamic Directorate of Astronomy was abolished and its calendar methods were subordinated to the main directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In year 31 the Islamic Directorate of Astronomy was abolished and its calendar methods were subordinated to the main directorate.

sentences.zh: 明初，又置稽疑司，以掌卜筮，未幾罷。

translations.literal: Early in the Ming a Directorate of Oracle Verification was also established to manage divination; it was soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Ming a Directorate of Oracle Verification was also established to manage divination; it was soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 洪武十七年，置稽疑司，設司令一人，正六品，左、右丞各一人，從六品，屬官司筮，正九品，無定員。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 17 the Directorate of Oracle Verification was established, with one Commander at rank 6a, one Left and one Right Vice Commander each at rank 6b, and subordinate Divination Clerks at rank 9a with no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 17 the Directorate of Oracle Verification was established, with one commander at rank 6a, one left and one right vice commander each at rank 6b, and subordinate Divination Clerks at rank 9a with no fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 尋罷。

translations.literal: It was soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: It was soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 太醫院。

translations.literal: The Imperial Medical Institute.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Medical Institute.

sentences.zh: 院使一人，正五品院判二人。

translations.literal: One Superintendent at rank 5a and two Vice Superintendents at rank 6a.
translations.idiomatic: One superintendent at rank 5a and two vice superintendents at rank 6a.

sentences.zh: 正六品其屬，御醫四人，正八品，後增至十八人，隆慶五年定設十人。

translations.literal: Its subordinates included four Imperial Physicians at rank 8a, later increased to eighteen; in Longqing year 5 the quota was fixed at ten.
translations.idiomatic: Its subordinates included four Imperial Physicians at rank 8a, later increased to eighteen; in Longqing year 5 the quota was fixed at ten.

sentences.zh: 生藥庫、惠民藥局，各大使一人，副使一人。

translations.literal: The Raw Medicine Depot and the Public Pharmacy Bureau each had one Ambassador and one Vice Ambassador.
translations.idiomatic: The Raw Medicine Depot and the Public Pharmacy Bureau each had one ambassador and one vice ambassador.

sentences.zh: 太醫院掌醫療之法。

translations.literal: The Imperial Medical Institute managed medical methods.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Medical Institute managed medical methods.

sentences.zh: 凡醫術十三科，醫官、醫生、醫士，專科肄業：曰大方脈，曰小方脈，曰婦人，曰瘡瘍，曰針灸，曰眼，曰口齒，曰接骨，曰傷寒，曰咽喉，曰金鏃，曰按摩，曰祝由。

translations.literal: There were thirteen medical specialties; medical officers, students, and practitioners each trained in one specialty: Great Internal Medicine, Minor Internal Medicine, Gynecology, Sores and Ulcers, Acupuncture and Moxibustion, Ophthalmology, Dentistry, Bone-Setting, Cold Damage, Throat, Metal Arrow Wounds, Massage, and Incantation.
translations.idiomatic: There were thirteen medical specialties; medical officers, students, and practitioners each trained in one specialty: Great Internal Medicine, Minor Internal Medicine, Gynecology, Sores and Ulcers, Acupuncture and Moxibustion, Ophthalmology, Dentistry, Bone-Setting, Cold Damage, Throat, Metal Arrow Wounds, Massage, and Incantation.

sentences.zh: 凡醫家子弟，擇師而教之。

translations.literal: For medical families, teachers were chosen to instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: Medical families chose teachers to instruct their members.

sentences.zh: 三年、五年一試、再試、三試，乃黜陟之。

translations.literal: Every three or five years there was a first, second, and third examination before promotion or demotion.
translations.idiomatic: Every three or five years there was a first, second, and third examination before promotion or demotion.

sentences.zh: 凡藥，辨其土宜，擇其良楛，慎其條制而用之。

translations.literal: For medicines, they identified soil suitability, selected quality, and carefully prepared prescriptions before use.
translations.idiomatic: For medicines they identified soil suitability, selected quality, and carefully prepared prescriptions before use.

sentences.zh: 四方解納藥品，院官收貯生藥庫，時其燥濕，禮部委官一員稽察之。

translations.literal: Medicines presented from the four directions were received by institute officials and stored in the Raw Medicine Depot; dryness and moisture were timed, and the Ministry of Rites assigned one official to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: Medicines presented from the four directions were received by institute officials and stored in the Raw Medicine Depot; dryness and moisture were monitored, and the Ministry of Rites assigned one official to inspect.

sentences.zh: 診視禦脈，使、判、御醫參看校同，會內臣就內局選藥，連名封記藥劑，具本開寫藥性、證治之法以奏。

translations.literal: For imperial pulse diagnosis the Superintendent, Vice Superintendents, and Imperial Physicians jointly examined and verified; they met inner eunuchs at the inner pharmacy to select drugs, jointly sealed the prescriptions, and memorialized with drug properties and treatment methods.
translations.idiomatic: For imperial pulse diagnosis the superintendent, vice superintendents, and Imperial Physicians jointly examined and verified; they met inner eunuchs at the inner pharmacy to select drugs, jointly sealed the prescriptions, and memorialized with drug properties and treatment methods.

sentences.zh: 烹調禦藥，院官與內臣監視。

translations.literal: In preparing imperial medicine, institute officials and inner eunuchs supervised.
translations.idiomatic: In preparing imperial medicine institute officials and inner eunuchs supervised.

sentences.zh: 每二劑合為一，候熟，分二器，一御醫、內臣先嘗，一進禦。

translations.literal: Every two doses were combined into one; when cooked they were divided into two vessels—one tasted first by an Imperial Physician and an inner eunuch, one presented to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Every two doses were combined into one; when cooked they were divided into two vessels—one tasted first by an Imperial Physician and an inner eunuch, one presented to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 仍置曆簿，用內印鈐記，細載年月緣由，以憑考察。

translations.literal: A register book was kept, stamped with the inner seal, recording in detail the year, month, and circumstances for inspection.
translations.idiomatic: A register book was kept, stamped with the inner seal, recording in detail the year, month, and circumstances for inspection.

sentences.zh: 王府請醫，本院奉旨遣官或醫士往。

translations.literal: When princely establishments requested physicians, the institute dispatched an official or practitioner by imperial order.
translations.idiomatic: When princely establishments requested physicians, the institute dispatched an official or practitioner by imperial order.

sentences.zh: 文武大臣及外國君長有疾，亦奉旨往視。

translations.literal: When civil and military ministers or foreign rulers fell ill, physicians were also dispatched by imperial order.
translations.idiomatic: When civil and military ministers or foreign rulers fell ill, physicians were also dispatched by imperial order.

sentences.zh: 其治療可否，皆具本覆奏。

translations.literal: Whether treatment succeeded was always reported in a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Whether treatment succeeded was always reported in a memorial.

sentences.zh: 外府州縣置惠民藥局。

translations.literal: In outer prefectures, departments, and counties Public Pharmacy Bureaus were established.
translations.idiomatic: Public Pharmacy Bureaus were established in outer prefectures, departments, and counties.

sentences.zh: 邊關衛所及人聚處，各設醫生、醫士或醫官，俱由本院試遣。

translations.literal: At frontier passes, guard posts, and places where people gathered, medical students, practitioners, or officers were each appointed—all tested and dispatched by the institute.
translations.idiomatic: At frontier passes, guard posts, and populated areas, medical students, practitioners, or officers were appointed as needed—all tested and dispatched by the institute.

sentences.zh: 歲終，會察其功過而殿最之，以憑黜陟。

translations.literal: At year's end their merits and faults were jointly reviewed and ranked for promotion or demotion.
translations.idiomatic: At year's end their merits and faults were jointly reviewed and ranked to guide promotion and demotion.

sentences.zh: 太祖初，置醫學提舉司，設提舉，從五品同提舉，從六品副提舉，從七品醫學教授，正九品學正、官醫、提領。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Taizu reign, the Medical Superintendency was established, with a Superintendent at rank 5b, an Associate Superintendent at rank 6b, a Deputy Superintendent at rank 7b, a Medical Instructor, and rank 9a Rectifiers, Official Physicians, and Directors.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Taizu reign, the Medical Superintendency was established, with a superintendent at rank 5b, an associate superintendent at rank 6b, a deputy superintendent at rank 7b, a medical instructor, and rank 9a rectifiers, official physicians, and directors.

sentences.zh: 從九品尋改為太醫監，設少監，正四品監丞。

translations.literal: At rank 9b; soon it was changed to the Imperial Medical Directorate, with a Vice Director at rank 4a and a Directorate Assistant.
translations.idiomatic: Those at rank 9b were soon superseded when the office became the Imperial Medical Directorate, with a vice director at rank 4a and a directorate assistant.

sentences.zh: 正六品吳元年，改監為院，設院使，秩正三品，同知，正四品，院判，正五品，典簿，正七品。

translations.literal: At rank 6a. In the Wu year period the directorate was changed to an institute, with a Superintendent at rank 3a, an Associate Superintendent at rank 4a, a Vice Superintendent at rank 5a, and a Registrar at rank 7a.
translations.idiomatic: The directorate assistant was at rank 6a. In the Wu year period the directorate became an institute, with a superintendent at rank 3a, an associate superintendent at rank 4a, a vice superintendent at rank 5a, and a registrar at rank 7a.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年，置惠民藥局，府設提領，州縣設官醫。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 3, Public Pharmacy Bureaus were established; prefectures had Directors and departments and counties had Official Physicians.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 3, Public Pharmacy Bureaus were established; prefectures had directors and departments and counties had official physicians.

sentences.zh: 凡軍民之貧病者，給之醫藥。

translations.literal: For soldiers and civilians who were poor and ill, medicine was provided.
translations.idiomatic: Poor and sick soldiers and civilians were given medicine.

sentences.zh: 六年，置禦藥局於內府，始設御醫。

translations.literal: In year 6, the Imperial Pharmacy Bureau was established in the inner palace, and Imperial Physicians were first appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6, the Imperial Pharmacy Bureau was established in the inner palace, and Imperial Physicians were first appointed.

sentences.zh: 御醫局，秩正六品，設尚藥、奉禦二人，直長二人，藥童十人，俱以內官、內使充之。

translations.literal: The Imperial Physicians Bureau, at rank 6a, had two Directors of Medicine and Imperial Attendants, two Duty Chiefs, and ten Medicine Pages—all filled by inner eunuchs and inner attendants.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Physicians Bureau, at rank 6a, had two Directors of Medicine and Imperial Attendants, two duty chiefs, and ten medicine pages—all filled by inner eunuchs and inner attendants.

sentences.zh: 設御醫四人，以太醫院醫士充之。

translations.literal: Four Imperial Physicians were appointed, drawn from practitioners of the Imperial Medical Institute.
translations.idiomatic: Four Imperial Physicians were appointed from among the institute's practitioners.

sentences.zh: 凡收受四方貢獻名藥及儲蓄藥品，奉禦一人掌之。

translations.literal: One Imperial Attendant managed receipt of famous medicines presented as tribute from the four directions and storage of pharmaceutical supplies.
translations.idiomatic: One Imperial Attendant managed receipt of famous tribute medicines from the four directions and storage of pharmaceutical supplies.

sentences.zh: 凡供禦藥餌，醫官就內局修制，太醫院官診視。

translations.literal: For imperial medicines, medical officers prepared them at the inner bureau while officials of the Imperial Medical Institute examined and diagnosed.
translations.idiomatic: For imperial medicines, medical officers prepared them at the inner bureau while institute officials examined and diagnosed.

sentences.zh: 十四年，改太醫院為正五品，設令一人，丞一人，吏目一人。
