translations.literal: In year 14, the Imperial Medical Institute was changed to rank 5a, with one Director, one Vice Director, and one Clerk.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14, the Imperial Medical Institute was raised to rank 5a, with one director, one vice director, and one clerk.

sentences.zh: 屬官御醫四人，俱如文職授散官。

translations.literal: Subordinate Imperial Physicians numbered four; all received honorary civil titles like civil officials.
translations.idiomatic: Four subordinate Imperial Physicians all received honorary civil titles like civil officials.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，復改令為院使，丞為院判。

translations.literal: In year 22, the Director was again changed to Superintendent and the Vice Director to Vice Superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22, the director was again renamed superintendent and the vice director vice superintendent.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十五年，改禦藥房為聖濟殿，又設禦藥庫，詔御醫輪直供事。

translations.literal: In Jiajing year 15, the Imperial Pharmacy was changed to the Hall of Sacred Succor, an Imperial Medicine Depot was also established, and Imperial Physicians were ordered to serve on rotating duty.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 15, the Imperial Pharmacy became the Hall of Sacred Succor, an Imperial Medicine Depot was also established, and Imperial Physicians were ordered to serve on rotating duty.

sentences.zh: 上林苑監。

translations.literal: The Directorate of the Imperial Parks.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of the Imperial Parks.

sentences.zh: 左、右監正各一人，正五品左、右監副各一人，正六品，監正、監副後不常設，以監丞署職。

translations.literal: Left and Right Directors, one each at rank 5a; Left and Right Vice Directors, one each at rank 6a. Directors and Vice Directors were later not regularly appointed, and Assistant Directors served in their stead.
translations.idiomatic: There was one left and one right director at rank 5a and one left and one right vice director at rank 6a. Directors and vice directors were later not regularly appointed, and assistant directors served in their stead.

sentences.zh: 左、右監丞各一人。

translations.literal: Left and Right Assistant Directors, one each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one left and one right assistant director.

sentences.zh: 正七品其屬，典簿廳，典簿一人。

translations.literal: At rank 7a. Its subordinates included the Registry Office, with one Registrar.
translations.idiomatic: At rank 7a. Its subordinates included the Registry Office, with one registrar.

sentences.zh: 正九品良牧、蕃育、林衡、嘉蔬四署，各典署一人，正七品署丞一人，正八品錄事一人。

translations.literal: The four offices of Fine Herds, Breeding, Forestry Balance, and Fine Vegetables each had one Office Director, one Deputy at rank 7a, and one Clerk at rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: The four offices of Fine Herds, Breeding, Forestry Balance, and Fine Vegetables each had one office director, one deputy at rank 7a, and one clerk at rank 8a.

sentences.zh: 正九品

translations.literal: Rank 9a.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 9a.

sentences.zh: 監正掌苑囿、園池、牧畜、樹種之事。

translations.literal: Directors managed parklands, gardens, ponds, livestock breeding, and planting.
translations.idiomatic: Directors managed parklands, gardens, ponds, livestock breeding, and planting.

sentences.zh: 凡禽獸、草木、蔬果，率其屬督其養戶、栽戶，以時經理其養地、栽地而畜植之，以供祭祀、賓客、宮府之膳羞。

translations.literal: For birds, beasts, plants, fruits, and vegetables, they led their subordinates to supervise keepers and planters, seasonally managing breeding and planting lands to raise and cultivate supplies for sacrifices, guests, and palace provisions.
translations.idiomatic: For birds, beasts, plants, fruits, and vegetables, they led their subordinates to supervise keepers and planters, seasonally managing breeding and planting lands to supply sacrifices, guests, and palace kitchens.

sentences.zh: 凡苑地，東至白河，西至西山，南至武清，北至居庸關，西南至渾河，並禁圍獵。

translations.literal: The parklands extended east to the Bai River, west to the Western Hills, south to Wuqing, north to Juyong Pass, and southwest to the Hun River; hunting was forbidden throughout.
translations.idiomatic: The parklands extended east to the Bai River, west to the Western Hills, south to Wuqing, north to Juyong Pass, and southwest to the Hun River; hunting was forbidden throughout.

sentences.zh: 良牧，牧牛羊豕，蕃育，育鵝鴨雞，皆籍其牝牡之數，而課孳卵焉。

translations.literal: Fine Herds raised cattle, sheep, and pigs; Breeding raised geese, ducks, and chickens. Male and female counts were registered, and breeding and eggs were assessed.
translations.idiomatic: Fine Herds raised cattle, sheep, and pigs; Breeding raised geese, ducks, and chickens. Male and female counts were registered, and breeding output and eggs were assessed.

sentences.zh: 林衡，典果實、花木，嘉蔬，典蒔藝瓜菜，皆計其町畦、樹植之數，而以時苞進焉。

translations.literal: Forestry Balance managed fruits and flowers; Fine Vegetables managed melons and vegetables. Plot and planting counts were recorded, and produce was presented seasonally.
translations.idiomatic: Forestry Balance managed fruits and flowers; Fine Vegetables managed melons and vegetables. Plot and planting counts were recorded, and produce was presented seasonally.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十五年，議開上林院，度地城南。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 25, opening an Imperial Park Institute was discussed and land south of the city was surveyed.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 25, opening an Imperial Park Institute was discussed and land south of the city was surveyed.

sentences.zh: 自牛首山接方山，西並河涯。

translations.literal: From Niushou Mountain connecting to Fang Mountain, west to the riverbank.
translations.idiomatic: The area ran from Niushou Mountain to Fang Mountain and west to the riverbank.

sentences.zh: 比圖上，太祖謂有妨民業，遂止。

translations.literal: When the map was submitted, the Taizu said it would harm people's livelihoods, and the plan was abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: When the map was submitted, the Taizu said it would harm people's livelihoods, and the plan was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 永樂五年，始置上林苑監，設良牧、蕃育、嘉蔬、林衡、川衡、冰鑒及典察左右前後十屬署。

translations.literal: In Yongle year 5, the Directorate of the Imperial Parks was first established, with the ten subordinate offices of Fine Herds, Breeding, Fine Vegetables, Forestry Balance, River Balance, Ice Store, and the Inspectorates of Left, Right, Front, and Rear.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle year 5, the Directorate of the Imperial Parks was first established, with ten subordinate offices: Fine Herds, Breeding, Fine Vegetables, Forestry Balance, River Balance, Ice Store, and the Left, Right, Front, and Rear Inspectorates.

sentences.zh: 洪熙中，並為蕃育、嘉蔬二署。

translations.literal: In the Hongxi reign they were merged into the two offices of Breeding and Fine Vegetables.
translations.idiomatic: During the Hongxi reign they were merged into the two offices of Breeding and Fine Vegetables.

sentences.zh: 以良牧、川衡並蕃育，冰鑒、林衡並嘉蔬，典察四署分併入。

translations.literal: Fine Herds and River Balance were merged into Breeding; Ice Store and Forestry Balance into Fine Vegetables; and the four Inspectorate offices were distributed and merged in.
translations.idiomatic: Fine Herds and River Balance were merged into Breeding; Ice Store and Forestry Balance into Fine Vegetables; and the four inspectorate offices were distributed and merged in.

sentences.zh: 宣德十年，始定四署。

translations.literal: In Xuande year 10, the four offices were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 10, the four offices were fixed.

sentences.zh: 正德間，增設監督內臣共九十九員。

translations.literal: In the Zhengde period, supervising inner eunuchs were added, totaling ninety-nine posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhengde period, supervising inner eunuchs were added, totaling ninety-nine posts.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年，裁汰八十員，革蕃育、嘉蔬二署典署，林衡、嘉蔬二署錄事。

translations.literal: In Jiajing 1, eighty posts were cut; the Office Directors of Breeding and Fine Vegetables were abolished, as were the Clerks of Forestry Balance and Fine Vegetables.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 1, eighty posts were cut; the office directors of Breeding and Fine Vegetables were abolished, as were the clerks of Forestry Balance and Fine Vegetables.

sentences.zh: 中、東、西、南、北五城兵馬指揮司。

translations.literal: The Five-City Military Patrol Offices of Central, East, West, South, and North.
translations.idiomatic: The Five-City Military Patrol Offices of Central, East, West, South, and North.

sentences.zh: 各指揮一人，正六品副指揮四人，正七品吏目一人。

translations.literal: Each had one Commander at rank 6a, four Vice Commanders at rank 7a, and one Clerk.
translations.idiomatic: Each had one commander at rank 6a, four vice commanders at rank 7a, and one clerk.

sentences.zh: 指揮，巡捕盜賊，疏理街道溝渠及囚犯、火禁之事。

translations.literal: Commanders patrolled against bandits and robbers, cleared streets and drains, and managed prisoners and fire bans.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders patrolled against bandits and robbers, cleared streets and drains, and managed prisoners and fire bans.

sentences.zh: 凡京城內外，各畫境而分領之。

translations.literal: Within and outside the capital, jurisdictions were marked out and separately administered.
translations.idiomatic: Within and outside the capital, jurisdictions were marked out and separately administered.

sentences.zh: 境內有遊民、奸民則逮治。

translations.literal: Vagrants and criminals within a jurisdiction were arrested and punished.
translations.idiomatic: Vagrants and criminals within a jurisdiction were arrested and punished.

sentences.zh: 若車駕親郊，則率夫裏供事。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage personally performed the suburban sacrifice, they led district laborers to serve.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor personally performed the suburban sacrifice, they led district laborers to serve.

sentences.zh: 凡親、郡王妃父無官者，親王授兵馬指揮，郡王授副指揮，不管事。

translations.literal: When the fathers of consorts of princes of the first and second rank held no office, the prince's father-in-law was granted the title of Military Patrol Commander and the commandery prince's father-in-law that of Vice Commander, without administrative duties.
translations.idiomatic: When the fathers of consorts of imperial princes and commandery princes held no office, the imperial prince's father-in-law was granted the title of military patrol commander and the commandery prince's father-in-law that of vice commander, without administrative duties.

sentences.zh: 明初，置兵馬指揮司，設都指揮、副都指揮、知事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Ming, Military Patrol Offices were established, with Chief Commanders, Vice Chief Commanders, and Administrative Officers.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Ming, Military Patrol Offices were established, with chief commanders, vice chief commanders, and administrative officers.

sentences.zh: 後改設指揮使、副指揮使，各城門設兵馬。

translations.literal: Later Commanders and Vice Commanders were established, and military patrol posts were set at each city gate.
translations.idiomatic: Later commanders and vice commanders were established, and military patrol posts were set at each city gate.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，命在京兵馬指揮司並管市司，每三日一次校勘街市斛斗、秤尺，稽考牙儈姓名，時其物價。

translations.literal: In Hongwu 1, the capital Military Patrol Offices were also ordered to manage market offices; every three days they verified street measures and scales, checked brokers' names, and reported current prices.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1, the capital Military Patrol Offices were also ordered to manage market offices; every three days they verified street measures and scales, checked brokers' names, and reported current prices.

sentences.zh: 五年，又設兵馬指揮司分司於中都。

translations.literal: In year 5, branch Military Patrol Offices were also established at the Secondary Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5, branch Military Patrol Offices were also established at the Secondary Capital.

sentences.zh: 十年，定京城及中都兵馬指揮司秩俱正六品。

translations.literal: In year 10, the ranks of the capital and Secondary Capital Military Patrol Offices were both fixed at rank 6a.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10, the ranks of the capital and Secondary Capital Military Patrol Offices were both fixed at rank 6a.

sentences.zh: 先是秩正四品。

translations.literal: Previously the rank had been 4a.
translations.idiomatic: Previously the rank had been 4a.

sentences.zh: 改為指揮、副指揮，職專京城巡捕等事，革知事。

translations.literal: They were changed to Commanders and Vice Commanders, with duties focused on capital patrol and related matters; the Administrative Officer was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: They were changed to commanders and vice commanders, with duties focused on capital patrol and related matters; the administrative officer was abolished.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，定設五城兵馬指揮司，惟中城止稱中兵馬指揮司。

translations.literal: In year 23, the Five-City Military Patrol Offices were fixed; only the central city office was called the Central Military Patrol Office.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23, the Five-City Military Patrol Offices were fixed; only the central city office was called the Central Military Patrol Office.

sentences.zh: 俱增設吏目。

translations.literal: A Clerk was added to each.
translations.idiomatic: A clerk was added to each.

sentences.zh: 建文中，改為兵馬司，改指揮、副指揮為兵馬、副兵馬。

translations.literal: In the Jianwen reign they were changed to Military Patrol Offices, and Commanders and Vice Commanders were renamed Military Patrol Officers and Deputy Military Patrol Officers.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jianwen reign they were changed to Military Patrol Offices, and commanders and vice commanders were renamed military patrol officers and deputy military patrol officers.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年復舊。

translations.literal: In Yongle 1 the former names were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 1 the former names were restored.

sentences.zh: 二年，設北京兵馬指揮司。

translations.literal: In year 2, the Beijing Military Patrol Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2, the Beijing Military Patrol Office was established.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖四十一年，詔巡視五城御史，每年終，將各城兵馬指揮會本舉劾。

translations.literal: In Jiajing year 41, an edict ordered the censors patrolling the five cities that at year's end they should jointly assess the military patrol commanders of each city and memorialize recommending promotion or impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 41, an edict ordered the censors patrolling the five cities that at year's end they should jointly assess each city's military patrol commanders and memorialize recommending promotion or impeachment.

sentences.zh: 隆慶間，御史趙可懷言：「五城兵馬司官，宜取科貢正途，職檢驗死傷，理刑名盜賊，如兩京知縣。

translations.literal: In the Longqing period, Censor Zhao Kehuai said: "Officers of the Five-City Military Patrol Offices should be drawn from the regular examination route; their duties should include examining wounds and fatalities and handling criminal cases and banditry, like magistrates of the two capitals.
translations.idiomatic: In the Longqing period, Censor Zhao Kehuai said: "Officers of the Five-City Military Patrol Offices should be drawn from the regular examination route; their duties should include examining wounds and fatalities and handling criminal cases and banditry, like magistrates of the two capitals.

sentences.zh: 不職者，巡城御史糾劾之。」

translations.literal: Those who failed in duty should be impeached by the patrolling censors."
translations.idiomatic: Those who failed in duty should be impeached by the patrolling censors."

sentences.zh: 順天府。

translations.literal: Shuntian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shuntian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 府尹一人，正三品府丞一人，正四品治中一人，正五品通判六人，正六品，嘉靖後革三人。

translations.literal: One Prefect at rank 3a, one Vice Prefect at rank 4a, one Administrative Assistant at rank 5a, and six Vice Prefects at rank 6a—three of the latter were abolished after the Jiajing reign.
translations.idiomatic: There was one prefect at rank 3a, one vice prefect at rank 4a, one administrative assistant at rank 5a, and six vice prefects at rank 6a—three of the latter were abolished after the Jiajing reign.

sentences.zh: 推官一人，從六品儒學教授一人，從九品訓導一人。

translations.literal: One Judicial Assistant at rank 6b, one Prefectural Instructor at rank 9b, and one Prefectural Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: There was one judicial assistant at rank 6b, one prefectural instructor at rank 9b, and one prefectural tutor.

sentences.zh: 其屬，經歷司，經歷一人，從七品知事一人。

translations.literal: Its subordinates included the Administrative Office, with one Administrator at rank 7b and one Administrative Clerk.
translations.idiomatic: Its subordinates included the Administrative Office, with one administrator at rank 7b and one administrative clerk.

sentences.zh: 從八品照磨所，照磨一人，從九品檢校一人。

translations.literal: At rank 8b. The Copying Office had one Copyist at rank 9b and one Examiner.
translations.idiomatic: At rank 8b. The Copying Office had one copyist at rank 9b and one examiner.

sentences.zh: 所轄，宛平、大興二縣，各知縣一人，正六品縣丞二人，正七品主簿無定員，正八品典史一人。

translations.literal: Under its jurisdiction were Wanping and Daxing counties, each with one Magistrate at rank 6a, two Assistant Magistrates at rank 7a, Assistant Registrars without fixed quota at rank 8a, and one Clerk.
translations.idiomatic: Under its jurisdiction were Wanping and Daxing counties, each with one magistrate at rank 6a, two assistant magistrates at rank 7a, assistant registrars without fixed quota at rank 8a, and one clerk.

sentences.zh: 司獄司，司獄一人。

translations.literal: The Prison Office had one Prison Warden.
translations.idiomatic: The Prison Office had one prison warden.

sentences.zh: 從九品都稅司，大使一人，從九品副使一人。

translations.literal: At rank 9b. The Metropolitan Tax Office had one Ambassador and one Vice Ambassador.
translations.idiomatic: At rank 9b. The Metropolitan Tax Office had one ambassador and one vice ambassador.

sentences.zh: 宣課司，凡四，正陽門外、正陽門、張家灣、盧溝橋。

translations.literal: Commodity Tax Offices, four in all: outside Zhengyang Gate, at Zhengyang Gate, at Zhangjiawan, and at Lugou Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: There were four Commodity Tax Offices: outside Zhengyang Gate, at Zhengyang Gate, at Zhangjiawan, and at Lugou Bridge.

sentences.zh: 稅課司，凡二，安定門外、安定門。

translations.literal: Transit Tax Offices, two in all: outside Anding Gate and at Anding Gate.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Transit Tax Offices: outside Anding Gate and at Anding Gate.

sentences.zh: 各大使一人。

translations.literal: Each had one Ambassador.
translations.idiomatic: Each had one ambassador.

sentences.zh: 從九品稅課分司，凡二，崇文門、德勝門。

translations.literal: At rank 9b. Branch Transit Tax Offices, two in all: at Chongwen Gate and at Desheng Gate.
translations.idiomatic: At rank 9b. There were two Branch Transit Tax Offices: at Chongwen Gate and at Desheng Gate.

sentences.zh: 各副使一人。

translations.literal: Each had one Vice Ambassador.
translations.idiomatic: Each had one vice ambassador.

sentences.zh: 遞軍所、批驗所，各大使一人。

translations.literal: Courier Stations and Inspection Offices each had one Ambassador.
translations.idiomatic: Courier stations and inspection offices each had one ambassador.

sentences.zh: 府尹，掌京府之政令。

translations.literal: The Prefect managed the policies of the capital prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The prefect managed the policies of the capital prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宣化和人，勸農問俗，均貢賦，節徵徭，謹祭祀，閱實戶口，糾治豪強，隱恤窮困，疏理獄訟，務知百姓之疾苦。

translations.literal: He promoted harmony and instructed the people, encouraged agriculture and inquired into local customs, equalized tribute and taxes, regulated levies and corvée, maintained sacrifices, verified household registers, corrected powerful wrongdoers, relieved the destitute, cleared lawsuits, and strove to know the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: He promoted harmony and instructed the people, encouraged agriculture and inquired into local customs, equalized tribute and taxes, regulated levies and corvée, maintained sacrifices, verified household registers, corrected powerful wrongdoers, relieved the destitute, cleared lawsuits, and strove to know the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 歲立春，迎春、進春，祭先農之神。

translations.literal: Each year at the Beginning of Spring he welcomed spring, presented spring offerings, and sacrificed to the Spirit of the First Farmer.
translations.idiomatic: Each year at the Beginning of Spring he welcomed spring, presented spring offerings, and sacrificed to the Spirit of the First Farmer.

sentences.zh: 月朔望，早朝，奏老人坊廂聽宣諭。

translations.literal: On the first and fifteenth of each month he attended early court and reported at the Elderly Lane pavilion to hear proclamations.
translations.idiomatic: On the first and fifteenth of each month he attended early court and reported at the Elderly Lane pavilion to hear proclamations.

sentences.zh: 孟春、孟冬，率其僚屬行鄉飲酒禮。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring and the first month of winter he led his subordinates in performing the district drinking ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring and the first month of winter he led his subordinates in performing the district drinking ceremony.

sentences.zh: 凡勳戚家人文引，每三月一奏。

translations.literal: For household passes of meritorious officials' families, a report was submitted every three months.
translations.idiomatic: For household passes of meritorious officials' families, a report was submitted every three months.

sentences.zh: 市易平其物價。

translations.literal: In markets prices were stabilized.
translations.idiomatic: In markets prices were stabilized.

sentences.zh: 遇內官監徵派物料，雖有印信、揭帖，必補牘面奏。

translations.literal: When the Directorate of Palace Eunuchs requisitioned materials, even if there were seals and posted notices, a supplementary memorial had to be submitted in person.
translations.idiomatic: When the Directorate of Palace Eunuchs requisitioned materials, even if there were seals and posted notices, a supplementary memorial had to be submitted in person.

sentences.zh: 若天子耕耤，行三推禮，則奉青箱播種於後。

translations.literal: When the Son of Heaven plowed the sacred field and performed the three-push rite, he followed with the green seed box to sow behind.
translations.idiomatic: When the Son of Heaven plowed the sacred field and performed the three-push rite, he followed with the green seed box to sow behind.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，率庶人終畝。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, he led commoners to finish the furrow.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was complete, he led commoners to finish the furrow.

sentences.zh: 府丞，貳京府，兼領學校。

translations.literal: The Vice Prefect assisted in the capital prefecture and concurrently oversaw schools.
translations.idiomatic: The vice prefect assisted in the capital prefecture and concurrently oversaw schools.

sentences.zh: 治中，參理府事，以佐尹丞。

translations.literal: The Administrative Assistant participated in managing prefectural affairs to assist the Prefect and Vice Prefect.
translations.idiomatic: The administrative assistant participated in managing prefectural affairs to assist the prefect and vice prefect.

sentences.zh: 通判，分理糧儲、馬政、軍匠、薪炭、河渠、堤塗之事。

translations.literal: Vice Prefects separately managed grain stores, horse administration, military artisans, fuel and charcoal, rivers and canals, and embankments.
translations.idiomatic: Vice prefects separately managed grain stores, horse administration, military artisans, fuel and charcoal, rivers and canals, and embankments.

sentences.zh: 推官，理刑名，察屬吏。

translations.literal: The Judicial Assistant handled criminal cases and inspected subordinate officials.
translations.idiomatic: The judicial assistant handled criminal cases and inspected subordinate officials.

sentences.zh: 二縣，職掌如外縣，以近蒞輦下，故品秩特優。

translations.literal: The two counties had duties like outer counties, but because they were near the imperial presence their ranks were especially high.
translations.idiomatic: The two counties had duties like outer counties, but because they were near the imperial presence their ranks were especially high.

sentences.zh: 順天府即舊北平府。

translations.literal: Shuntian Prefecture was formerly Beiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shuntian Prefecture was formerly Beiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年置北平行省。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 2 the Northern Pacification Branch Secretariat was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 2 the Northern Pacification Branch Secretariat was established.

sentences.zh: 九年改為北平布政司，皆以北平為會府。

translations.literal: In year 9 it was changed to the Beiping Provincial Administration Commission; in both cases Beiping served as the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 it became the Beiping Provincial Administration Commission; in both cases Beiping served as the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 永樂初，改為順天府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yongle reign it was changed to Shuntian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yongle reign it became Shuntian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十年，升為府尹，秩正三品，設官如應天府。

translations.literal: In year 10 it was elevated to a Prefect at rank 3a, with officials established like those of Yingtian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 it was elevated to a prefect at rank 3a, with officials established like those of Yingtian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 順天府通判，舊六人，內一人管糧，一人管馬，一人清軍，一人管匠，一人管河，一人管柴炭。

translations.literal: Shuntian Prefecture formerly had six Vice Prefects: one managed grain, one horses, one military registration, one artisans, one rivers, and one fuel and charcoal.
translations.idiomatic: Shuntian Prefecture formerly had six vice prefects: one managed grain, one horses, one military registration, one artisans, one rivers, and one fuel and charcoal.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖八年革管河、管柴炭二人。

translations.literal: In Jiajing year 8 the two vice prefects managing rivers and fuel and charcoal were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 8 the two vice prefects managing rivers and fuel and charcoal were abolished.

sentences.zh: 萬曆九年革清軍、管匠二人。

translations.literal: In Wanli year 9 the two vice prefects managing military registration and artisans were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli year 9 the two vice prefects managing military registration and artisans were abolished.

sentences.zh: 十一年復設一人，兼管軍匠。

translations.literal: In year 11 one post was restored, concurrently managing military artisans.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 one post was restored, concurrently managing military artisans.

sentences.zh: 武學。

translations.literal: The Military Academy.
translations.idiomatic: The Military Academy.

sentences.zh: 京衛武學，教授一人，從九品訓導一人。

translations.literal: Capital-guard Military Academies had one Instructor at rank 9b and one Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Capital-guard military academies had one instructor at rank 9b and one tutor.

sentences.zh: 衛武學，教授一人，訓導二人或一人。

translations.literal: Guard Military Academies had one Instructor and two Tutors, or one Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Guard military academies had one instructor and two tutors, or one tutor.

sentences.zh: 掌教京衛各衛幼官及應襲舍人與武生，以待科舉、武舉、會舉，而聽於兵部。

translations.literal: They taught young officers of the capital guards and each guard, hereditary attendants due to inherit, and military students, preparing them for the civil examinations, military examinations, and joint examinations, and were subject to the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: They instructed young officers of the capital guards and individual guards, hereditary attendants awaiting succession, and military students, preparing them for civil, military, and joint examinations under the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 其無武學者，凡諸武生則隸儒學。

translations.literal: Where there were no Military Academies, all military students were placed under Confucian schools.
translations.idiomatic: Where no Military Academy existed, military students were assigned to Confucian schools.

sentences.zh: 建文四年始置京衛武學，設教授一人。

translations.literal: In Jianwen year 4 the capital-guard Military Academy was first established, with one Instructor appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianwen year 4 the capital-guard Military Academy was first established, with one instructor appointed.

sentences.zh: 啟忠等十齋，各訓導二人。

translations.literal: The ten halls including Qizhong each had two Tutors.
translations.idiomatic: The ten halls, including Qizhong, each had two tutors.

sentences.zh: 永樂中罷，正統六年復設。

translations.literal: It was abolished in the Yongle period and restored in Zhengtong year 6.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished during the Yongle period and restored in Zhengtong year 6.

sentences.zh: 後漸置各衛武軍，設官如儒學之制。

translations.literal: Later Military Academies were gradually established at each guard, with officials appointed under the same system as Confucian schools.
translations.idiomatic: Later military academies were gradually established at each guard, with officials appointed on the same model as Confucian schools.

sentences.zh: 僧錄司。

translations.literal: Office for Recording Buddhist Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Office for Recording Buddhist Affairs.

sentences.zh: 左、右善世二人，正六品左、右闡教二人，從六品左右講經二人，正八品左、右覺義二人。

translations.literal: Left and Right World-Improvers, two at rank 6a; Left and Right Doctrine-Promoters, two at rank 6b; Left and Right Sutra Lecturers, two at rank 8a; Left and Right Awakening-Aides, two at rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: There were two left and two right world-improvers at rank 6a, two left and two right doctrine-promoters at rank 6b, two left and two right sutra lecturers at rank 8a, and two left and two right awakening-aides at rank 8b.

sentences.zh: 從八品

translations.literal: Rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 8b.

sentences.zh: 導錄司。

translations.literal: Office for Recording Taoist Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Office for Recording Taoist Affairs.

sentences.zh: 左、右正一二人，正六品左、右演法二人，從六品左、右至靈二人，正八品左、右玄義二人。

translations.literal: Left and Right Orthodox Ones, two at rank 6a; Left and Right Ritual Expounders, two at rank 6b; Left and Right Spirit Attendants, two at rank 8a; Left and Right Arcane Aides, two at rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: There were two left and two right orthodox ones at rank 6a, two left and two right ritual expounders at rank 6b, two left and two right spirit attendants at rank 8a, and two left and two right arcane aides at rank 8b.

sentences.zh: 從八品神樂觀提點一人，正六品知觀一人，從八品，嘉靖中革。

translations.literal: The Abbey of Divine Music had one Intendant at rank 6a and one Abbot at rank 8b; both were abolished in the Jiajing period.
translations.idiomatic: The Abbey of Divine Music had one intendant at rank 6a and one abbot at rank 8b; both were abolished in the Jiajing period.

sentences.zh: 龍虎山正一真人一人。

translations.literal: One Orthodox One Perfected Man of Mount Longhu.
translations.idiomatic: One Orthodox One Perfected Man of Mount Longhu.

sentences.zh: 正二品。

translations.literal: Rank 2a.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 2a.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，張正常入朝，去其天師之號，封為真人，世襲。

translations.literal: In Hongwu 1, Zhang Zhengchang came to court; his title of Celestial Master was removed and he was enfeoffed as Perfected Man, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1, Zhang Zhengchang came to court; his title of Celestial Master was removed and he was enfeoffed as Perfected Man on a hereditary basis.

sentences.zh: 隆慶間革真人，止稱提點。

translations.literal: In the Longqing period the title Perfected Man was abolished and only Intendant was used.
translations.idiomatic: During the Longqing period the title Perfected Man was abolished and only intendant was used.

sentences.zh: 萬曆初復之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Wanli reign it was restored.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Wanli reign it was restored.

sentences.zh: 法官、贊教、掌書各二人。

translations.literal: Law Officers, Praising Instructors, and Record Keepers, two each.
translations.idiomatic: There were two law officers, two praising instructors, and two record keepers.

sentences.zh: 閣皁山、三茅山各靈官一人，正八品太和山提點一人。

translations.literal: Mount Gezao and Mount Sanmao each had one Spirit Officer at rank 8a; Mount Taihe had one Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Gezao and Mount Sanmao each had one spirit officer at rank 8a, and Mount Taihe had one intendant.

sentences.zh: 僧、道錄司掌天下僧道。

translations.literal: The Buddhist and Taoist Recording Offices managed monks and Taoists throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The Buddhist and Taoist Recording Offices oversaw monks and Taoists throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 在外府州縣有僧綱、道紀等司，分掌其事，俱選精通經典、戒行端潔者為之。

translations.literal: In outer prefectures, departments, and counties were Buddhist Superintendencies, Taoist Registries, and similar offices that shared these duties; all were filled by those well versed in the classics and of upright conduct and pure discipline.
translations.idiomatic: Outer prefectures, departments, and counties had Buddhist superintendencies, Taoist registries, and similar offices that shared these duties; appointees were chosen for mastery of the classics and upright, disciplined conduct.

sentences.zh: 神樂觀掌樂舞，以備大祀天地、神祇及宗廟、社稷之祭，隸太常寺，與道錄司無統屬。

translations.literal: The Abbey of Divine Music managed music and dance to supply the great sacrifices to Heaven and Earth, spirits, ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain; it was subordinate to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and had no administrative tie to the Taoist Recording Office.
translations.idiomatic: The Abbey of Divine Music managed music and dance for the great sacrifices to Heaven and Earth, spirits, ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain; it was subordinate to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and was not under the Taoist Recording Office.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，立善世、玄教二院。

translations.literal: In Hongwu 1, the two institutes of World-Improvement and Arcane Teaching were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1, the institutes of World-Improvement and Arcane Teaching were established.

sentences.zh: 四年革。

translations.literal: Abolished in year 4.
translations.idiomatic: Abolished in year 4.

sentences.zh: 五年，給僧道度牒。

translations.literal: In year 5, ordination certificates were issued to monks and Taoists.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5, ordination certificates were issued to monks and Taoists.

sentences.zh: 十一年，建神樂觀於郊祀壇西，設提點、知觀。

translations.literal: In year 11, the Abbey of Divine Music was built west of the suburban sacrifice altar, with an Intendant and Abbot appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11, the Abbey of Divine Music was built west of the suburban sacrifice altar, with an intendant and abbot appointed.

sentences.zh: 初，提點從六品，知觀從九品。

translations.literal: Initially the Intendant was rank 6b and the Abbot rank 9b.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the intendant was rank 6b and the abbot rank 9b.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年升提點正六品，知觀從八品。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 15 the Intendant was raised to rank 6a and the Abbot to rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 15 the intendant was raised to rank 6a and the abbot to rank 8b.

sentences.zh: 凡遇朝會，提點列於僧錄司左善世之下，道錄司左正一之上。

translations.literal: Whenever there was a court assembly, the Intendant was ranked below the Left World-Improver of the Buddhist Recording Office and above the Left Orthodox One of the Taoist Recording Office.
translations.idiomatic: At court assemblies the intendant ranked below the left world-improver of the Buddhist Recording Office and above the left orthodox one of the Taoist Recording Office.

sentences.zh: 十五年，始置僧錄司、道錄司。

translations.literal: In year 15, the Buddhist and Taoist Recording Offices were first established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15, the Buddhist and Taoist Recording Offices were first established.

sentences.zh: 各設官如前所列。

translations.literal: Officials were appointed in each as listed above.
translations.idiomatic: Each was staffed with the officials listed above.

sentences.zh: 僧凡三等：曰禪，曰講，曰教。

translations.literal: Monks were of three grades: called Chan, Lecture, and Teaching.
translations.idiomatic: Monks were divided into three grades: Chan, Lecture, and Teaching.

sentences.zh: 道凡二等：曰全真，曰正一。

translations.literal: Taoists were of two grades: called Complete Perfection and Orthodox One.
translations.idiomatic: Taoists were divided into two grades: Complete Perfection and Orthodox One.

sentences.zh: 設官不給俸，隸禮部。

translations.literal: These offices received no salaries and were subordinate to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Their officials received no salaries and were subordinate to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，清理釋、道二教，限僧三年一度給牒。

translations.literal: In year 24, Buddhism and Taoism were purged; monks were limited to receiving certificates once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: In year 24, Buddhism and Taoism were purged, and monks could receive certificates only once every three years.

sentences.zh: 凡各府州縣寺觀，但存寬大者一所，並居之。

translations.literal: In each prefecture, department, and county only one spacious temple or abbey was kept, and all resided together.
translations.idiomatic: In each prefecture, department, and county only one spacious temple or abbey was retained, and all monks and Taoists lived together there.

sentences.zh: 凡僧道，府不得過四十人，州三十人，縣二十人。

translations.literal: Monks and Taoists were limited to no more than forty per prefecture, thirty per department, and twenty per county.
translations.idiomatic: Monks and Taoists were capped at forty per prefecture, thirty per department, and twenty per county.

sentences.zh: 民年非四十以上、女年非五十以上者，不得出家。

translations.literal: Men under forty and women under fifty were not permitted to leave home for ordination.
translations.idiomatic: Men under forty and women under fifty were not permitted to take ordination.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，令天下僧道赴京考試給牒，不通經典者黜之。

translations.literal: In year 28, all monks and Taoists in the realm were ordered to come to the capital for examination before receiving certificates; those who did not know the classics were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28, all monks and Taoists in the realm were ordered to come to the capital for examination before receiving certificates, and those who failed the classics were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 其後，釋氏有法王、佛子、大國師等封號，道士有大真人、高士，高士等封號，賜銀印蟒玉，加太常卿、禮部尚書及宮保銜，至有封伯爵者，皆一時寵倖，非制也。

translations.literal: Later Buddhists received titles such as Dharma King, Buddha Son, and Great State Preceptor, and Taoists received titles such as Great Perfected Man and Lofty Gentleman, with silver seals, python robes and jade, plus designations as Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Minister of Rites, and Grand Guardian, even to enfeoffment as earl—all were temporary favors, not regular institutions.
translations.idiomatic: Later Buddhists received titles such as Dharma King, Buddha Son, and Great State Preceptor, and Taoists titles such as Great Perfected Man and Lofty Gentleman, with silver seals, python robes and jade, plus honorary ranks as vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, minister of rites, and grand guardian, even to enfeoffment as earl—all were temporary favors, not regular institutions.

sentences.zh: 教坊司。

translations.literal: Office of the Imperial Music Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Office of the Imperial Music Bureau.

sentences.zh: 奉鑾一人，正九品左、右韶舞各一人，左、右司樂各一人，並從九品掌樂舞承應。

translations.literal: One Bearer of the Phoenix Chime at rank 9a; Left and Right Masters of Elegance and Dance, one each; Left and Right Directors of Music, one each—all at rank 9b, managing music, dance, and performances.
translations.idiomatic: There was one bearer of the phoenix chime at rank 9a, one left and one right master of elegance and dance, and one left and one right director of music—all at rank 9b—managing music, dance, and performances.

sentences.zh: 以樂戶充之，隸禮部。

translations.literal: Filled by music households, subordinate to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Posts were filled by music households, and the office was subordinate to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖中，又設顯陵供祀教坊司，設左、右司樂各一人。

translations.literal: In the Jiajing period the Xianling Sacrificial Music Bureau was also established, with one Left and one Right Director of Music.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiajing period the Xianling Sacrificial Music Bureau was also established, with one left and one right director of music.

sentences.zh: 宦官。

translations.literal: Eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 十二監。

translations.literal: Twelve Directorates.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve Directorates.

sentences.zh: 每監各太監一員，正四品，左、右少監各一員，從四品，左、右監丞各一員，正五品，典簿一員，正六品，長隨、奉禦無定員，從六品。

translations.literal: Each directorate had one Grand Director at rank 4a, one Left and one Right Vice Director at rank 4b, one Left and one Right Assistant Director at rank 5a, one Registrar at rank 6a, and Attendants and Imperial Attendants without fixed quota at rank 6b.
translations.idiomatic: Each directorate had one grand director at rank 4a, one left and one right vice director at rank 4b, one left and one right assistant director at rank 5a, one registrar at rank 6a, and attendants and imperial attendants without fixed quota at rank 6b.

sentences.zh: 此洪武舊制也。

translations.literal: This was the Hongwu original institution.
translations.idiomatic: This was the original Hongwu institution.

sentences.zh: 後漸更革，詳見各條下。

translations.literal: It was gradually altered later; details appear under each entry below.
translations.idiomatic: It was gradually altered later; details appear under each entry below.

sentences.zh: 司禮監，提督太監一員，掌印太監一員，秉筆太監、隨堂太監、書籍名畫等庫掌司、內書堂掌司、六科郎掌司、典簿無定員。

translations.literal: Directorate of Ceremonial: one Supervising Grand Director, one Seal-Holding Grand Director, Brush-Holding Grand Directors, Attending Grand Directors, Directors of the Libraries of Books and Famous Paintings, Directors of the Inner Script Hall, Directors of the Six Offices of Scrutiny, and Registrars without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Ceremonial had one supervising grand director, one seal-holding grand director, brush-holding and attending grand directors, directors of the libraries of books and famous paintings, directors of the inner script hall, directors of the six offices of scrutiny, and registrars without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 提督掌督理皇城內一應儀禮刑名，及鈐束長隨、當差、聽事各役，關防門禁，催督光祿供應等事。

translations.literal: The Supervisor oversaw all ritual and legal matters within the Imperial City, controlled attendants, duty assignments, and service personnel, guarded gates, and urged supplies from the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: The supervisor oversaw all ritual and legal matters within the Imperial City, controlled attendants, duty assignments, and service personnel, guarded gates, and urged supplies from the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 掌印掌理內外章奏及御前勘合。

translations.literal: The Seal-Holder managed memorials from within and without and verification slips before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: The seal-holder managed memorials from within and without and verification slips before the throne.

sentences.zh: 秉筆、隨堂掌章奏文書，照閣票批硃。

translations.literal: Brush-Holders and Attending Grand Directors managed memorial documents and applied vermilion annotations according to Grand Secretariat recommendation slips.
translations.idiomatic: Brush-holders and attending grand directors managed memorial documents and applied vermilion annotations according to Grand Secretariat recommendation slips.

sentences.zh: 掌司各掌所司。

translations.literal: Directors each managed their assigned offices.
translations.idiomatic: Directors each managed their assigned offices.

sentences.zh: 典簿典記奏章及諸出納號簿。

translations.literal: The Registrar kept records of memorials and all receipt and issue ledgers.
translations.idiomatic: The registrar kept records of memorials and all receipt and issue ledgers.

sentences.zh: 內官監，掌印太監一員，總理、管理、僉書、典簿、掌司、寫字、監工無定員，掌木、石、瓦、土、塔材、東行、西行、油漆、婚禮、火藥十作，及米鹽庫、營造庫、皇壇庫，凡國家營造宮室、陵墓，並銅錫妝奩、器用暨冰窨諸事。

translations.literal: Directorate of Palace Eunuchs: one Seal-Holding Grand Director, General Managers, Managers, Secretaries, Registrars, Directors, Scribes, and Construction Supervisors without fixed quota, managing the ten workshops of wood, stone, tile, earth, pagoda materials, Eastern Row, Western Row, lacquer, wedding goods, and gunpowder, plus the Rice and Salt Depot, Construction Depot, and Imperial Altar Depot—for all state construction of palaces and tombs, copper and tin cosmetic boxes, utensils, and ice cellars.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Palace Eunuchs had one seal-holding grand director and general managers, managers, secretaries, registrars, directors, scribes, and construction supervisors without fixed quota; it managed ten workshops—wood, stone, tile, earth, pagoda materials, Eastern Row, Western Row, lacquer, wedding goods, and gunpowder—and the rice and salt, construction, and imperial altar depots, handling state construction of palaces and tombs, copper and tin cosmetic boxes, utensils, and ice cellars.

sentences.zh: 御用監，掌印太監一員，裏外監把總二員，典簿、掌司、寫字、監工無定員。

translations.literal: Directorate of Imperial Manufacture: one Seal-Holding Grand Director, two Inner and Outer Chief Controllers, Registrars, Directors, Scribes, and Construction Supervisors without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Imperial Manufacture had one seal-holding grand director, two inner and outer chief controllers, and registrars, directors, scribes, and construction supervisors without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 凡御前所用圍屏、牀榻諸木器，及紫檀、象牙、烏木、螺甸諸玩器，皆造辦之。

translations.literal: All screens, couches, and other wooden furnishings used before the throne, as well as zitan, ivory, ebony, and mother-of-pearl curios, were made there.
translations.idiomatic: All screens, couches, and other wooden furnishings used before the throne, as well as zitan, ivory, ebony, and mother-of-pearl curios, were made there.

sentences.zh: 又有仁智殿監工一員，掌武英殿中書承旨所寫書籍畫冊等，奏進御前。

translations.literal: There was also one Construction Supervisor of the Hall of Benevolence and Wisdom, who managed books, albums, and other works written at the Drafting Office of the Hall of Military Glory and presented them before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: There was also one construction supervisor of the Hall of Benevolence and Wisdom, who managed books, albums, and other works written at the drafting office of the Hall of Military Glory and presented them before the throne.

sentences.zh: 司設監，員同內官監，掌鹵簿、儀仗、帷幕諸事。

translations.literal: Directorate of Palace Equipment, with posts like the Directorate of Palace Eunuchs, managed insignia, ceremonial guards, and curtains.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Palace Equipment, with posts like the Directorate of Palace Eunuchs, managed insignia, ceremonial guards, and curtains.

sentences.zh: 御馬監，掌印、監督、提督太監各一員。

translations.literal: Directorate of Imperial Horses had one Seal-Holding, one Supervising, and one Supervising Grand Director each.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Imperial Horses had one seal-holding grand director, one inspecting grand director, and one supervising grand director.

sentences.zh: 騰驤四衛營各設監官、掌司、典簿、寫字、拿馬等員。

translations.literal: The four Tengxiang Guard camps each had Directors, Controllers, Registrars, Scribes, Horse Handlers, and similar posts.
translations.idiomatic: The four Tengxiang Guard camps each had directors, controllers, registrars, scribes, horse handlers, and similar posts.

sentences.zh: 象房有掌司等員。

translations.literal: The Elephant House had Directors and similar posts.
translations.idiomatic: The elephant house had directors and similar posts.

sentences.zh: 神宮監，掌印太監一員，僉書、掌司、管理無定員，掌太廟各廟灑掃、香燈等事。

translations.literal: Directorate of Imperial Shrines: one Seal-Holding Grand Director, Secretaries, Directors, and Managers without fixed quota, managing sweeping, incense, and lamps at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and its halls.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Imperial Shrines had one seal-holding grand director and secretaries, directors, and managers without fixed quota, managing sweeping, incense, and lamps at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and its halls.

sentences.zh: 尚膳監，掌印太監一員，提督光祿太監一員，總理一員，管理、僉書、掌司、寫字、監工及各牛羊等房廠監工無定員，掌禦膳及宮內食用並筵宴諸事。

translations.literal: Directorate of Imperial Cuisine: one Seal-Holding Grand Director, one Grand Director supervising the Court of Imperial Entertainments, one General Manager, Managers, Secretaries, Directors, Scribes, Construction Supervisors, and supervisors of cattle, sheep, and other workshops without fixed quota, managing imperial meals, palace provisions, and banquets.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Imperial Cuisine had one seal-holding grand director, one grand director supervising the Court of Imperial Entertainments, one general manager, and managers, secretaries, directors, scribes, construction supervisors, and supervisors of cattle, sheep, and other workshops without fixed quota, managing imperial meals, palace provisions, and banquets.

sentences.zh: 尚寶監，掌印一員，僉書、掌司無定員，掌寶璽、敕符、將軍印信。

translations.literal: Directorate of Imperial Seals: one Seal-Holder, Secretaries and Directors without fixed quota, managing imperial seals, edict tokens, and general officers' seals.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Imperial Seals had one seal-holder and secretaries and directors without fixed quota, managing imperial seals, edict tokens, and general officers' seals.

sentences.zh: 凡用寶，外尚寶司以揭帖赴監請旨，至女官尚寶司領取，監視外司用訖，存號簿，繳進。

translations.literal: When seals were used, the outer Imperial Seals Office submitted a notice to the directorate to request instructions; the female officials' Imperial Seals Office then received them; the directorate supervised the outer office until use was complete, kept the register, and returned them.
translations.idiomatic: When seals were used, the outer Imperial Seals Office submitted a notice to the directorate for instructions; the female officials' Imperial Seals Office then received them; the directorate supervised the outer office until use was complete, kept the register, and returned them.

sentences.zh: 印綬監，員同尚寶，掌古今通集庫，並鐵券、誥敕、貼黃、印信、勘合、符驗、信符諸事。

translations.literal: Directorate of Seals and Credentials, with posts like the Directorate of Imperial Seals, managed the Comprehensive Collections Depot of past and present, as well as iron certificates, patents of nobility, yellow slips, seals, verification documents, tally tokens, and credential seals.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Seals and Credentials, with posts like the Directorate of Imperial Seals, managed the comprehensive collections depot of past and present, as well as iron certificates, patents of nobility, yellow slips, seals, verification documents, tally tokens, and credential seals.

sentences.zh: 直殿監，員同上，掌各殿及廊廡掃除事。

translations.literal: Directorate of Palace Maintenance, with posts as above, managed sweeping of the halls and corridors.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Palace Maintenance, with posts as above, managed sweeping of the halls and corridors.

sentences.zh: 尚衣監，掌印太監一員，管理、僉書、掌司、監工無定員，掌御用冠冕、袍服及屨舄、靴襪之事。

translations.literal: Directorate of Imperial Wardrobe: one Seal-Holding Grand Director, Managers, Secretaries, Directors, and Construction Supervisors without fixed quota, managing imperial caps, robes, sandals, and boots and socks.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Imperial Wardrobe had one seal-holding grand director and managers, secretaries, directors, and construction supervisors without fixed quota, managing imperial caps, robes, sandals, and boots and socks.

sentences.zh: 都知監。

translations.literal: Directorate of Imperial Inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate of Imperial Inspection.

sentences.zh: 掌印太監一員，僉書、掌司、長隨、奉禦無定員，舊掌各監行移、關知、勘合之事，後惟隨駕前導警蹕。

translations.literal: One Seal-Holding Grand Director, Secretaries, Directors, Attendants, and Imperial Attendants without fixed quota; formerly managed communications, notifications, and verification for all directorates; later only preceded the imperial carriage to clear the way.
translations.idiomatic: There was one seal-holding grand director and secretaries, directors, attendants, and imperial attendants without fixed quota; formerly the office managed communications, notifications, and verification for all directorates, but later it only preceded the imperial carriage to clear the way.

sentences.zh: 四司。

translations.literal: Four Offices.
translations.idiomatic: Four Offices.

sentences.zh: 舊制每司各司正一人，正五品；

translations.literal: Under the original institution each office had one Director at rank 5a;
translations.idiomatic: Under the original institution each office had one director at rank 5a;

sentences.zh: 左、右司副各一人，從五品。

translations.literal: one Left and one Right Vice Director at rank 5b.
translations.idiomatic: There was one left and one right vice director at rank 5b.

sentences.zh: 後漸更易，詳下。

translations.literal: These were gradually changed later; details below.
translations.idiomatic: These were gradually changed later; details appear below.

sentences.zh: 惜薪司，掌印太監一員，總理、僉書、掌道、掌司、寫字、監工及外廠、北廠、南廠、新南廠、新西廠各設僉書、監工，俱無定員，掌所用薪炭之事。

translations.literal: Office of Frugal Fuel: one Seal-Holding Grand Director, General Managers, Secretaries, Controllers, Directors, Scribes, Construction Supervisors, and at the Outer, North, South, New South, and New West yards Secretaries and Construction Supervisors—all without fixed quota—managed firewood and charcoal.
translations.idiomatic: The Office of Frugal Fuel had one seal-holding grand director and general managers, secretaries, controllers, directors, scribes, and construction supervisors, with secretaries and construction supervisors also at the Outer, North, South, New South, and New West yards—all without fixed quota—and managed firewood and charcoal.

sentences.zh: 鐘鼓司，掌印太監一員，僉書、司房、學藝官無定員，掌管出朝鐘鼓，及內樂、傳奇、過錦、打稻諸雜戲。

translations.literal: Office of Bells and Drums: one Seal-Holding Grand Director, Secretaries, Clerks, and Arts Instructors without fixed quota, managing departure bells and drums, inner music, plays, patterned banquets, rice-stamping, and other entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: The Office of Bells and Drums had one seal-holding grand director and secretaries, clerks, and arts instructors without fixed quota, managing departure bells and drums, inner music, plays, patterned banquets, rice-stamping, and other entertainments.

sentences.zh: 寶鈔司，掌印太監一員，僉書、管理、監工無定員，掌造粗細草紙。

translations.literal: Office of Treasure Notes: one Seal-Holding Grand Director, Secretaries, Managers, and Construction Supervisors without fixed quota, manufacturing coarse and fine straw paper.
translations.idiomatic: The Office of Treasure Notes had one seal-holding grand director and secretaries, managers, and construction supervisors without fixed quota, manufacturing coarse and fine straw paper.

sentences.zh: 混堂司。

translations.literal: Office of the Bathhouse.
translations.idiomatic: Office of the Bathhouse.

sentences.zh: 掌印太監一員，僉書、監工無定員，掌沐浴之事。

translations.literal: One Seal-Holding Grand Director, Secretaries and Construction Supervisors without fixed quota, managing bathing.
translations.idiomatic: There was one seal-holding grand director and secretaries and construction supervisors without fixed quota, managing bathing.

sentences.zh: 八局。

translations.literal: Eight Bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Bureaus.

sentences.zh: 舊制每局大使一人，正五品；

translations.literal: Under the original institution each bureau had one Director at rank 5a;
translations.idiomatic: Under the original institution each bureau had one director at rank 5a;

sentences.zh: 左、右副使各一人，從五品。

translations.literal: one Left and one Right Vice Director at rank 5b.
translations.idiomatic: There was one left and one right vice director at rank 5b.

sentences.zh: 兵仗局，掌印太監一員，提督軍器庫太監一員，管理、僉書、掌司、寫字、監工無定員，掌製造軍器。

translations.literal: Bureau of Military Equipment: one Seal-Holding Grand Director, one Grand Director supervising the Armory Depot, Managers, Secretaries, Directors, Scribes, and Construction Supervisors without fixed quota, manufacturing weapons.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Equipment had one seal-holding grand director, one grand director supervising the armory depot, and managers, secretaries, directors, scribes, and construction supervisors without fixed quota, manufacturing weapons.

sentences.zh: 火藥司屬之。

translations.literal: The Gunpowder Office was subordinate to it.
translations.idiomatic: The Gunpowder Office was subordinate to it.

sentences.zh: 銀作局，掌印太監一員，管理、僉書、寫字、監工無定員，掌打造金銀器飾。

translations.literal: Bureau of Silver Work: one Seal-Holding Grand Director, Managers, Secretaries, Scribes, and Construction Supervisors without fixed quota, crafting gold and silver ornaments.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Silver Work had one seal-holding grand director and managers, secretaries, scribes, and construction supervisors without fixed quota, crafting gold and silver ornaments.

sentences.zh: 浣衣局，掌印太監一員，僉書、監工無定員。

translations.literal: Bureau of Laundry: one Seal-Holding Grand Director, Secretaries and Construction Supervisors without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Laundry had one seal-holding grand director and secretaries and construction supervisors without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 凡宮人年老及罷退廢者，發此局居住。

translations.literal: Palace women who were old, dismissed, or discarded were sent to live at this bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Palace women who were old, dismissed, or discarded were sent to live at this bureau.

sentences.zh: 惟此局不在皇城內。

translations.literal: This bureau alone lay outside the Imperial City.
translations.idiomatic: This bureau alone lay outside the Imperial City.

sentences.zh: 巾帽局，掌印太監一員，管理、僉書、掌司、監工無定員，掌宮內使帽靴，駙馬冠靴及籓王之國諸旗尉帽靴。

translations.literal: Bureau of Caps and Boots: one Seal-Holding Grand Director, Managers, Secretaries, Directors, and Construction Supervisors without fixed quota, managing inner attendants' caps and boots, imperial sons-in-law's caps and boots, and banner guards' caps and boots when princes went to their fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Caps and Boots had one seal-holding grand director and managers, secretaries, directors, and construction supervisors without fixed quota, managing inner attendants' caps and boots, imperial sons-in-law's caps and boots, and banner guards' caps and boots when princes went to their fiefs.

sentences.zh: 針工局，員同巾帽局，掌造宮中衣服。

translations.literal: Bureau of Needlework, with posts like the Bureau of Caps and Boots, made palace clothing.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Needlework, with posts like the Bureau of Caps and Boots, made palace clothing.

sentences.zh: 內織染局，員同上，掌染造御用及宮內應用緞匹。

translations.literal: Bureau of Inner Weaving and Dyeing, with posts as above, dyed and wove imperial and palace satin.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Inner Weaving and Dyeing, with posts as above, dyed and wove imperial and palace satin.

sentences.zh: 城西藍靛廠為此局外署。

translations.literal: The Indigo Mill west of the city served as its outer office.
translations.idiomatic: The indigo mill west of the city served as its outer office.

sentences.zh: 酒醋面局，員同上，掌宮內食用酒醋、糖醬、面豆諸物。

translations.literal: Bureau of Wine, Vinegar, and Flour, with posts as above, managed palace wine, vinegar, sugar paste, flour, and beans.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Wine, Vinegar, and Flour, with posts as above, managed palace wine, vinegar, sugar paste, flour, and beans.

sentences.zh: 與禦酒房不相統轄。

translations.literal: It was not under the Imperial Wine Cellar.
translations.idiomatic: It was not under the Imperial Wine Cellar.

sentences.zh: 司苑局。

translations.literal: Bureau of Palace Gardens.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau of Palace Gardens.

sentences.zh: 員同上，掌蔬菜、瓜果。

translations.literal: With posts as above, it managed vegetables and melons.
translations.idiomatic: With posts as above, it managed vegetables and melons.

sentences.zh: 十二監、四司、八局，所謂二十四衙門也。

translations.literal: The Twelve Directorates, Four Offices, and Eight Bureaus were what were called the Twenty-Four Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: The twelve directorates, four offices, and eight bureaus were what were called the twenty-four yamen.

sentences.zh: 其外有內府供用庫，掌印太監一員，總理、管理、掌司、寫字、監工無定員。

translations.literal: Outside these was the Inner Palace Supply Depot, with one Seal-Holding Grand Director, General Managers, Managers, Directors, Scribes, and Construction Supervisors without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Outside these was the Inner Palace Supply Depot, with one seal-holding grand director and general managers, managers, directors, scribes, and construction supervisors without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 掌宮內及山陵等處內官食米及御用黃蠟、白蠟、沉香等香。

translations.literal: It managed grain rations for inner attendants within the palace and at imperial tombs, and also imperial yellow wax, white wax, agarwood, and other incense.
translations.idiomatic: It supplied grain rations for palace inner attendants and those at imperial tombs, and managed imperial yellow wax, white wax, agarwood, and other incense.

sentences.zh: 凡油蠟等庫俱屬之。

translations.literal: All oil-wax depots and similar stores were subordinate to it.
translations.idiomatic: All oil-wax depots and related stores fell under its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 舊制各庫設官同八局。

translations.literal: Under the original institution, each depot was staffed on the same model as the Eight Bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Under the original institution, each depot was staffed like the eight bureaus.

sentences.zh: 司鑰庫，員同上，掌收貯製錢以給賞賜。

translations.literal: Key Depot, with posts as above, collected and stored minted coin for bestowals and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: The Key Depot, with posts as above, collected and stored minted coin for imperial bestowals and rewards.

sentences.zh: 內承運庫，掌印太監一員，近侍、僉書太監十員，掌司、寫字、監工無定員。

translations.literal: Inner Transport Depot: one Seal-Holding Grand Director, ten Attendant and Secretary Grand Directors, Directors, Scribes, and Construction Supervisors without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Transport Depot had one seal-holding grand director, ten attendant and secretary grand directors, and directors, scribes, and construction supervisors without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 掌大內庫藏，凡金銀及諸寶貨總隸之。

translations.literal: It managed the inner palace treasury; all gold, silver, and other valuables were placed under its authority.
translations.idiomatic: It managed the inner palace treasury, and all gold, silver, and other valuables were subordinate to it.

sentences.zh: 十庫，甲字，掌貯銀硃、黃丹、烏梅、藤黃、水銀諸物。

translations.literal: Of the ten depots, Jia stored cinnabar, yellow orpiment, dark plum, garcinia, mercury, and similar items.
translations.idiomatic: Of the ten depots, the Jia depot stored cinnabar, yellow orpiment, dark plum, garcinia, mercury, and similar items.

sentences.zh: 乙字，掌貯奏本等紙及各省所解胖襖。

translations.literal: Yi stored memorial paper and padded jackets presented from the provinces.
translations.idiomatic: The Yi depot stored memorial paper and padded jackets presented from the provinces.

sentences.zh: 丙字，掌貯絲綿、布匹。

translations.literal: Bing stored silk floss and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: The Bing depot stored silk floss and cloth.

sentences.zh: 丁字，掌貯生漆、桐油等物。

translations.literal: Ding stored raw lacquer, tung oil, and similar items.
translations.idiomatic: The Ding depot stored raw lacquer, tung oil, and similar items.

sentences.zh: 戊字，掌貯所解弓箭、盔甲等物。

translations.literal: Wu stored bows, arrows, armor, and similar tribute items.
translations.idiomatic: The Wu depot stored bows, arrows, armor, and similar items presented in tribute.

sentences.zh: 承運，掌貯黃白生絹。

translations.literal: Chengyun stored raw yellow and white silk.
translations.idiomatic: The Chengyun depot stored raw yellow and white silk.

sentences.zh: 廣盈，掌貯紗羅諸帛匹。

translations.literal: Guangying stored gauze, silk, and other bolts of cloth.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangying depot stored gauze, silk, and other bolts of cloth.

sentences.zh: 廣惠，掌造貯巾帕、梳籠、刷抿、錢貫、鈔錠之類。

translations.literal: Guanghui made and stored handkerchiefs, comb boxes, brushes, strings of cash, and ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: The Guanghui depot made and stored handkerchiefs, comb boxes, brushes, strings of cash, and ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 贓罰，掌沒入官物。

translations.literal: Forfeiture managed goods confiscated by the state.
translations.idiomatic: The Forfeiture depot managed goods confiscated by the state.

sentences.zh: 已上各掌庫一員，貼庫、僉書無定員。

translations.literal: Each of the above had one Depot Manager, with Assistant Depot Managers and Secretaries without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the above depots had one depot manager, with assistant depot managers and secretaries without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 禦酒房，提督太監一員，僉書無定員。

translations.literal: Imperial Wine Cellar: one Supervising Grand Director, Secretaries without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Wine Cellar had one supervising grand director and secretaries without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 掌造御用酒。

translations.literal: It made imperial wine.
translations.idiomatic: It manufactured imperial wine.

sentences.zh: 禦藥房，提督太監正、副二員，分兩班。

translations.literal: Imperial Pharmacy: two Supervising Grand Directors, senior and junior, divided into two shifts.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Pharmacy had two supervising grand directors, senior and junior, divided into two shifts.

sentences.zh: 近侍、醫官無定員。

translations.literal: Attendants and medical officers served without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Personal attendants and medical officers served without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 職掌御用藥餌，與太醫院官相表裏。

translations.literal: Its duty was to manage imperial medicines and pills, working in tandem with the Imperial Medical Institute.
translations.idiomatic: It managed imperial medicines and pills, working in tandem with officials of the Imperial Medical Institute.

sentences.zh: 禦茶房，提督太監正、副二員，分兩班。

translations.literal: Imperial Tea Room: two Supervising Grand Directors, senior and junior, divided into two shifts.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Tea Room had two supervising grand directors, senior and junior, divided into two shifts.

sentences.zh: 近侍無定員。

translations.literal: Attendants served without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Personal attendants served without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 職司供奉茶酒、瓜果及進禦膳。

translations.literal: Its duty was to supply tea, wine, melons, and fruit and present imperial meals.
translations.idiomatic: It supplied tea, wine, melons, and fruit and presented imperial meals.

sentences.zh: 牲口房，提督太監一員，僉書無定員。

translations.literal: Livestock House: one Supervising Grand Director, Secretaries without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Livestock House had one supervising grand director and secretaries without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 收養異獸珍禽。

translations.literal: It kept rare beasts and precious birds.
translations.idiomatic: It housed rare beasts and precious birds.

sentences.zh: 刻漏房，掌房一員，僉書無定員。

translations.literal: Clepsydra Office: one Chief Controller, Secretaries without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Clepsydra Office had one chief controller and secretaries without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 掌管每日時刻，每一時即令直殿監官入宮換牌，夜報刻水。

translations.literal: It regulated the hours of each day; at every double-hour it ordered an official of the Directorate of Palace Maintenance to enter the palace and change the time plaque, and at night reported the clepsydra graduations.
translations.idiomatic: It kept the hours of each day; at every double-hour it ordered an official of the Directorate of Palace Maintenance to enter the palace and change the time plaque, and at night reported the clepsydra graduations.

sentences.zh: 更鼓房，有罪內官職司之。

translations.literal: The Night-Watch Drum Office was staffed by inner attendants guilty of offenses.
translations.idiomatic: The Night-Watch Drum Office was staffed by offending inner attendants.

sentences.zh: 甜食房，掌房一員，協同無定員。

translations.literal: Sweetmeats Office: one Chief Controller, Assistants without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Sweetmeats Office had one chief controller and assistants without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 掌造辦虎眼、窩絲等糖及諸甜食，隸御用監。

translations.literal: It made tiger-eye, birds-nest, and other confections and various sweetmeats, and was subordinate to the Directorate of Imperial Manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: It made tiger-eye, birds-nest, and other confections and various sweetmeats under the Directorate of Imperial Manufacture.

sentences.zh: 彈子房，掌房一員，僉書數員。

translations.literal: Pellet Office: one Chief Controller and several Secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: The Pellet Office had one chief controller and several secretaries.

sentences.zh: 專備泥彈。

translations.literal: It supplied clay pellets exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: It supplied clay pellets exclusively for palace use.

sentences.zh: 靈臺，掌印太監一員，僉書近侍、看時近侍無定員。

translations.literal: Spirit Platform: one Seal-Holding Grand Director, Secretary Attendants and Timekeeping Attendants without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Spirit Platform had one seal-holding grand director and secretary attendants and timekeeping attendants without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 掌觀星氣雲物，測候災祥。

translations.literal: It observed stars, vapors, and clouds and measured portents of disaster and good fortune.
translations.idiomatic: It observed stars, vapors, and clouds and measured omens of disaster and good fortune.

sentences.zh: 條作，掌作一員，協同無定員。

translations.literal: Cord Workshop: one Master Craftsman, Assistants without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Cord Workshop had one master craftsman and assistants without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 掌造各色兜羅絨及諸絛綬，隸御用監。

translations.literal: It made various types of velvet and cords and tassels, and was subordinate to the Directorate of Imperial Manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: It made various types of velvet, cords, and tassels under the Directorate of Imperial Manufacture.

sentences.zh: 盔甲廠，即舊鞍轡局，掌造軍器。

translations.literal: Armor Factory, formerly the Saddle and Bridle Office, made military equipment.
translations.idiomatic: The Armor Factory, formerly the Saddle and Bridle Office, manufactured military equipment.

sentences.zh: 安民廠，舊名王恭廠，各掌廠太監一員，貼廠、僉書無定員。

translations.literal: Anmin Factory, formerly called Wanggong Factory: each had one Factory Director Grand Director, with Assistant Factory Managers and Secretaries without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Anmin Factory, formerly called the Wanggong Factory, had one factory director grand director at each site, with assistant factory managers and secretaries without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 掌造銃砲、火藥之類。

translations.literal: It made guns, cannon, gunpowder, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: It manufactured guns, cannon, gunpowder, and the like.

sentences.zh: 午門，東華門，西華門，奉天門，玄武門，左、右順門，左、右紅門，皇宮門，坤甯門，宮左、右門。

translations.literal: Meridian Gate, East Flowery Gate, West Flowery Gate, Gate of Imperial Heaven, Dark Warrior Gate, Left and Right Gates of Compliance, Left and Right Red Gates, Imperial Palace Gate, Gate of Earthly Tranquility, and Left and Right Palace Gates.
translations.idiomatic: These included the Meridian Gate, East Flowery Gate, West Flowery Gate, Gate of Imperial Heaven, Dark Warrior Gate, left and right Gates of Compliance, left and right Red Gates, Imperial Palace Gate, Gate of Earthly Tranquility, and left and right palace gates.

sentences.zh: 東宮春和門，後門，左、右門，皇城、京城內外諸門，各門正一員，管事無定員。

translations.literal: The Eastern Palace Gate of Spring Harmony, Rear Gate, Left and Right Gates, and all gates within and without the Imperial City and capital each had one Gate Chief and Managers without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Palace Gate of Spring Harmony, Rear Gate, left and right gates, and all gates within and without the Imperial City and capital each had one gate chief and managers without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 司晨昏啟閉，關防出入。

translations.literal: They regulated opening and closing at dawn and dusk and controlled passage in and out.
translations.idiomatic: They opened and closed the gates at dawn and dusk and controlled passage in and out.

sentences.zh: 舊設門正、門副各一員。

translations.literal: Formerly one Gate Chief and one Gate Vice Chief were appointed at each gate.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly each gate had one gate chief and one gate vice chief.

sentences.zh: 提督東廠，掌印太監一員，掌班、領班、司房無定員。

translations.literal: Eastern Depot Supervisor: one Seal-Holding Grand Director, Shift Chiefs, Leading Shift Chiefs, and Office Clerks without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Depot supervisor had one seal-holding grand director and shift chiefs, leading shift chiefs, and office clerks without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 貼刑二員，掌刺緝刑獄之事。

translations.literal: Two Attached Penal Officers managed investigation and prison affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Two attached penal officers managed investigation and prison affairs.

sentences.zh: 舊選各監中一人提督，後專用司禮、秉筆第二人或第三人為之。

translations.literal: Formerly one man was chosen from each directorate to supervise; later only the second or third man of the Directorate of Ceremonial or the Brush-Holders served.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly one man was chosen from each directorate to supervise; later only the second or third man of the Directorate of Ceremonial or the brush-holders was appointed.

sentences.zh: 其貼刑官，則用錦衣衛千百戶為之。

translations.literal: The Attached Penal Officers were drawn from battalion and company commanders of the Embroidered Uniform Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The attached penal officers were drawn from battalion and company commanders of the Embroidered Uniform Guard.

sentences.zh: 凡內官司禮監掌印，權如外廷元輔；

translations.literal: Generally, the Seal-Holder of the Directorate of Ceremonial among inner officials wielded authority like the chief minister of the outer court;
translations.idiomatic: Generally, the seal-holder of the Directorate of Ceremonial among inner officials wielded authority like the chief minister of the outer court;

sentences.zh: 掌東廠，權如總憲。

translations.literal: the Eastern Depot supervisor wielded authority like the censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: the Eastern Depot supervisor wielded authority like the censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 秉筆、隨堂視眾輔。

translations.literal: Brush-Holders and Attending Grand Directors were regarded as vice ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Brush-holders and attending grand directors were regarded as vice ministers.

sentences.zh: 各設私臣掌家、掌班、司房等員。

translations.literal: Each maintained private retainers such as Stewards, Shift Chiefs, and Office Clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Each maintained private retainers such as stewards, shift chiefs, and office clerks.

sentences.zh: 提督西廠，不常設，惟汪直、穀大用置之。

translations.literal: Western Depot Supervisor was not regularly established; only Wang Zhi and Gu Dayong were appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Depot supervisor was not regularly established; only Wang Zhi and Gu Dayong were appointed to it.

sentences.zh: 劉瑾又設西內廠。

translations.literal: Liu Jin further established the Western Inner Depot.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jin further established the Western Inner Depot.

sentences.zh: 尋俱罷革。

translations.literal: Soon all were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Soon all were abolished.

sentences.zh: 提督京營，提督太監，坐營太監，監槍、掌司、僉書俱無定員。

translations.literal: Capital Camp Supervisor: Supervising Grand Director, Camp-Resident Grand Director, Firearms Supervisors, Directors, and Secretaries—all without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: The capital camp supervisor included a supervising grand director, camp-resident grand director, firearms supervisors, directors, and secretaries—all without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 始於景泰元年。

translations.literal: This began in Jingtai 1.
translations.idiomatic: This institution began in Jingtai 1.

sentences.zh: 文書房，掌房十員。

translations.literal: Document Office: ten Chief Controllers.
translations.idiomatic: The Document Office had ten chief controllers.

sentences.zh: 掌收通政司每日封進本章，並會極門京官及各籓所上封本，其在外之閣票，在內之搭票，一應聖諭旨意御批，俱由文書房落底簿發。

translations.literal: It received daily memorials sealed and forwarded by the Directorate of Communications, sealed memorials from capital officials at the Gate of Supreme Harmony and from the feudatories, recommendation slips from outside and routing slips from within; all imperial edicts, instructions, and rescripts were entered in the master ledger and dispatched by the Document Office.
translations.idiomatic: It received daily memorials sealed and forwarded by the Directorate of Communications, sealed memorials from capital officials at the Gate of Supreme Harmony and from the feudatories, recommendation slips from outside and routing slips from within; all imperial edicts, instructions, and rescripts were registered and dispatched through the Document Office.

sentences.zh: 凡升司禮者，必由文書房出，如外廷之詹、翰也。

translations.literal: All who were promoted to the Directorate of Ceremonial had to come up through the Document Office, like the Hanlin and Academy staffs of the outer court.
translations.idiomatic: All who rose to the Directorate of Ceremonial had to come up through the Document Office, like the Hanlin and Academy staffs of the outer court.

sentences.zh: 禮儀房，提督太監一員，司禮、掌印或秉筆攝之，掌司、寫字、管事、長隨無定員。

translations.literal: Ritual Office: one Supervising Grand Director, filled concurrently by the Directorate of Ceremonial, Seal-Holder, or Brush-Holders; Directors, Scribes, Managers, and Attendants without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Office had one supervising grand director, filled concurrently by the Directorate of Ceremonial, seal-holder, or brush-holders, and directors, scribes, managers, and attendants without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 掌一應選婚、選駙馬、誕皇太子女、選擇乳婦諸吉禮。

translations.literal: It managed all auspicious rites of selecting consorts, selecting imperial sons-in-law, the birth of imperial grandsons and granddaughters, and choosing wet nurses.
translations.idiomatic: It managed all auspicious rites of selecting consorts, selecting imperial sons-in-law, the birth of imperial grandsons and granddaughters, and choosing wet nurses.

sentences.zh: 中書房，掌房一員，散官無定員。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat Office: one Chief Controller, Honorary Officials without fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat Office had one chief controller and honorary officials without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 掌管文華殿中書所寫書籍、對聯、扇柄等件，承旨發寫，完日奏進。

translations.literal: It managed books, couplets, fan handles, and other items written at the Drafting Office of the Hall of Literary Glory; on receiving instructions it dispatched the writing, and when finished presented them to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: It managed books, couplets, fan handles, and other items written at the drafting office of the Hall of Literary Glory; on receiving instructions it dispatched the writing, and when finished presented them to the throne.

sentences.zh: 御前近侍，曰乾清宮管事，督理御用諸事，曰打卯牌子，掌隨朝捧劍，俱位居司禮、東廠提督守備之次。

translations.literal: Personal attendants before the throne included the Manager of the Palace of Heavenly Purity, who oversaw imperial affairs; the Dawn Bell Attendant, who carried the sword at court; all ranked next after the Directorate of Ceremonial, Eastern Depot supervisor, and garrison commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Personal attendants before the throne included the manager of the Palace of Heavenly Purity, who oversaw imperial affairs, and the dawn bell attendant, who carried the sword at court; all ranked next after the Directorate of Ceremonial, Eastern Depot supervisor, and garrison commanders.

sentences.zh: 曰御前牌子，曰暖殿，曰管櫃子，曰贊禮，曰答應長隨，曰當差聽事，曰拿馬，尚冠、尚衣、尚履，皆近侍也。
