translations.literal: There were Imperial Attendants, Warming-Hall Attendants, Cabinet Keepers, Ritual Announcers, Response Attendants, Duty Attendants, Horse Handlers, and the Offices of Imperial Caps, Imperial Robes, and Imperial Footwear—all personal attendants.
translations.idiomatic: These included imperial attendants, warming-hall attendants, cabinet keepers, ritual announcers, response attendants, duty attendants, horse handlers, and the offices of imperial caps, imperial robes, and imperial footwear—all personal attendants.

sentences.zh: 南京守備，正、副守備太監各一員。

translations.literal: Nanjing Garrison: one Senior and one Junior Garrison Grand Director.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanjing garrison had one senior and one junior garrison grand director.

sentences.zh: 關防一顆，護衛留都，為司禮監外差。

translations.literal: It held one seal of authority, protected the secondary capital, and was an outside assignment of the Directorate of Ceremonial.
translations.idiomatic: It held one seal of authority, protected the secondary capital, and was an outside posting of the Directorate of Ceremonial.

sentences.zh: 天壽山守備，太監一員。

translations.literal: Tianshou Mountain Garrison: one Grand Director.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianshou Mountain garrison had one grand director.

sentences.zh: 轄各陵守陵太監，職司護衛。

translations.literal: He oversaw tomb-guard grand directors at each mausoleum and was charged with protection.
translations.idiomatic: He oversaw tomb-guard grand directors at each mausoleum and was charged with guarding the tombs.

sentences.zh: 湖廣承天府守備，太監一員。

translations.literal: Huguang Chengtian Prefecture Garrison: one Grand Director.
translations.idiomatic: The Huguang Chengtian Prefecture garrison had one grand director.

sentences.zh: 轄承德、荊、襄地方，護衛興甯。

translations.literal: He had jurisdiction over Chengde and the Jing and Xiang regions and protected Xingning.
translations.idiomatic: He had jurisdiction over Chengde and the Jing and Xiang regions and protected Xingning.

sentences.zh: 織造，提督太監南京一員，蘇州一員，杭州一員。

translations.literal: Weaving: one Supervising Grand Director each at Nanjing, Suzhou, and Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: For weaving, there was one supervising grand director each at Nanjing, Suzhou, and Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 掌織造御用龍衣。

translations.literal: They wove imperial dragon robes.
translations.idiomatic: They wove imperial dragon robes.

sentences.zh: 鎮守，鎮守太監始於洪熙，遍設於正統，凡各省各鎮無不有鎮守太監，至嘉靖八年後始革。

translations.literal: Garrison commissioners: garrison grand directors began in the Hongxi reign, were established everywhere in the Zhengtong period, and no province or garrison lacked one until they were abolished after Jiajing year 8.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison grand directors began in the Hongxi reign, were established everywhere in the Zhengtong period, and no province or garrison lacked one until they were abolished after Jiajing year 8.

sentences.zh: 市舶，廣東、福建、浙江三市舶司各設太監提督，後罷浙江、福建二司，惟存廣東司。

translations.literal: Maritime Trade: each of the three maritime trade offices of Guangdong, Fujian, and Zhejiang had a supervising grand director; later the offices of Zhejiang and Fujian were abolished, and only Guangdong remained.
translations.idiomatic: For maritime trade, each of the three maritime trade offices of Guangdong, Fujian, and Zhejiang had a supervising grand director; later the offices of Zhejiang and Fujian were abolished, and only Guangdong remained.

sentences.zh: 監督倉場，各倉、各場俱設監督太監。

translations.literal: Granary and depot supervision: each granary and depot had a supervising grand director.
translations.idiomatic: For granary and depot supervision, each granary and depot had a supervising grand director.

sentences.zh: 諸陵神宮監，各陵俱設神宮監太監守陵。

translations.literal: At each imperial tomb a Directorate of Imperial Shrines grand director was appointed to guard the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: At each imperial tomb a Directorate of Imperial Shrines grand director was appointed to guard the tomb.

sentences.zh: 其外之監軍、採辦、糧稅、礦關等使，不常設者，不可勝紀也。

translations.literal: Beyond these, army supervisors, procurement agents, grain-tax collectors, mining and customs commissioners, and other irregularly established posts were too numerous to record.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond these, army supervisors, procurement agents, grain-tax collectors, mining and customs commissioners, and other irregularly established posts were too numerous to record.

sentences.zh: 初，吳元年置內史監，設監令，正四品丞，正五品，奉禦，從五品內史，正七品典簿。

translations.literal: At the beginning, in Wu 1 the Inner Scribe Directorate was established, with a Director at rank 4a, Deputies at rank 5a, Imperial Attendants at rank 5b, Inner Scribes at rank 7a, and Registrars.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning, in Wu 1 the Inner Scribe Directorate was established, with a director at rank 4a, deputies at rank 5a, imperial attendants at rank 5b, inner scribes at rank 7a, and registrars.

sentences.zh: 正八品皇門官設皇門使，正五品副。

translations.literal: at rank 8b. Imperial Gate officials were established as Imperial Gate Envoys at rank 5a and Vice Envoys at rank 5b.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 8b. Imperial gate officials were established as imperial gate envoys at rank 5a and vice envoys at rank 5b.

sentences.zh: 從五品後改置內使監、御用監，各設令一人，正三品丞二人，從三品奉禦，正六品典簿。

translations.literal: at rank 5b. Later the Inner Attendant Directorate and Directorate of Imperial Manufacture were established, each with one Director at rank 3a, two Deputies at rank 3b, Imperial Attendants at rank 6a, and Registrars.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 5b. Later the Inner Attendant Directorate and Directorate of Imperial Manufacture were established, each with one director at rank 3a, two deputies at rank 3b, imperial attendants at rank 6a, and registrars.

sentences.zh: 正七品皇門官門正，正四品副，從四品春宮門官正，正五品副，從五品御馬司司正，正五品副，從五品尚寶兼守殿、尚冠、尚衣、尚佩、尚履、尚藥、紀事等奉禦。

translations.literal: at rank 7a. Imperial Gate officials had Gate Chiefs at rank 4a and Vice Chiefs at rank 4b; Eastern Palace Gate officials had Chiefs at rank 5a and Vice Chiefs at rank 5b; the Imperial Horse Office had Office Chiefs at rank 5a and Vice Chiefs at rank 5b; and Imperial Attendants for Imperial Seals combined with Palace Guard, Imperial Caps, Imperial Robes, Imperial Girdles, Imperial Footwear, Imperial Medicine, and Records.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 7a. Imperial gate officials had gate chiefs at rank 4a and vice chiefs at rank 4b; eastern palace gate officials had chiefs at rank 5a and vice chiefs at rank 5b; the imperial horse office had office chiefs at rank 5a and vice chiefs at rank 5b; and imperial attendants for imperial seals combined with palace guard, imperial caps, imperial robes, imperial girdles, imperial footwear, imperial medicine, and records.

sentences.zh: 俱正六品洪武二年，定置內使監奉禦六十人，尚寶一人，尚冠七人，尚衣十人，尚佩九人，尚藥七人，紀事二人，執膳四人，司脯二人，司香四人，太廟司香四人，涓潔二人。

translations.literal: were all at rank 6a. In Hongwu year 2 the Inner Attendant Directorate was fixed at sixty Imperial Attendants, one for Imperial Seals, seven for Imperial Caps, ten for Imperial Robes, nine for Imperial Girdles, seven for Imperial Medicine, two for Records, four for Kitchen Service, two for Preserved Meats, four for Incense, four for Imperial Ancestral Temple Incense, and two for Cleanliness.
translations.idiomatic: were all at rank 6a. In Hongwu year 2 the inner attendant directorate was fixed at sixty imperial attendants, one for imperial seals, seven for imperial caps, ten for imperial robes, nine for imperial girdles, seven for imperial medicine, two for records, four for kitchen service, two for preserved meats, four for incense, four for imperial ancestral temple incense, and two for cleanliness.

sentences.zh: 置尚酒、尚醋、尚面、尚染四局，局設正一人，副二人。

translations.literal: Four offices were established for Imperial Wine, Imperial Vinegar, Imperial Flour, and Imperial Dyeing, each with one Director and two Deputies.
translations.idiomatic: Four offices were established for imperial wine, imperial vinegar, imperial flour, and imperial dyeing, each with one director and two deputies.

sentences.zh: 置御馬、御用二司，司設正一人，副二人。

translations.literal: Two offices were established for Imperial Horses and Imperial Manufacture, each with one Director and two Deputies.
translations.idiomatic: Two offices were established for imperial horses and imperial manufacture, each with one director and two deputies.

sentences.zh: 內府庫設大使一人，副使二人。

translations.literal: The Inner Palace Depot had one Chief Envoy and two Vice Envoys.
translations.idiomatic: The inner palace depot had one chief envoy and two vice envoys.

sentences.zh: 內倉監設令一人，丞二人。

translations.literal: The Inner Granary Directorate had one Director and two Deputies.
translations.idiomatic: The inner granary directorate had one director and two deputies.

sentences.zh: 及置東宮典璽、典翰、典膳、典服、典藥、典乘兵六局，局設局郎一人，丞一人。

translations.literal: Six Eastern Palace offices were also established for Seals, Documents, Cuisine, Robes, Medicine, and Chariots and Arms, each with one Bureau Director and one Deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Six eastern palace offices were also established for seals, documents, cuisine, robes, medicine, and chariots and arms, each with one bureau director and one deputy.

sentences.zh: 又置門官，午門等十三門，各設門正一人，副一人。

translations.literal: Gate officials were also established at the thirteen gates including the Meridian Gate, each with one Gate Chief and one Vice Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Gate officials were also established at the thirteen gates including the Meridian Gate, each with one gate chief and one gate vice chief.

sentences.zh: 東宮門官，春和門等四門，各設門正一人，副一人。

translations.literal: Eastern Palace gate officials were established at the four gates including the Gate of Spring Harmony, each with one Gate Chief and one Vice Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern palace gate officials were established at the four gates including the Gate of Spring Harmony, each with one gate chief and one gate vice chief.

sentences.zh: 三年，置王府承奉司。

translations.literal: In year 3 the Princely Household Service Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 the princely household service office was established.

sentences.zh: 設承奉一人，承奉副二人，典寶、典服、典膳三所，各設正一人，副一人，門官設門正一人，副一人。

translations.literal: One Household Steward, two Vice Stewards, and three offices for Seals, Robes, and Cuisine were established, each with one Director and one Deputy; gate officials were established with one Gate Chief and one Vice Chief.
translations.idiomatic: One household steward, two vice stewards, and three offices for seals, robes, and cuisine were established, each with one director and one deputy; gate officials were established with one gate chief and one gate vice chief.

sentences.zh: 改內使監、御用監，秩皆從三品，令從三品，丞正四品。

translations.literal: The Inner Attendant Directorate and Directorate of Imperial Manufacture were changed, both to rank 3b; Directors to rank 3b and Deputies to rank 4a.
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Attendant Directorate and Directorate of Imperial Manufacture were both reduced to rank 3b; directors were rank 3b and deputies rank 4a.

sentences.zh: 皇門官秩從四品。

translations.literal: Imperial Gate officials were rank 4b.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial gate officials were rank 4b.

sentences.zh: 門正從四品，副正五品，春宮門官正、副同。

translations.literal: Gate Chiefs were rank 4b and Vice Chiefs rank 5a; Eastern Palace Gate Chiefs and Vice Chiefs were the same.
translations.idiomatic: Gate chiefs were rank 4b and vice chiefs rank 5a; eastern palace gate chiefs and vice chiefs were the same.

sentences.zh: 四年，復悉差其品秩，授以散官。

translations.literal: In year 4 all ranks were again adjusted and honorary titles were conferred.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 all ranks were again adjusted and honorary titles were conferred.

sentences.zh: 乃改內使監為正五品，皇門官為正六品。

translations.literal: The Inner Attendant Directorate was then changed to rank 5a and Imperial Gate officials to rank 6a.
translations.idiomatic: The inner attendant directorate was then changed to rank 5a and imperial gate officials to rank 6a.

sentences.zh: 洪武四年，定內官散官。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 4 honorary titles for inner officials were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 4 honorary titles for inner officials were fixed.

sentences.zh: 正四品，中正大夫。

translations.literal: Rank 4a: Righteous Central Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 4a was Righteous Central Grandee.

sentences.zh: 從四品，中侍大夫。

translations.literal: Rank 4b: Central Attendant Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 4b was Central Attendant Grandee.

sentences.zh: 正五品，中衛大夫。

translations.literal: Rank 5a: Central Guard Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 5a was Central Guard Grandee.

sentences.zh: 從五品，侍直大夫。

translations.literal: Rank 5b: Attendant Straight Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 5b was Attendant Straight Grandee.

sentences.zh: 正六品，內侍郎。

translations.literal: Rank 6a: Inner Attendant Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 6a was Inner Attendant Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 從六品，內直郎。

translations.literal: Rank 6b: Inner Straight Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 6b was Inner Straight Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 正七品，正奉郎。

translations.literal: Rank 7a: Righteous Attendant Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 7a was Righteous Attendant Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 從七品，正衛郎。

translations.literal: Rank 7b: Righteous Guard Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 7b was Righteous Guard Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 正八品，司奉郎。

translations.literal: Rank 8a: Office Attendant Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 8a was Office Attendant Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 從八品，司直郎。

translations.literal: Rank 8b: Office Straight Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 8b was Office Straight Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 尋定內使監令。

translations.literal: Soon after the Inner Attendant Directorate director's post was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after the inner attendant directorate director's post was fixed.

sentences.zh: 正五品，授中衛大夫。

translations.literal: Rank 5a, conferred Central Guard Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: The director at rank 5a was conferred Central Guard Grandee.

sentences.zh: 丞，從五品，授侍直大夫。

translations.literal: Deputies, rank 5b, conferred Attendant Straight Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: Deputies at rank 5b were conferred Attendant Straight Grandee.

sentences.zh: 皇門正、局正、司正、東宮門正、局正，俱正六品，授內侍郎。

translations.literal: Imperial Gate Chiefs, Bureau Chiefs, Office Chiefs, Eastern Palace Gate Chiefs, and Bureau Chiefs—all rank 6a, conferred Inner Attendant Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial gate chiefs, bureau chiefs, office chiefs, eastern palace gate chiefs, and bureau chiefs—all at rank 6a—were conferred Inner Attendant Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 尚寶、奉禦、皇門副、局副、司副、東宮門副、局丞，王府承奉、門正、所正，俱從六品，授內直郎。

translations.literal: Imperial Seals Attendants, Imperial Attendants, Imperial Gate Vice Chiefs, Bureau Vice Chiefs, Office Vice Chiefs, Eastern Palace Gate Vice Chiefs, Bureau Deputies, princely household stewards, gate chiefs, and office chiefs—all rank 6b, conferred Inner Straight Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants of imperial seals, imperial attendants, imperial gate vice chiefs, bureau vice chiefs, office vice chiefs, eastern palace gate vice chiefs, bureau deputies, princely household stewards, gate chiefs, and office chiefs—all at rank 6b—were conferred Inner Straight Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 尚冠等奉禦、內府庫大使、內倉監令、王府承奉副、門副、所副，俱正七品，授正奉郎。

translations.literal: Imperial Caps and other Imperial Attendants, Inner Palace Depot chief envoys, Inner Granary directors, princely household vice stewards, gate vice chiefs, and office vice chiefs—all rank 7a, conferred Righteous Attendant Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial caps and other imperial attendants, inner palace depot chief envoys, inner granary directors, princely household vice stewards, gate vice chiefs, and office vice chiefs—all at rank 7a—were conferred Righteous Attendant Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 庫副使、倉丞，俱從七品，授正衛郎。

translations.literal: Depot vice envoys and granary deputies—all rank 7b, conferred Righteous Guard Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Depot vice envoys and granary deputies—all at rank 7b—were conferred Righteous Guard Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 六年，改御用監為供奉司，秩從七品，設官五人。

translations.literal: In year 6 the Directorate of Imperial Manufacture was changed to the Office of Offerings, at rank 7b, with five officials established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 the directorate of imperial manufacture was renamed the Office of Offerings at rank 7b, with five officials established.

sentences.zh: 內倉監為內府倉，以監令為大使，監丞為副使。

translations.literal: The Inner Granary Directorate became the Inner Palace Granary; the director was made chief envoy and the deputy vice envoy.
translations.idiomatic: The inner granary directorate became the inner palace granary; the director was made chief envoy and the deputy vice envoy.

sentences.zh: 內府庫為承運庫。

translations.literal: The Inner Palace Depot became the Transport Depot.
translations.idiomatic: The inner palace depot was renamed the Transport Depot.

sentences.zh: 仍設大使、副使。

translations.literal: Chief and vice envoys were still established.
translations.idiomatic: Chief and vice envoys were still established.

sentences.zh: 尋置紀事司，以宦者張翊為司正。

translations.literal: The Records Office was soon established, with the eunuch Zhang Yi as its director.
translations.idiomatic: The Records Office was soon established, with the eunuch Zhang Yi as its director.

sentences.zh: 秩正七品。

translations.literal: at rank 7a.
translations.idiomatic: Its rank was 7a.

sentences.zh: 又考前代糾劾內官之法，置內正司，設司正一人，正七品司副一人，從七品專糾內官失儀及不法者。

translations.literal: Examining past methods for censuring inner officials, the Inner Rectification Office was established, with one director at rank 7a and one vice director at rank 7b, specifically to investigate breaches of decorum and unlawful conduct among inner officials.
translations.idiomatic: Examining past methods for censuring inner officials, the Inner Rectification Office was established with one director at rank 7a and one vice director at rank 7b, specifically to investigate breaches of decorum and unlawful conduct among inner officials.

sentences.zh: 旋改為典禮司，又改為典禮紀察司，升其品秩。

translations.literal: It was soon changed to the Ceremonial Office, then to the Ceremonial Records and Inspection Office, and its ranks were raised.
translations.idiomatic: It was soon renamed the Ceremonial Office, then the Ceremonial Records and Inspection Office, and its ranks were raised.

sentences.zh: 司正升正六品，司副升從六品。

translations.literal: The office director was promoted to rank 6a and the vice director to rank 6b.
translations.idiomatic: The office director was promoted to rank 6a and the vice director to rank 6b.

sentences.zh: 十年，置神宮內使監，設監令，正五品丞，從五品，司香奉禦，正七品典簿。

translations.literal: In year 10 the Inner Attendant Directorate of Imperial Shrines was established, with a director at rank 5a, a deputy at rank 5b, incense imperial attendants at rank 7a, and a registrar at rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 the inner attendant directorate of imperial shrines was established, with a director at rank 5a, a deputy at rank 5b, incense imperial attendants at rank 7a, and a registrar at rank 8b.

sentences.zh: 從九品天地壇、神壇各祠祭署，設署令，正七品丞，從七品，司香奉禦。

translations.literal: at rank 8b. Sacrifice offices at the Altars of Heaven and Earth and Spirit Altars each had a commissioner at rank 7a, a deputy at rank 7b, and incense imperial attendants at rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 8b. Sacrifice offices at the altars of heaven and earth and spirit altars each had a commissioner at rank 7a, a deputy at rank 7b, and incense imperial attendants at rank 8a.

sentences.zh: 正八品甲、乙、丙、丁、戊五庫，各設大使，正七品副使，從七品及皇城門官端門等十六門，各設門正，正七品副，從七品十二年，更置尚衣、尚冠、尚履三監，針工、皮作、巾帽三局。

translations.literal: Five depots—A, B, C, D, and E—each had a chief envoy at rank 7a and a vice envoy at rank 7b; imperial city gate officials at the Duan Gate and fifteen other gates each had a gate chief at rank 7a and a vice chief at rank 7b. In year 12 the three directorates of Imperial Robes, Imperial Caps, and Imperial Footwear were added, along with the three bureaus of Needlework, Leatherwork, and Caps and Boots.
translations.idiomatic: Five depots—A, B, C, D, and E—each had a chief envoy at rank 7a and a vice envoy at rank 7b; imperial city gate officials at the Duan Gate and fifteen other gates each had a gate chief at rank 7a and a vice chief at rank 7b. In year 12 three directorates were added for imperial robes, imperial caps, and imperial footwear, along with bureaus for needlework, leatherwork, and caps and boots.

sentences.zh: 改尚佩局為尚佩監。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Imperial Girdles was changed to the Directorate of Imperial Girdles.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau of imperial girdles was renamed the directorate of imperial girdles.

sentences.zh: 十六年，置內府寶鈔廣源、廣惠二庫，職掌出納楮幣，入則廣源庫掌之，出則廣惠庫掌之。

translations.literal: In year 16 the Inner Palace Treasure Note Guangyuan and Guanghui depots were established, charged with receipt and disbursement of paper currency; receipts were managed by the Guangyuan Depot and disbursements by the Guanghui Depot.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 the inner palace treasure note Guangyuan and Guanghui depots were established to handle paper currency; the Guangyuan depot received deposits and the Guanghui depot handled disbursements.

sentences.zh: 寶鈔廣源庫，設大使一人，正九品，用流官；

translations.literal: The Treasure Note Guangyuan Depot had one chief envoy at rank 9a, filled by a regular official;
translations.idiomatic: The treasure note Guangyuan depot had one chief envoy at rank 9a, filled by a regular official;

sentences.zh: 副使一人，正九品，用內官。

translations.literal: one vice envoy at rank 9a, filled by an inner official.
translations.idiomatic: one vice envoy at rank 9a, filled by an inner official.

sentences.zh: 寶鈔廣惠庫，設大使二人，從九品；

translations.literal: The Treasure Note Guanghui Depot had two chief envoys at rank 9b;
translations.idiomatic: The treasure note Guanghui depot had two chief envoys at rank 9b;

sentences.zh: 副使二人，從九品。

translations.literal: two vice envoys at rank 9b.
translations.idiomatic: two vice envoys at rank 9b.

sentences.zh: 俱流官、內官兼用。

translations.literal: Both regular and inner officials were used interchangeably.
translations.idiomatic: Both regular and inner officials were used interchangeably.

sentences.zh: 十七年，更定內官諸監、庫、局品職。

translations.literal: In year 17 the ranks and posts of the inner directorates, depots, and bureaus were fixed anew.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 the ranks and posts of inner directorates, depots, and bureaus were fixed anew.

sentences.zh: 內官監，設令一人，正六品丞二人，從六品典簿一人。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Palace Eunuchs had one director at rank 6a, two deputies at rank 6b, and one registrar.
translations.idiomatic: The directorate of palace eunuchs had one director at rank 6a, two deputies at rank 6b, and one registrar.

sentences.zh: 正九品神宮監，設令一人，正七品丞一人，從七品奉禦一人，正八品。

translations.literal: at rank 9a. The Directorate of Imperial Shrines had one director at rank 7a, one deputy at rank 7b, and one imperial attendant at rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 9a. The directorate of imperial shrines had one director at rank 7a, one deputy at rank 7b, and one imperial attendant at rank 8a.

sentences.zh: 尚寶監，設令一人正七品丞一人。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Imperial Seals had one director at rank 7a and one deputy at rank 7b.
translations.idiomatic: The directorate of imperial seals had one director at rank 7a and one deputy at rank 7b.

sentences.zh: 從七品尚衣監，設令一人，正七品丞一人。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Imperial Wardrobe had one director at rank 7a and one deputy at rank 7b.
translations.idiomatic: The directorate of imperial wardrobe had one director at rank 7a and one deputy at rank 7b.

sentences.zh: 從七品奉禦四人。

translations.literal: at rank 7b, with four imperial attendants at rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: Its deputy was rank 7b, with four imperial attendants at rank 8a.

sentences.zh: 正八品尚膳監，設令一人，正七品丞一人。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Imperial Cuisine had one director at rank 7a and one deputy at rank 7b.
translations.idiomatic: The directorate of imperial cuisine had one director at rank 7a and one deputy at rank 7b.

sentences.zh: 從七品司設監，設令一人，正七品丞一人，從七品奉禦四人，正八品司禮監，設令一人，正七品丞一人，從七品御馬監，設令一人，正七品丞一人，從七品直殿監，設令一人，正七品丞四人，從七品小內使十五人。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Palace Equipment had one director at rank 7a, one deputy at rank 7b, and four imperial attendants at rank 8a; the Directorate of Ceremonial had one director at rank 7a and one deputy at rank 7b; the Directorate of Imperial Horses had one director at rank 7a and one deputy at rank 7b; the Directorate of Palace Maintenance had one director at rank 7a, four deputies at rank 7b, and fifteen junior inner attendants at rank 7b.
translations.idiomatic: The directorate of palace equipment had one director at rank 7a, one deputy at rank 7b, and four imperial attendants at rank 8a; the directorate of ceremonial had one director at rank 7a and one deputy at rank 7b; the directorate of imperial horses had one director at rank 7a and one deputy at rank 7b; the directorate of palace maintenance had one director at rank 7a, four deputies at rank 7b, and fifteen junior inner attendants at rank 7b.

sentences.zh: 宮門承製，設奉禦五人。

translations.literal: The Palace Gate Imperial Manufacture office had five imperial attendants.
translations.idiomatic: The palace gate imperial manufacture office had five imperial attendants.

sentences.zh: 正八品宮門守門官，設門正一人，正八品副四人。

translations.literal: at rank 8a. Palace gate guard officials had one gate chief at rank 8a and four vice chiefs at rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 8a. Palace gate guard officials had one gate chief at rank 8a and four vice chiefs at rank 8b.

sentences.zh: 從八品內承運庫，設大使一人，正九品副使二人。

translations.literal: The Inner Transport Depot had one chief envoy at rank 9a and two vice envoys at rank 9b.
translations.idiomatic: The inner transport depot had one chief envoy at rank 9a and two vice envoys at rank 9b.

sentences.zh: 從九品司鑰庫，設大使一人，正九品副使四人。

translations.literal: The Key Depot had one chief envoy at rank 9a and four vice envoys at rank 9b.
translations.idiomatic: The key depot had one chief envoy at rank 9a and four vice envoys at rank 9b.

sentences.zh: 從九品巾帽局，設大使一人，正九品副使一人，從九品針工局，設大使一人，正九品副使一人，從九品織染局，設大使一人，正九品副使一人。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Caps and Boots had one chief envoy at rank 9a and one vice envoy at rank 9b; the Bureau of Needlework had one chief envoy at rank 9a and one vice envoy at rank 9b; the Bureau of Dyeing had one chief envoy at rank 9a and one vice envoy at rank 9b.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau of caps and boots had one chief envoy at rank 9a and one vice envoy at rank 9b; the bureau of needlework had one chief envoy at rank 9a and one vice envoy at rank 9b; the bureau of dyeing had one chief envoy at rank 9a and one vice envoy at rank 9b.

sentences.zh: 從九品顏料局，設大使一人。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Pigments had one chief envoy at rank 9a.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau of pigments had one chief envoy at rank 9a.

sentences.zh: 正九品司苑局，設大使一人。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Palace Gardens had one chief envoy at rank 9a.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau of palace gardens had one chief envoy at rank 9a.

sentences.zh: 正九品司牧局，設大使一人。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Palace Herds had one chief envoy at rank 9a.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau of palace herds had one chief envoy at rank 9a.

sentences.zh: 正九品皆於內官內選用。

translations.literal: All rank 9a posts were filled from among inner officials.
translations.idiomatic: All rank 9a posts were filled from among inner officials.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，重定內官監、司、庫、局與諸門官，並東宮六局、王府承奉等官職秩。

translations.literal: In year 28 the ranks of the inner directorates, offices, depots, and bureaus, gate officials, Eastern Palace six bureaus, and princely household stewards were fixed anew.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28 the ranks of inner directorates, offices, depots, bureaus, gate officials, eastern palace six bureaus, and princely household stewards were fixed anew.

sentences.zh: 凡內官監十一：曰神宮監，曰尚寶監，曰孝陵神宮監，曰尚膳監，曰尚衣監，曰司設監，曰內官監，曰司禮監，曰御馬監，曰印綬監，曰直殿監，皆設太監一人，正四品左、右少監各一人，從四品左、右監丞各一人，正五品典簿一人，正六品又設長隨、奉禦。

translations.literal: There were eleven inner directorates in all: the Directorate of Imperial Shrines, Directorate of Imperial Seals, Xiaoling Imperial Shrines Directorate, Directorate of Imperial Cuisine, Directorate of Imperial Wardrobe, Directorate of Palace Equipment, Directorate of Palace Eunuchs, Directorate of Ceremonial, Directorate of Imperial Horses, Directorate of Seals and Credentials, and Directorate of Palace Maintenance—each with one grand director at rank 4a, one left and one right vice director at rank 4b, one left and one right assistant director at rank 5a, one registrar at rank 6a, and attendants and imperial attendants also established.
translations.idiomatic: There were eleven inner directorates: the directorate of imperial shrines, directorate of imperial seals, Xiaoling imperial shrines directorate, directorate of imperial cuisine, directorate of imperial wardrobe, directorate of palace equipment, directorate of palace eunuchs, directorate of ceremonial, directorate of imperial horses, directorate of seals and credentials, and directorate of palace maintenance—each with one grand director at rank 4a, left and right vice directors at rank 4b, left and right assistant directors at rank 5a, one registrar at rank 6a, and attendants and imperial attendants also established.

sentences.zh: 正六品各門官七：午門、東華門、西華門、玄武門、奉天門、左順門、右順門，皆設門正一人，正四品門副一人。

translations.literal: Seven gate offices: the Meridian Gate, East Glorious Gate, West Glorious Gate, Dark Warrior Gate, Gate of Receiving Heaven, Left Gate of Conforming to the Seasons, and Right Gate of Conforming to the Seasons—each had one gate chief at rank 4a and one vice chief at rank 4b.
translations.idiomatic: Seven gate offices—the Meridian Gate, East Glorious Gate, West Glorious Gate, Dark Warrior Gate, Gate of Receiving Heaven, Left Gate of Conforming to the Seasons, and Right Gate of Conforming to the Seasons—each had one gate chief at rank 4a and one vice chief at rank 4b.

sentences.zh: 從四品司二：曰鐘鼓司，曰惜薪司，皆設司正一人，正五品，左、右司副各一人。

translations.literal: Two offices at rank 4b: the Office of Bells and Drums and the Office of Frugal Fuel—each had one office director at rank 5a and one left and one right vice director at rank 5b.
translations.idiomatic: Two offices at rank 4b—the Office of Bells and Drums and the Office of Frugal Fuel—each had one office director at rank 5a and left and right vice directors at rank 5b.

sentences.zh: 從五品局庫九：曰兵仗局，曰內織染局，曰針工局，曰巾帽局，曰司苑局，曰酒醋面局，曰內承運庫，曰司鑰庫，曰內府供用庫。

translations.literal: Nine bureaus and depots at rank 5b: the Bureau of Military Equipment, Inner Dyeing Bureau, Bureau of Needlework, Bureau of Caps and Boots, Bureau of Palace Gardens, Bureau of Wine, Vinegar, and Flour, Inner Transport Depot, Key Depot, and Inner Palace Supply Depot.
translations.idiomatic: Nine bureaus and depots at rank 5b: the bureau of military equipment, inner dyeing bureau, bureau of needlework, bureau of caps and boots, bureau of palace gardens, bureau of wine, vinegar, and flour, inner transport depot, key depot, and inner palace supply depot.

sentences.zh: 每局庫皆設大使一人，正五品左、右副使各一人。

translations.literal: Each bureau and depot had one chief envoy at rank 5a and one left and one right vice envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Each bureau and depot had one chief envoy at rank 5a and left and right vice envoys.

sentences.zh: 從五品。

translations.literal: at rank 5b.
translations.idiomatic: The vice envoys were rank 5b.

sentences.zh: 東宮典璽、典藥、典膳、典服、典兵、典乘六局，各設局郎一人，正五品局丞二人，從五品惟典璽局增設紀事、奉禦。

translations.literal: The Eastern Palace's six bureaus of Seals, Medicine, Cuisine, Robes, Arms, and Chariots each had one bureau director at rank 5a and two bureau deputies at rank 5b; only the Seals Bureau additionally had record keepers and imperial attendants.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern palace's six bureaus of seals, medicine, cuisine, robes, arms, and chariots each had one bureau director at rank 5a and two bureau deputies at rank 5b; only the seals bureau additionally had record keepers and imperial attendants.

sentences.zh: 正六品親王府承奉司設承奉正，正六品承奉副。

translations.literal: at rank 6a. Princely household steward offices had chief stewards at rank 6a and vice stewards at rank 6b.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 6a. Princely household steward offices had chief stewards at rank 6a and vice stewards at rank 6b.

sentences.zh: 從六品所三：曰典寶所，設典寶正一人，正六品副一人。

translations.literal: Three offices at rank 6b: the Seal Office, with one seal director at rank 6a and one deputy at rank 6b.
translations.idiomatic: Three offices at rank 6b: the seal office, with one seal director at rank 6a and one deputy at rank 6b.

sentences.zh: 從六品曰典膳所，設典膳正一人，正六品副一人。

translations.literal: The Cuisine Office had one cuisine director at rank 6a and one deputy at rank 6b.
translations.idiomatic: The cuisine office had one cuisine director at rank 6a and one deputy at rank 6b.

sentences.zh: 從六品曰典服所，設典服正一人，正六品副一人。

translations.literal: The Robes Office had one robes director at rank 6a and one deputy at rank 6b.
translations.idiomatic: The robes office had one robes director at rank 6a and one deputy at rank 6b.

sentences.zh: 從六品門官，設門正一人，正六品門副一人。

translations.literal: Gate officials had one gate chief at rank 6a and one vice chief at rank 6b.
translations.idiomatic: Gate officials had one gate chief at rank 6a and one vice chief at rank 6b.

sentences.zh: 從六品又設內使十人，司冠一人，司衣三人，司佩一人，司履一人，司藥二人，司矢二人。

translations.literal: Ten inner attendants were also established, with one cap keeper, three robe keepers, one girdle keeper, one footwear keeper, two medicine keepers, and two arrow keepers.
translations.idiomatic: Ten inner attendants were also established, with one cap keeper, three robe keepers, one girdle keeper, one footwear keeper, two medicine keepers, and two arrow keepers.

sentences.zh: 各公主位下設中使司，司正、司副各一人。

translations.literal: Under each princess's household an Inner Attendant Office was established, with one office director and one vice director.
translations.idiomatic: Under each princess's household an inner attendant office was established, with one office director and one vice director.

sentences.zh: 三十年，置都知監，設太監一人，正四品左、右少監各一人，從四品左、右監丞各一人，正五品典簿一人。

translations.literal: In year 30 the Directorate of Imperial Inspection was established, with one grand director at rank 4a, one left and one right vice director at rank 4b, one left and one right assistant director at rank 5a, and one registrar at rank 6a.
translations.idiomatic: In year 30 the directorate of imperial inspection was established, with one grand director at rank 4a, left and right vice directors at rank 4b, left and right assistant directors at rank 5a, and one registrar at rank 6a.

sentences.zh: 正六品又置銀作局，設大使一人，正五品副使一人。

translations.literal: at rank 6a. The Bureau of Silver Work was also established, with one chief envoy at rank 5a and one vice envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 6a. The bureau of silver work was also established, with one chief envoy at rank 5a and one vice envoy.

sentences.zh: 從五品

translations.literal: at rank 5b.
translations.idiomatic: The vice envoy was rank 5b.

sentences.zh: 太祖嘗謂侍臣曰：「朕觀《周禮》，奄寺不及百人。

translations.literal: The Taizu Emperor once said to his attending ministers: "When I examine the 《Rites of Zhou》, palace eunuchs numbered fewer than one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu emperor once told his attending ministers: "When I examine the 《Rites of Zhou》, palace eunuchs numbered fewer than one hundred.

sentences.zh: 後世至逾數千，因用階亂。

translations.literal: Later ages reached several thousand, and disorder arose through their employment.
translations.idiomatic: Later ages reached several thousand, and disorder arose through their employment.

sentences.zh: 此曹止可供灑掃，給使令，非別有委任，毋令過多。」

translations.literal: These people should only supply sweeping and running errands; they have no separate commissions—do not let their numbers grow excessive.
translations.idiomatic: These people should only supply sweeping and running errands; they have no separate commissions—do not let their numbers grow excessive.

sentences.zh: 又言：「此曹善者千百中不一二，惡者常千百。

translations.literal: He also said: "Among these people, perhaps one or two in a thousand are good; the bad are normally nine hundred ninety-nine in a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Among these people, perhaps one or two in a thousand are good; the bad are normally nine hundred ninety-nine in a thousand.

sentences.zh: 若用為耳目，即耳目蔽；

translations.literal: If they are used as eyes and ears, then the eyes and ears are blinded;
translations.idiomatic: If they are used as eyes and ears, then the eyes and ears are blinded;

sentences.zh: 用為心腹，即心腹病。

translations.literal: if they are used as heart and belly, then the heart and belly are diseased.
translations.idiomatic: if they are used as heart and belly, then the heart and belly are diseased.

sentences.zh: 馭之之道，在使之畏法，不可使有功。

translations.literal: The way to control them is to make them fear the law—not to let them have achievements.
translations.idiomatic: The way to control them is to make them fear the law—not to let them have achievements.

sentences.zh: 畏法則檢束，有功則驕恣。」

translations.literal: Fear of the law keeps them restrained; achievements make them arrogant and unrestrained.
translations.idiomatic: Fear of the law keeps them restrained; achievements make them arrogant and unrestrained.

sentences.zh: 有內侍事帝最久，微言及政事，立斥之，終其身不召。

translations.literal: There was an inner attendant who had served the emperor longest; he briefly touched on state affairs and was immediately dismissed, never summoned again for the rest of his life.
translations.idiomatic: There was an inner attendant who had served the emperor longest; he briefly touched on state affairs and was immediately dismissed, never summoned again for the rest of his life.

sentences.zh: 因定制，內侍毋許識字。

translations.literal: Accordingly a rule was made that inner attendants were not permitted to learn literacy.
translations.idiomatic: Accordingly a rule was made that inner attendants were not permitted to learn literacy.

sentences.zh: 洪武十七年鑄鐵牌，文曰：「內臣不得干預政事，犯者斬」，置宮門中。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 17 an iron plaque was cast with the text "Inner officials must not meddle in state affairs; violators are executed," and it was placed within the palace gates.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 17 an iron plaque was cast reading "Inner officials must not meddle in state affairs; violators are executed," and it was placed within the palace gates.

sentences.zh: 又敕諸司毋得與內官監文移往來。

translations.literal: Orders were also issued that no department might exchange official documents with the Directorate of Palace Eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: Orders were also issued that no department might exchange official documents with the directorate of palace eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 然二十五年命聶慶童往河州敕諭茶馬，中官奉使行事已自此始。

translations.literal: Yet in year 25 Nie Qingtong was sent to Hezhou with an imperial rescript on tea and horses—the beginning of inner officials bearing imperial commissions.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in year 25 Nie Qingtong was sent to Hezhou with an imperial rescript on tea and horses—the beginning of inner officials bearing imperial commissions.

sentences.zh: 成祖亦嘗云：「朕一遵太祖訓，無禦寶文書，即一軍一民，中官不得擅調發。」

translations.literal: The Chengzu Emperor also once said: "I follow the Taizu precepts in full; without an imperial seal document, not even one army or one commoner may an inner official deploy on his own authority.
translations.idiomatic: The Chengzu emperor also once said: "I follow the Taizu precepts in full; without an imperial seal document, not even one soldier or one commoner may an inner official deploy on his own authority.

sentences.zh: 有私役應天工匠者，立命錦衣逮治。

translations.literal: When one privately employed artisans of Yingtian, he immediately ordered the Brocade Guard to arrest and punish him.
translations.idiomatic: When one privately employed artisans of Yingtian, he immediately ordered the Brocade Guard to arrest and punish him.

sentences.zh: 顧中官四出，實始永樂時。

translations.literal: Yet the actual sending out of inner officials in all directions truly began in the Yongle reign.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the actual sending out of inner officials in all directions truly began in the Yongle reign.

sentences.zh: 元年，李興等齎敕勞暹羅國王，此奉使外國之始也。

translations.literal: In year 1 Li Xing and others carried an imperial message to congratulate the king of Siam—this was the beginning of missions abroad.
translations.idiomatic: In year 1 Li Xing and others carried an imperial message to congratulate the king of Siam—this was the beginning of missions abroad.

sentences.zh: 三年，命鄭和等率兵二萬，行賞西洋古裏、滿剌諸國，此將兵之始也。

translations.literal: In year 3 Zheng He and others were ordered to lead twenty thousand troops on reward missions to the Western Ocean states of Calicut, Malacca, and others—this was the beginning of commanding troops.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 Zheng He and others were ordered to lead twenty thousand troops on reward missions to the Western Ocean states of Calicut, Malacca, and others—this was the beginning of commanding troops.

sentences.zh: 八年，敕王安等監都督譚青等軍，馬靖巡視甘肅，此監軍、巡視之始也。

translations.literal: In year 8 Wang An and others were ordered to supervise the armies of Regional Commander Tan Qing and others; Ma Jing toured Gansu—this was the beginning of army supervision and inspection tours.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 Wang An and others were ordered to supervise the armies of Regional Commander Tan Qing and others; Ma Jing toured Gansu—this was the beginning of army supervision and inspection tours.

sentences.zh: 及洪熙元年，以鄭和領下番官軍守備南京，遂相沿不改。

translations.literal: By Hongxi 1 Zheng He was put in charge of the stationed troops from the southern voyages to garrison Nanjing, and this practice continued unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: By Hongxi 1 Zheng He was put in charge of the stationed troops from the southern voyages to garrison Nanjing, and this practice continued unchanged.

sentences.zh: 敕王安鎮守甘肅，而各省鎮皆設鎮守矣。

translations.literal: Wang An was ordered to garrison Gansu, and garrison commissioners were established in every province.
translations.idiomatic: Wang An was ordered to garrison Gansu, and garrison commissioners were established in every province.

sentences.zh: 宣德四年，特設內書堂，命大學士陳山專授小內使書，而太祖不許識字讀書之制，由此而廢。

translations.literal: In Xuande year 4 an Inner Script Hall was specially established, and Grand Secretary Chen Shan was ordered to instruct junior inner attendants in literacy—thereby abolishing the Taizu prohibition against literacy and reading.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 4 an Inner Script Hall was specially established, and Grand Secretary Chen Shan was ordered to instruct junior inner attendants in literacy—thereby abolishing the Taizu prohibition against literacy and reading.

sentences.zh: 賜王瑾、金英印記，則與諸密勿大臣同。

translations.literal: When Wang Jin and Jin Ying were granted seal stamps, they were treated like confidential grand ministers.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Jin and Jin Ying were granted seal stamps, they were treated like confidential grand ministers.

sentences.zh: 賜金英、範弘等免死詔，則又無異勳臣之鐵券也。

translations.literal: When death-exemption edicts were granted to Jin Ying, Fan Hong, and others, they were no different from the iron certificates given to meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: When death-exemption edicts were granted to Jin Ying, Fan Hong, and others, they were no different from the iron certificates given to meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 英之王振，憲之汪直，武之劉瑾，熹之魏忠賢，太阿倒握，威福下移。

translations.literal: Wang Zhen under Yingzong, Wang Zhi under Xianzong, Liu Jin under Wuzong, and Wei Zhongxian under Xizong—in each case imperial authority was inverted and power shifted downward.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhen under Yingzong, Wang Zhi under Xianzong, Liu Jin under Wuzong, and Wei Zhongxian under Xizong—in each case imperial authority was inverted and power shifted downward.

sentences.zh: 神宗礦稅之使，無一方不罹厥害。

translations.literal: The mining-tax commissioners of Shenzong brought suffering to every region.
translations.idiomatic: The mining-tax commissioners of Shenzong brought suffering to every region.

sentences.zh: 其他怙勢薰灼，不可勝紀。

translations.literal: Other cases of relying on power to intimidate and dominate were too numerous to record.
translations.idiomatic: Other cases of relying on power to intimidate and dominate were too numerous to record.

sentences.zh: 而廕弟、廕侄、封伯、封公，則撓官制之大者。

translations.literal: Ennobling younger brothers and nephews as earls and dukes was a major distortion of the official system.
translations.idiomatic: Ennobling younger brothers and nephews as earls and dukes was a major distortion of the official system.

sentences.zh: 莊烈帝初翦大憝，中外頌聖。

translations.literal: When the Chongzhen Emperor first cut down the great villain, court and country praised the sage ruler.
translations.idiomatic: When the Chongzhen emperor first cut down the great villain, court and country praised the sage ruler.

sentences.zh: 既而鎮守、出征、督餉、坐營等事，無一不命中官為之，而明亦遂亡矣。

translations.literal: Thereafter garrisoning, campaigning, supervising supplies, sitting in camp, and the like—none of these was done without appointing inner officials, and with that the Ming dynasty perished.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter garrisoning, campaigning, supervising supplies, sitting in camp, and the like—none of these was done without appointing inner officials, and with that the Ming dynasty perished.

sentences.zh: 女官。

translations.literal: Palace women officials.
translations.idiomatic: Palace women officials.

sentences.zh: 六局。

translations.literal: Six Bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Six Bureaus.

sentences.zh: 尚宮局，尚宮二人，正五品。

translations.literal: Chief Palace Bureau: two Chiefs of Palace at rank 5a.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Palace Bureau had two Chiefs of Palace at rank 5a.

sentences.zh: 六尚並同。

translations.literal: The Six Chiefs were all the same.
translations.idiomatic: All Six Chiefs held the same rank and staffing.

sentences.zh: 尚宮掌導引中宮。

translations.literal: The Chief of Palace directed and guided the empress.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief of Palace directed and guided the empress.

sentences.zh: 凡六局出納文籍，皆印署之。

translations.literal: For all documents issued and received by the Six Bureaus, she sealed and signed them.
translations.idiomatic: For all documents issued and received by the Six Bureaus, she sealed and signed them.

sentences.zh: 若徵辦於外，則為之請旨，牒付內官監。

translations.literal: If supplies were requisitioned from outside, she requested an imperial decree and sent a memorandum to the Inner Official Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: If supplies had to be procured from outside, she requested an imperial decree and forwarded a memorandum to the Inner Official Directorate.

sentences.zh: 監受牒，行移於外。

translations.literal: The directorate received the memorandum and forwarded dispatch documents outside.
translations.idiomatic: The directorate received the memorandum and sent dispatch documents outside.

sentences.zh: 領司四：司記，司記二人，正六品；

translations.literal: It oversaw four offices: Records, with two Supervisors of Records at rank 6a;
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw four offices. Records: two Supervisors of Records at rank 6a;

sentences.zh: 典記二人，正七品；

translations.literal: two Aides of Records at rank 7a;
translations.idiomatic: two Aides of Records at rank 7a;

sentences.zh: 掌記二人，正八品。

translations.literal: two Clerks of Records at rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: two Clerks of Records at rank 8a.

sentences.zh: 掌宮內諸司簿書，出入錄目，番署加印，然後授行。

translations.literal: They managed the ledgers of all inner offices, recorded items in and out, added seals in rotation, and only then authorized release.
translations.idiomatic: They kept the ledgers of all inner offices, recorded what went in and out, applied seals in rotation, and only then authorized release.

sentences.zh: 女史六人，掌執文書，凡二十四司，二十四典，二十四掌，品秩並同。

translations.literal: Six female clerks managed documents; for all twenty-four Supervisors, twenty-four Aides, and twenty-four Clerks, ranks were identical.
translations.idiomatic: Six female clerks handled documents; across all twenty-four Supervisors, twenty-four Aides, and twenty-four Clerks, ranks were the same.

sentences.zh: 司言，司言二人，典言二人，掌言二人，女史四人，掌宣傳啟奏。

translations.literal: Speech: two Supervisors of Speech, two Aides of Speech, two Clerks of Speech, and four female clerks who conveyed announcements and presented petitions.
translations.idiomatic: Speech: two Supervisors of Speech, two Aides of Speech, two Clerks of Speech, and four female clerks who conveyed announcements and presented petitions.

sentences.zh: 凡令節外命婦朝賀中宮，司言傳旨。

translations.literal: Whenever imperial edicts required titled ladies from outside to attend the empress on ceremonial occasions, the Supervisors of Speech transmitted the decree.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever edicts summoned titled ladies from outside to attend the empress on ceremonial occasions, the Supervisors of Speech transmitted the imperial will.

sentences.zh: 司簿，司簿二人，典簿二人，掌簿二人，女史六人，掌宮人名籍及廩賜之事。

translations.literal: Registers: two Supervisors of Registers, two Aides of Registers, two Clerks of Registers, and six female clerks who managed the registry of palace women and grain allotments and gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Registers: two Supervisors of Registers, two Aides of Registers, two Clerks of Registers, and six female clerks who kept the registry of palace women and managed grain allotments and gifts.

sentences.zh: 司闈。

translations.literal: Inner Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Gate.

sentences.zh: 司闈六人，典闈六人，掌闈六人，女史四人，掌宮闈管鍵之事。

translations.literal: Six Supervisors of Inner Gate, six Aides of Inner Gate, six Clerks of Inner Gate, and four female clerks who managed the keys and gates of the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: Six Supervisors of Inner Gate, six Aides of Inner Gate, six Clerks of Inner Gate, and four female clerks who managed the keys and gates of the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 尚儀局，尚儀二人，掌禮儀起居事。

translations.literal: Chief Ceremonial Bureau: two Chiefs of Ceremonies who managed ritual protocol and daily conduct.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Ceremonial Bureau had two Chiefs of Ceremonies who managed ritual protocol and daily conduct.

sentences.zh: 領司四：司籍，司籍二人，典籍二人，掌籍二人，女史十人，掌經籍、圖書、筆劄、幾案之事。

translations.literal: It oversaw four offices: Archives, with two Supervisors of Archives, two Aides of Archives, two Clerks of Archives, and ten female clerks who managed classics, books, writing materials, and desk furnishings.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw four offices. Archives: two Supervisors of Archives, two Aides of Archives, two Clerks of Archives, and ten female clerks who managed classics, books, writing materials, and desk furnishings.

sentences.zh: 司樂，司樂四人，典樂四人，掌樂四人，女史二人，掌音樂之事。

translations.literal: Music: four Supervisors of Music, four Aides of Music, four Clerks of Music, and two female clerks who managed musical affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Music: four Supervisors of Music, four Aides of Music, four Clerks of Music, and two female clerks who managed musical affairs.

sentences.zh: 司賓，司賓二人，典賓二人，掌賓二人，女史二人，掌朝見、宴會、賜賚之事。

translations.literal: Guests: two Supervisors of Guests, two Aides of Guests, two Clerks of Guests, and two female clerks who managed audiences, banquets, and imperial gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Guests: two Supervisors of Guests, two Aides of Guests, two Clerks of Guests, and two female clerks who managed audiences, banquets, and imperial gifts.

sentences.zh: 司贊，司贊二人，典贊二人，掌贊二人，女史二人，掌朝見、宴會、贊相之事。

translations.literal: Acclaim: two Supervisors of Acclaim, two Aides of Acclaim, two Clerks of Acclaim, and two female clerks who managed audiences, banquets, and ceremonial prompting.
translations.idiomatic: Acclaim: two Supervisors of Acclaim, two Aides of Acclaim, two Clerks of Acclaim, and two female clerks who managed audiences, banquets, and ceremonial prompting.

sentences.zh: 彤史。

translations.literal: Red Record.
translations.idiomatic: Red Record.

sentences.zh: 彤史二人，正六品，掌宴見進禦之事，凡后妃、羣妾禦於君所，彤史謹書其月日。

translations.literal: Two Red Record keepers at rank 6a managed banquets, audiences, and attendance at the emperor's bedchamber; whenever the empress, consorts, and concubines attended the sovereign, the Red Record keepers carefully recorded the month and day.
translations.idiomatic: Two Red Record keepers at rank 6a managed banquets, audiences, and attendance at the emperor's bedchamber; whenever the empress, consorts, and concubines attended the sovereign, the Red Record keepers carefully recorded the month and day.

sentences.zh: 尚服局，尚服二人，掌供服用採章之數。

translations.literal: Chief Wardrobe Bureau: two Chiefs of Wardrobe who managed the standards for dress and insignia.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Wardrobe Bureau had two Chiefs of Wardrobe who managed the standards for dress and insignia.

sentences.zh: 領司四：司寶，司寶二人，典寶二人，掌寶二人，女史四人，掌寶璽、符契。

translations.literal: It oversaw four offices: Seals, with two Supervisors of Seals, two Aides of Seals, two Clerks of Seals, and four female clerks who managed imperial seals and tally documents.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw four offices. Seals: two Supervisors of Seals, two Aides of Seals, two Clerks of Seals, and four female clerks who managed imperial seals and tally documents.

sentences.zh: 司衣，司衣二人，典衣二人，掌衣二人，女史四人，掌衣服、首飾之事。

translations.literal: Garments: two Supervisors of Garments, two Aides of Garments, two Clerks of Garments, and four female clerks who managed clothing and head ornaments.
translations.idiomatic: Garments: two Supervisors of Garments, two Aides of Garments, two Clerks of Garments, and four female clerks who managed clothing and head ornaments.

sentences.zh: 司飾，司飾二人，典飾二人，掌飾二人，女史二人，掌巾櫛、膏沐之事。

translations.literal: Toiletries: two Supervisors of Toiletries, two Aides of Toiletries, two Clerks of Toiletries, and two female clerks who managed towels, combs, and bathing preparations.
translations.idiomatic: Toiletries: two Supervisors of Toiletries, two Aides of Toiletries, two Clerks of Toiletries, and two female clerks who managed towels, combs, and bathing preparations.

sentences.zh: 司仗，司仗二人，典仗二人，掌仗二人，女史二人，凡朝賀，帥女官擎執儀仗。

translations.literal: Regalia: two Supervisors of Regalia, two Aides of Regalia, two Clerks of Regalia, and two female clerks; at every court congratulation ceremony they led palace women officials in bearing ceremonial regalia.
translations.idiomatic: Regalia: two Supervisors of Regalia, two Aides of Regalia, two Clerks of Regalia, and two female clerks; at every court congratulation ceremony they led palace women officials in bearing ceremonial regalia.

sentences.zh: 尚食局，尚食二人，掌膳羞品齊之數。

translations.literal: Chief Food Bureau: two Chiefs of Food who managed the standards for dishes and delicacies.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Food Bureau had two Chiefs of Food who managed the standards for dishes and delicacies.

sentences.zh: 凡以飲食進禦，尚食先嚐之。

translations.literal: Whenever food and drink were presented to the emperor, the Chief of Food tasted it first.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever food and drink were presented to the emperor, the Chief of Food tasted it first.

sentences.zh: 領司四：司膳，司膳四人，典膳四人，掌膳四人，女史四人，掌割烹煎和之事。

translations.literal: It oversaw four offices: Cuisine, with four Supervisors of Cuisine, four Aides of Cuisine, four Clerks of Cuisine, and four female clerks who managed cutting, cooking, frying, and seasoning.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw four offices. Cuisine: four Supervisors of Cuisine, four Aides of Cuisine, four Clerks of Cuisine, and four female clerks who managed cutting, cooking, frying, and seasoning.

sentences.zh: 司醞，司醞二人，典醞二人，掌醞二人，女史二人，掌酒醴酏飲之事。

translations.literal: Brewing: two Supervisors of Brewing, two Aides of Brewing, two Clerks of Brewing, and two female clerks who managed wine, fermented liquor, and beverages.
translations.idiomatic: Brewing: two Supervisors of Brewing, two Aides of Brewing, two Clerks of Brewing, and two female clerks who managed wine, fermented liquor, and beverages.

sentences.zh: 司藥，司藥二人，典藥二人，掌藥二人，女史四人，掌醫方藥物。

translations.literal: Medicine: two Supervisors of Medicine, two Aides of Medicine, two Clerks of Medicine, and four female clerks who managed medical prescriptions and drugs.
translations.idiomatic: Medicine: two Supervisors of Medicine, two Aides of Medicine, two Clerks of Medicine, and four female clerks who managed medical prescriptions and drugs.

sentences.zh: 司饎。

translations.literal: Provisions.
translations.idiomatic: Provisions.

sentences.zh: 司饎二人，典饎二人，掌饎二人，掌廩餼薪炭之事。

translations.literal: Two Supervisors of Provisions, two Aides of Provisions, and two Clerks of Provisions who managed grain allotments and fuel.
translations.idiomatic: Two Supervisors of Provisions, two Aides of Provisions, and two Clerks of Provisions who managed grain allotments and fuel.

sentences.zh: 尚寢局，尚寢二人，掌天子之宴寢。

translations.literal: Chief Bedchamber Bureau: two Chiefs of Bedchamber who managed the emperor's sleeping quarters.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Bedchamber Bureau had two Chiefs of Bedchamber who managed the emperor's sleeping quarters.

sentences.zh: 領司四：司設，司設二人，典設二人，掌設二人，女史四人，掌牀帷、茵席、汛掃、張設之事。

translations.literal: It oversaw four offices: Furnishings, with two Supervisors of Furnishings, two Aides of Furnishings, two Clerks of Furnishings, and four female clerks who managed bed curtains, mats, cleaning, and setup.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw four offices. Furnishings: two Supervisors of Furnishings, two Aides of Furnishings, two Clerks of Furnishings, and four female clerks who managed bed curtains, mats, cleaning, and setup.

sentences.zh: 司輿，司輿二人，典輿二人，掌輿二人，女史二人，掌輿輦、傘扇之事。

translations.literal: Carriages: two Supervisors of Carriages, two Aides of Carriages, two Clerks of Carriages, and two female clerks who managed palanquins, umbrellas, and fans.
translations.idiomatic: Carriages: two Supervisors of Carriages, two Aides of Carriages, two Clerks of Carriages, and two female clerks who managed palanquins, umbrellas, and fans.

sentences.zh: 司苑，司苑二人，典苑二人，掌苑二人，女史四人，掌園囿種值花果。

translations.literal: Gardens: two Supervisors of Gardens, two Aides of Gardens, two Clerks of Gardens, and four female clerks who managed planting flowers and fruit in the palace gardens.
translations.idiomatic: Gardens: two Supervisors of Gardens, two Aides of Gardens, two Clerks of Gardens, and four female clerks who managed planting flowers and fruit in the palace gardens.

sentences.zh: 司燈。

translations.literal: Lamps.
translations.idiomatic: Lamps.

sentences.zh: 司燈二人，典燈二人，掌燈二人，女史二人，掌燈燭事。

translations.literal: Two Supervisors of Lamps, two Aides of Lamps, two Clerks of Lamps, and two female clerks who managed lamps and candles.
translations.idiomatic: Two Supervisors of Lamps, two Aides of Lamps, two Clerks of Lamps, and two female clerks who managed lamps and candles.

sentences.zh: 尚功局，尚功二人，掌督女紅之程課。

translations.literal: Chief Works Bureau: two Chiefs of Works who supervised quotas and assessments for women's needlework.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Works Bureau had two Chiefs of Works who supervised quotas and assessments for women's needlework.

sentences.zh: 領司四：司制，司制二人，典制二人，掌制二人，女史四人，裳衣服裁製縫紉之事。

translations.literal: It oversaw four offices: Manufacture, with two Supervisors of Manufacture, two Aides of Manufacture, two Clerks of Manufacture, and four female clerks who managed cutting, sewing, and stitching garments.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw four offices. Manufacture: two Supervisors of Manufacture, two Aides of Manufacture, two Clerks of Manufacture, and four female clerks who managed cutting, sewing, and stitching garments.

sentences.zh: 司珍，司珍二人，典珍二人，掌珍二人，女史六人，掌金玉寶貨。

translations.literal: Treasures: two Supervisors of Treasures, two Aides of Treasures, two Clerks of Treasures, and six female clerks who managed gold, jade, and precious goods.
translations.idiomatic: Treasures: two Supervisors of Treasures, two Aides of Treasures, two Clerks of Treasures, and six female clerks who managed gold, jade, and precious goods.

sentences.zh: 司彩，司彩二人，典彩二人，掌彩二人，女史六人，掌繪綿絲絮事。

translations.literal: Colors: two Supervisors of Colors, two Aides of Colors, two Clerks of Colors, and six female clerks who managed dyeing, silk floss, and padding.
translations.idiomatic: Colors: two Supervisors of Colors, two Aides of Colors, two Clerks of Colors, and six female clerks who managed dyeing, silk floss, and padding.

sentences.zh: 司計，司計二人，典計二人，掌計二人，女史四人，掌度支衣服、飲食、柴炭之事。

translations.literal: Accounts: two Supervisors of Accounts, two Aides of Accounts, two Clerks of Accounts, and four female clerks who managed expenditures for clothing, food, and fuel.
translations.idiomatic: Accounts: two Supervisors of Accounts, two Aides of Accounts, two Clerks of Accounts, and four female clerks who managed expenditures for clothing, food, and fuel.

sentences.zh: 宮正司。

translations.literal: Palace Rectitude Office.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Rectitude Office.

sentences.zh: 宮正一人，正五品；

translations.literal: One Palace Rectifier at rank 5a;
translations.idiomatic: One Palace Rectifier at rank 5a;

sentences.zh: 司正二人，正六品；

translations.literal: two Rectifier Supervisors at rank 6a;
translations.idiomatic: two Rectifier Supervisors at rank 6a;

sentences.zh: 典正二人，正七品。

translations.literal: two Rectifier Aides at rank 7a.
translations.idiomatic: two Rectifier Aides at rank 7a.

sentences.zh: 掌糾察宮闈、戒令、謫罰之事。

translations.literal: They inspected the inner palace, enforced regulations, and imposed demotions and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: They inspected the inner palace, enforced regulations, and imposed demotions and punishments.

sentences.zh: 大事則奏聞。

translations.literal: Major matters were reported to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Major matters were reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 女史四人，記功過。

translations.literal: Four female clerks recorded merit and fault.
translations.idiomatic: Four female clerks recorded merit and fault.

sentences.zh: 吳元年，置內職六尚局。

translations.literal: In the first year of the Wu reign era, the Six Chief Bureaus of inner service were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Wu reign era, the Six Chief Bureaus of inner service were established.

sentences.zh: 洪武五年，定為六局一司。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 5 they were fixed as six bureaus and one office.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 5 they were fixed as six bureaus and one office.

sentences.zh: 局曰尚宮，曰尚儀，曰尚服，曰尚食，曰尚寢，曰尚功。

translations.literal: The bureaus were called Chief Palace, Chief Ceremonial, Chief Wardrobe, Chief Food, Chief Bedchamber, and Chief Works.
translations.idiomatic: The bureaus were Chief Palace, Chief Ceremonial, Chief Wardrobe, Chief Food, Chief Bedchamber, and Chief Works.

sentences.zh: 司曰宮正。

translations.literal: The office was called Palace Rectitude.
translations.idiomatic: The office was called Palace Rectitude.

sentences.zh: 尚宮二人，尚儀、尚服、尚食、尚寢、尚功各一人，宮正二人，俱正六品。

translations.literal: Two Chiefs of Palace; one each for Chief Ceremonial, Chief Wardrobe, Chief Food, Chief Bedchamber, and Chief Works; and two Palace Rectifiers—all at rank 6a.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Chiefs of Palace; one each for Chief Ceremonial, Chief Wardrobe, Chief Food, Chief Bedchamber, and Chief Works; and two Palace Rectifiers—all at rank 6a.

sentences.zh: 六局分領二十四司，每司或二人或四人。

translations.literal: The Six Bureaus divided supervision among twenty-four offices, each with either two or four incumbents.
translations.idiomatic: The Six Bureaus divided supervision among twenty-four offices, each staffed with either two or four incumbents.

sentences.zh: 司記、司言、司簿、司樂、司寶、司衣、司飾、司醞、司藥、司供、司輿、司苑、司珍、司彩、司計各二人。

translations.literal: Records, Speech, Registers, Music, Seals, Garments, Toiletries, Brewing, Medicine, Provisions, Carriages, Gardens, Treasures, Colors, and Accounts each had two incumbents.
translations.idiomatic: Records, Speech, Registers, Music, Seals, Garments, Toiletries, Brewing, Medicine, Provisions, Carriages, Gardens, Treasures, Colors, and Accounts each had two incumbents.

sentences.zh: 司闈、司籍、司賓、司贊、司仗、司饌、司設、司燈、司制各四人。

translations.literal: Inner Gate, Archives, Guests, Acclaim, Regalia, Cuisine, Furnishings, Lamps, and Manufacture each had four incumbents.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Gate, Archives, Guests, Acclaim, Regalia, Cuisine, Furnishings, Lamps, and Manufacture each had four incumbents.

sentences.zh: 女史十八人。

translations.literal: There were eighteen female clerks.
translations.idiomatic: There were eighteen female clerks.

sentences.zh: 尚功局六人，餘五局及宮正局各二人。

translations.literal: The Chief Works Bureau had six; the other five bureaus and the Palace Rectitude Office each had two.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Works Bureau had six incumbents; the other five bureaus and the Palace Rectitude Office each had two.

sentences.zh: 十七年，更定品秩。

translations.literal: In year 17 the ranks were revised.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 the ranks were revised.

sentences.zh: 尚宮、尚儀、尚服、尚食、尚寢、尚功、宮正各一人，俱改正五品；

translations.literal: One each for Chief Palace, Chief Ceremonial, Chief Wardrobe, Chief Food, Chief Bedchamber, Chief Works, and Palace Rectifier—all raised to rank 5a;
translations.idiomatic: One each for Chief Palace, Chief Ceremonial, Chief Wardrobe, Chief Food, Chief Bedchamber, Chief Works, and Palace Rectifier—all raised to rank 5a;

sentences.zh: 二十四司正六品。

translations.literal: the twenty-four Supervisors were rank 6a.
translations.idiomatic: the twenty-four Supervisors were rank 6a.

sentences.zh: 增設二十四掌，正七品。

translations.literal: Twenty-four Clerks were added at rank 7a.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-four Clerks were added at rank 7a.

sentences.zh: 宮正司增設司正，正六品。

translations.literal: The Palace Rectitude Office added Rectifier Supervisors at rank 6a.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Rectitude Office added Rectifier Supervisors at rank 6a.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，授宮官敕。

translations.literal: In year 22 appointment patents were issued to palace officials.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22 appointment patents were issued to palace officials.

sentences.zh: 服勞多者，或五載六載，得歸父母，聽婚嫁。

translations.literal: Those who had served diligently for five or six years might return to their parents and were permitted to marry.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had served diligently for five or six years might return to their parents and were permitted to marry.

sentences.zh: 年高者許歸，願留者聽。

translations.literal: The aged were allowed to leave; those who wished to remain were permitted to stay.
translations.idiomatic: The aged were allowed to leave; those who wished to remain were permitted to stay.

sentences.zh: 現授職者，家給與祿。

translations.literal: Those currently holding office had salaries granted to their families.
translations.idiomatic: Those currently holding office had salaries granted to their families.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，又重定品職。

translations.literal: In year 27 the ranks and posts were revised again.
translations.idiomatic: In year 27 the ranks and posts were revised again.

sentences.zh: 增設二十四典，正七品。

translations.literal: Twenty-four Aides were added at rank 7a.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-four Aides were added at rank 7a.

sentences.zh: 改二十四掌為正八品。

translations.literal: The twenty-four Clerks were changed to rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-four Clerks were changed to rank 8a.

sentences.zh: 尚儀局增設彤史，正六品。

translations.literal: The Chief Ceremonial Bureau added Red Record keepers at rank 6a.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Ceremonial Bureau added Red Record keepers at rank 6a.

sentences.zh: 宮正司增設典正，正七品。

translations.literal: The Palace Rectitude Office added Rectifier Aides at rank 7a.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Rectitude Office added Rectifier Aides at rank 7a.

sentences.zh: 自六尚以下，員數俱如前所列。

translations.literal: From the Six Chiefs downward, the numbers of incumbents were all as listed above.
translations.idiomatic: From the Six Chiefs downward, staffing numbers were all as listed above.

sentences.zh: 凡宮官一百八十七人，女史九十六人。

translations.literal: In all there were 187 palace officials and 96 female clerks.
translations.idiomatic: In all there were 187 palace officials and 96 female clerks.

sentences.zh: 六局各鑄印給之。

translations.literal: Each of the Six Bureaus was cast a seal and given it.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the Six Bureaus was cast a seal and given it.

sentences.zh: 永樂後，職盡移於宦官。

translations.literal: After Yongle, the posts were entirely transferred to eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: After Yongle, the posts were entirely transferred to eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 其宮官所存者，惟尚寶四司而已。

translations.literal: Of the palace officials who remained, only the four offices under the Chief Wardrobe Bureau survived.
translations.idiomatic: Of the palace officials who remained, only the four offices under the Chief Wardrobe Bureau survived.
